# Claude 인수인계 — 운영 전체 코드와 문서

운영 릴리스: `ce17343ad93030eb0da97a44a3e93806d9a83b50`

아래 **1부**는 현재 운영 배포와 동일한 Apps Script 프로젝트 코드입니다. 배포 파일은 `index.html`과 `대시보드.gs` 두 개이며 `Code.gs`는 없습니다. 생략 없이 전부 수록했습니다.

<style>
/* Working and department-report surfaces. */
:root { --plane:#f3f6fb; --surface:#fff; --ink:#14263d; --ink2:#465974; --muted:#65758b; --s1:#2364d2; --border:#dbe3ef; }
html[data-theme="dark"] { --plane:#101927; --surface:#192638; --ink:#edf3ff; --ink2:#bfcee2; --muted:#9aacbf; --border:#34445b; }
body {font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}
.rail {width:218px;background:var(--surface);padding-top:24px}
.rail .nav {font-size:14px;min-height:42px;margin-bottom:4px}
.rail .nav.on {background:#2364d2;color:white}
.rail .nav.on .ix {color:white}
main.main {margin-left:0}
.periodbar {position:relative;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #17294805}
.filters label,.plabel,.pill,.btn,.seg button,.basis-note {font-size:14px}
.filters select,.filters input {font-size:14px;min-height:38px}
.v10-top {display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.v10-top label {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px}
.v10-top select {background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font:inherit}
.v10-top .version {margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.v10-reset {background:#edf3ff!important;color:#194fa7!important;border-color:#b8cdf0!important;font-weight:600}
.v10-banner {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;border-left:4px solid #2364d2;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:18px}
.v10-banner h2 {font-size:21px;margin:0 0 4px}
.v10-banner p {margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.v10-kpis {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.v10-kpi {display:block;text-align:left;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-top:3px solid var(--metric);border-radius:12px;padding:17px;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.v10-kpi:hover {box-shadow:0 4px 18px #17407114;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v10-kpi .label {font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-kpi strong {display:block;font-size:29px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.7px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v10-kpi small {display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
.v10-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
.v10-panel {background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:18px;min-width:0;break-inside:avoid}
.v10-grid>.v10-panel {margin-bottom:0}
.v10-panel h3 {font-size:17px;margin:0 0 4px}
.v10-note {color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:4px 0 14px}
.v10-table {overflow:auto}
.v10-table table {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.v10-table th {background:var(--plane);color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600;padding:11px 12px;text-align:right}
.v10-table td {padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v10-table th:first-child,.v10-table td:first-child {text-align:left}
.v10-table tr:last-child td {border-bottom:0}
.v10-table button {border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--s1);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.v10-empty {padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:12px}
.v10-callout {padding:14px 18px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff5df;color:#714809;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.v10-pair {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.v10-goal {padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.v10-goal-head {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.v10-track {height:8px;background:var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.v10-track span {display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px;background:var(--s1)}
.v10-goal small {color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.v10-settings {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:15px 0}
.v10-settings label {font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-settings input {display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font:inherit}
.v10-actions {display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}
.v10-panel textarea {width:100%;min-height:115px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
.v10-insight {border-left:3px solid #d08a13;padding:8px 16px;margin:14px 0}
.v10-insight h4 {font-size:16px;margin:0 0 5px}
.v10-insight p {margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-panel svg text {font-size:12px}
.v10-panel .chart {overflow:hidden}
.v10-unit {font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.v10-status {font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(min-width:1600px){.v10-kpis {grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:1100px){.v10-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v10-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:760px){.rail{width:200px}.v10-top .version{margin-left:0}.v10-settings{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v10-kpis{gap:8px}.v10-kpi{padding:12px}.v10-kpi strong{font-size:24px}.v10-banner{display:block}.v10-panel{padding:14px}main.main{margin-left:0}}
@media print{
 @page{size:A4 landscape;margin:12mm}
 .rail,.periodbar,.topbar,.basis-note,.foot,.v10-actions,.v10-top,button,.v10-no-print{display:none!important}
 main,main.main,.main,.shell{display:block!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;max-width:none!important}
 body,html{background:#fff!important;color:#14263d!important;font-size:12px;print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
 .v10-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v10-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
 .v10-kpi{display:block!important;padding:10px}.v10-kpi strong{font-size:23px}
 .v10-panel{padding:12px;break-inside:avoid}.v10-table{overflow:visible}.v10-table table{font-size:11px;white-space:normal}
 .v10-table th,.v10-table td{padding:6px}.v10-table button{display:inline!important;color:inherit}
 textarea{border:0!important;resize:none;overflow:visible}.v10-print-break{break-before:page}
}

/* Focused workbench: one shared time period, seven destinations. */
:root{--rail-w:220px;--plane:#f1f5fa;--surface:#fff;--ink:#12253f;--ink2:#4c607a;--muted:#697d94;--border:#dee6f0;--s1:#2364d2;--grid:#e3eaf3;--axis:#a6b7ca}
.rail{width:220px;padding:26px 14px 20px;background:#12253f;color:#fff;border:0;gap:6px}
.rail .brand{padding:0 6px 26px;color:#fff}
.rail .brand small{color:#9fb3ce}
.rail .grp{color:#91a8c5;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:14px 12px 8px}
.rail .nav{color:#c6d4e6;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:10px;line-height:1.4;min-height:48px;font-size:15px}
.rail .nav .ix{color:#8aa2c1;font-size:12px;min-width:20px}
.rail .nav:hover{background:#233c5b;color:white}
.rail .nav.on{background:#2b6bce;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0002;color:#fff}
.rail .easy-nav-group{margin-top:2px}
.rail .easy-nav-children{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin:2px 0 7px 28px;padding:2px 0 2px 10px;border-left:1px solid #49627f}
.rail .easy-nav-child{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:34px;padding:7px 8px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:#aebed3;font:inherit;font-size:13px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.rail .easy-nav-child>span{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#66809f;flex:none}
.rail .easy-nav-child:hover{background:#203a59;color:#fff}
.rail .easy-nav-child.on{background:#eaf2ff;color:#154e9f;font-weight:700}
.rail .easy-nav-child.on>span{background:#2b6bce}
.rail .btn{background:transparent;color:#d3dfef;border-color:#3b516e;font-size:14px;min-height:35px}
.main{max-width:none;padding:28px 32px 64px}
.topbar{margin-bottom:20px}
#sectTitle{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.6px;font-weight:750}
.easy-title-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.easy-pdf-download{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:42px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #2364d225}
#easySubtitle{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:3px 0 0}
.periodbar{background:var(--surface);padding:18px 20px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:20px}
.easy-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.easy-period{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding-right:12px;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.easy-period select{font-family:inherit;font-size:17px;font-weight:650;border:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);padding:7px 4px;cursor:pointer}
.easy-preset{font:inherit;font-size:14px;border:1px solid transparent;background:var(--plane);color:var(--ink2);padding:7px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.easy-preset.on{background:#e9f1ff;border-color:#adc9ee;color:#1854b1;font-weight:650}
.easy-spacer{flex:1}
.easy-conditions{border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:16px;padding-top:16px}
.easy-conditions .filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px}
.easy-conditions label{font-size:13px;gap:5px}
.easy-conditions input,.easy-conditions select{width:100%;font-size:14px}
.easy-conditions .grow{grid-column:span 2;min-width:0}
.easy-period-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0}
.easy-custom{margin-top:15px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.easy-custom p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px}
.easy-custom .pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}
.easy-custom .pill{font-size:14px;min-width:48px;min-height:35px;border-radius:7px}
.easy-subnav{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:5px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:18px;width:max-content;max-width:100%}
.easy-subnav button{border:0;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer}
.easy-subnav button.on{color:#fff;background:#2364d2;font-weight:600}
.easy-lead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
.easy-lead h2{font-size:20px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 5px;font-weight:700}
.easy-lead p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.easy-tag{font-size:12px;background:#edf3ff;color:#2460b4;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 9px;white-space:nowrap}
.v10-kpis{gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.v10-kpi{padding:20px;border-top:0;border-left:4px solid var(--metric);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #17294803}
.v10-kpi strong{font-size:34px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:750}
.v10-kpi .label{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-kpi small{font-size:13px;min-height:20px}
.easy-secondary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:22px}
.easy-secondary>div{padding:16px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}
.easy-secondary>div:last-child{border-right:0}
.easy-secondary span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.easy-secondary b{font-size:19px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
.easy-summary{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;background:#eaf2ff;color:#224d89;border:1px solid #ccdef9;border-radius:10px;padding:15px 18px;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.easy-summary strong{white-space:nowrap}
.easy-link{border:0;background:none;color:var(--s1);font:inherit;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;padding:0;text-align:left}
.easy-tablelink{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin:14px 0}
.v10-panel{padding:22px}.v10-panel h3{font-size:17px}.v10-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.easy-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.55fr 1fr;gap:20px}.easy-grid>.v10-panel{min-width:0}
.easy-rolemenu{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.easy-rolemenu .easy-subnav{margin:0}
.easy-rolemenu label{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto}
.easy-rolemenu select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px;border-radius:8px}
.easy-goalmode{display:flex;gap:5px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;padding:5px;margin-bottom:18px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px}
.easy-goalmode button{border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:10px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.easy-goalmode button.on{background:#2364d2;color:#fff;font-weight:650}
.easy-week-select{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:15px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.easy-week-select label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.easy-week-select select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;min-width:210px}
.easy-week-select strong{margin-left:auto;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.easy-details{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:18px;padding:16px 20px}
.easy-details>summary{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
.easy-details[open]>summary{margin-bottom:16px}
.easy-details .v10-panel{border:0;margin:0;padding:0}
.easy-person-key{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink)}
.easy-person-key i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:99px;display:inline-block;flex:none}
.perf-deck{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.perf-cover{min-height:310px;padding:40px 44px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#122b4b 0%,#1c4f91 62%,#2f73d2 100%);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px #15365f22}
.perf-cover h2{font-size:40px;line-height:1.23;letter-spacing:-1.4px;margin:12px 0 13px;word-break:keep-all}
.perf-cover p{margin:0;max-width:720px;color:#dceaff;font-size:16px}
.perf-eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#aecdff;font-weight:750}
.perf-cover-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.perf-cover-actions>span{font-size:13px;color:#dceaff}
.perf-cover-actions>small{max-width:210px;white-space:normal;text-align:right;line-height:1.45;color:#c7dcf9}
.perf-slide{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 30px;box-shadow:0 7px 24px #1729480b;min-width:0}
.perf-slide-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.perf-slide-head>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:#2364d2;color:#fff;font-weight:750;font-size:13px;flex:none}
.perf-slide-head h2{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 4px}
.perf-slide-head p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.perf-slide-body>.v10-panel:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.perf-two>.v10-panel{margin-bottom:0}
.perf-source-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.perf-source-card{position:relative;min-width:0;padding:17px 18px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--plane);overflow:hidden}
.perf-source-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:4px;background:var(--source-color)}
.perf-source-card.marketing{--source-color:#2a78d6}.perf-source-card.referral{--source-color:#d38a00}.perf-source-card.meeting.marketing{--source-color:#eb6834}.perf-source-card.meeting.referral{--source-color:#2364d2}
.perf-source-card>span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:7px}
.perf-source-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
.perf-source-card strong{display:block;font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:var(--source-color);letter-spacing:-.7px}
.perf-source-card strong small{font-size:13px;margin-left:3px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.perf-source-card p{margin:9px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45}
.perf-source-card p b{color:var(--source-color);font-size:13px}
.perf-source-charts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start;margin-bottom:16px}
.perf-source-charts>.v10-panel{margin-bottom:0}
.perf-next{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;background:#eaf2ff;color:#224d89;border:1px solid #ccdef9;border-radius:10px;padding:15px 18px;margin-top:18px}
.perf-next strong{white-space:nowrap}
.perf-next span{line-height:1.65}
.perf-comment-editor{margin:22px 0 18px;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--plane)}
.perf-comment-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.perf-comment-head h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.perf-comment-head p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.perf-comment-head label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.perf-comment-head select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px}
.perf-comment-editor textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;resize:vertical;padding:15px 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-size:17px;line-height:1.75}
.perf-comment-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:stretch}.perf-comment-columns label{display:block}.perf-comment-columns label>strong,.perf-comment-block-title>strong{display:block;font-size:19px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}.perf-comment-columns label>span,.perf-comment-block-title>span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:9px}.perf-comment-analysis-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}.perf-comment-analysis-stack textarea{height:220px;min-height:220px}.perf-comment-improvement{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column}.perf-comment-improvement textarea{height:672px;min-height:672px;flex:1}.perf-auto-inquiry{padding:0}.perf-inquiry-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.perf-inquiry-metrics article{border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid #6b7c93;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 12px;background:var(--surface)}.perf-inquiry-metrics article.marketing{border-left-color:#eb6834}.perf-inquiry-metrics article.referral{border-left-color:#2364d2}.perf-inquiry-metrics article.meeting{border-left-color:#139b78}.perf-inquiry-metrics article.contract{border-left-color:#d38a00}.perf-inquiry-metrics h4{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}.perf-inquiry-metrics dl{margin:0}.perf-inquiry-metrics dl>div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:3px 0;border-top:1px dotted var(--grid)}.perf-inquiry-metrics dl>div:first-child{border-top:0}.perf-inquiry-metrics dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.perf-inquiry-metrics dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:750;text-align:right}
.perf-comment-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.perf-comment-actions small{margin-left:auto}
.perf-comment-success{color:#12805f;font-weight:650}.perf-comment-error{color:#c43d4a;font-weight:650}
.perf-comment-print{display:none;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-top:18px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #cbd7e6;border-radius:10px;background:#f5f8fc;color:#14263d}
.perf-comment-print h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:17px}.perf-comment-print p{margin:0;line-height:1.7}.perf-comment-print small{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:#61738a}
.perf-rank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;min-width:64px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:7px}.perf-rank small{font-size:10px;font-weight:750}.perf-rank.inquiry.rank-1{background:#fff0b8;color:#805900}.perf-rank.inquiry.rank-2{background:#fff8dc;color:#8a6b1c}.perf-rank.meeting.rank-1{background:#dff4eb;color:#087250}.perf-rank.meeting.rank-2{background:#edf8f4;color:#267761}
.perf-data-comment{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:14px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:#eef4ff;color:#254d83}.perf-data-comment strong{white-space:nowrap}.perf-data-comment span{line-height:1.6}
.perf-band-top{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#fff1a8;color:#7c5900;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 6px}.perf-band-top small{font-size:9px;font-weight:750}
.perf-staff-picker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;background:var(--plane);font-size:13px}.perf-staff-picker strong{margin-right:5px}.perf-staff-picker label{white-space:nowrap}.perf-staff-table .v10-table{overflow-x:auto}.perf-staff-table td b{display:block}.perf-staff-table td small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}.perf-staff-table th:nth-child(n+3),.perf-staff-table td:nth-child(n+3){min-width:100px}
.easy-count{font-size:12px;background:#2364d2;color:#fff;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;margin-left:4px}
.perf-values-always{margin-top:14px}.perf-values-always .tblwrap{overflow-x:auto}
.perf-contract-table{min-width:0}.perf-contract-table>.v10-note{text-align:right;margin:0 0 8px}
.perf-quarter-table tbody tr:last-child,.perf-total{background:#eaf1fb;color:#193e71;font-weight:750;border-top:2px solid #9ab2cf}
.perf-source-table thead tr:first-child th[colspan]{font-size:18px;text-align:center;padding:13px}
.perf-source-table th,.perf-source-table td{text-align:center!important}
.perf-marketing-head{background:#eaf2ff!important;color:#245a99!important}.perf-referral-head{background:#fff5d8!important;color:#805e00!important}
.perf-source-divider{border-left:3px solid #a5b5c9!important}
.perf-source-table tbody td:nth-child(n+2):nth-child(-n+5){background:#f7faff}
.perf-source-table tbody td:nth-child(n+6){background:#fffdf5}
.perf-mk-inquiry{color:#2a78d6}.perf-mk-meeting{color:#eb6834}.perf-ref-inquiry{color:#a46b00}.perf-ref-meeting{color:#2364d2}
.perf-region-guide{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0}.perf-region-guide strong{margin-right:8px;color:var(--ink)}
.perf-region-table th,.perf-region-table td{text-align:center!important}
.perf-week-table{margin-bottom:24px}.perf-goal-met{background:#e3f5ec;color:#116744}.perf-achieved{display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;border-radius:5px;background:#147951;color:white;padding:2px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.perf-band-summary{padding:12px 14px;background:var(--plane);border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.perf-band-summary strong{margin-right:12px}
.perf-capacity-table td:has(.perf-band-rank.rank-1){background:#ffe68a;color:#634400}
.perf-capacity-table td:has(.perf-band-rank.rank-2){background:#e4efff;color:#24598d}
.perf-band-rank{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.perf-band-rank b{font-size:15px}.perf-band-rank small{font-size:10px;font-weight:750;white-space:nowrap}
.perf-staff-table{margin-bottom:20px}.perf-staff-table table{width:100%;table-layout:fixed}
.perf-staff-table th,.perf-staff-table td{text-align:center!important;padding:12px 7px}

.perf-staff-table th:nth-child(n+3),.perf-staff-table td:nth-child(n+3){min-width:0}

.perf-person-start{border-left:3px solid #a7b6c8!important}

.perf-staff-month-total td{padding:17px 8px}.perf-staff-month-total td b{font-size:25px}.perf-staff-month-total td small{font-size:14px;color:inherit}.perf-staff-month-total td span{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px}

.contract-controls,.fu-filter-panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;margin:0 0 20px}
.rail button.nav{color:#c6d4e6}.rail button.nav .ix{color:#91a8c5}.rail button.nav.on,.rail button.nav.on .ix{color:#fff}.rail button.nav:hover{color:#fff;background:#233c5b}.rail button.nav.on:hover{background:#2b6bce}
.contract-basis{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:stretch;margin:12px 0 20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.contract-basis button{flex:1;min-width:210px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--plane);color:var(--ink);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.contract-basis button.on{border:2px solid var(--s1);padding:15px 17px;background:#ecf3ff}
.contract-basis b,.contract-basis small{display:block}.contract-basis small{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:5px}
.contract-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.contract-heading h3{margin:0}
.contract-filter-grid,.fu-filter-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.contract-filter-grid label,.fu-filter-grid label,.fu-lock label,.fu-detail label,.fu-access label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)}
.contract-filter-grid select,.contract-filter-grid input,.fu-filter-grid select,.fu-filter-grid input,.fu-lock input,.fu-detail input,.fu-detail select,.fu-detail textarea,.fu-access select,.fu-issued input{font:inherit;font-size:14px;min-height:43px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid #b6c5d7;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
.contract-search{grid-column:span 2}.contract-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.contract-source{margin:16px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.contract-source summary{cursor:pointer}
.fu-lock{max-width:720px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:42px;margin:26px auto}.fu-lock h2{font-size:24px}.fu-lock p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9}.fu-lock-icon{color:var(--s1);font-weight:700}.fu-lock form{display:grid;gap:18px;margin:24px 0}.fu-toolbar{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}.fu-toolbar small{margin-right:auto;color:var(--muted)}
.fu-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:15px;margin-bottom:22px}.fu-metrics>div{padding:20px 22px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;border-top:4px solid #8999b0}.fu-metrics .late{border-top-color:#c83f48}.fu-metrics .today{border-top-color:#db9615}.fu-metrics .request{border-top-color:#356bcc}.fu-metrics strong{display:block;font-size:32px;line-height:1.6}.fu-metrics small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.fu-metrics span{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.fu-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:20px 0}.fu-tabs button{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink2);padding:10px 18px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;border-radius:24px;cursor:pointer}.fu-tabs button.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--surface);border-color:var(--ink)}

.fu-address{display:block;max-width:270px;white-space:normal;min-width:180px;text-align:left;line-height:1.7}.fu-pagination{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-top:22px}.fu-pagination button:disabled,.fu-detail button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.fu-error{background:#fff0f0;color:#a02330;border-radius:8px;padding:13px 16px}.fu-success{background:#e7f5ee;color:#106745;border-radius:8px;padding:13px 16px}
.fu-detail{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid #acc4e5;border-radius:16px;margin:22px 0;scroll-margin-top:20px}.fu-detail>header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:22px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}.fu-detail h2{margin:4px 0;font-size:24px}.fu-detail h2 span{font-size:17px;font-weight:500}.fu-detail small{color:var(--muted)}.fu-detail h3{font-size:16px;margin:20px 0 10px}.fu-detail-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 330px;gap:30px;padding:26px}.fu-detail-body>aside{border-left:1px solid var(--border);padding-left:26px}.fu-detail-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}.fu-detail-fields dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 5px}.fu-detail-fields dd{font-size:14px;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.fu-detail a,.fu-actions a{color:var(--s1);font-size:13px}.fu-actions{display:flex;gap:18px;margin:16px 0}.fu-pre,.fu-content,.fu-history p{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.8}.fu-content{font-size:14px;background:var(--plane);padding:18px;border-radius:10px;max-height:500px;overflow:auto}.fu-detail form{display:grid;gap:13px}.fu-detail textarea{min-height:100px;resize:vertical}.fu-history{list-style:none;padding:0}.fu-history li{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px}.fu-history small{display:block;font-size:11px}.fu-raw{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 20px}.fu-raw p{white-space:pre-wrap}.fu-access{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:15px}.fu-issued{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;max-width:700px;word-break:break-all}.fu-period-hidden{display:none!important}.fu-bell{font:inherit;font-size:12px;border:1px solid #b8cdf0;border-radius:20px;color:#2358a3;background:#eaf2ff;padding:5px 12px;margin-top:8px;cursor:pointer}

@media(max-width:700px){.fu-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.contract-filter-grid,.fu-filter-grid,.fu-detail-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}.contract-search{grid-column:auto}.fu-lock{padding:24px}.fu-detail-body{padding:18px}.contract-controls{padding:16px}}
@media print{.contract-controls,.fu-bell{display:none!important}}
.fu-role-tabs{display:flex;gap:12px;margin:0 0 24px}.fu-role-tabs button{flex:1;text-align:left;padding:19px 24px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font:inherit}.fu-role-tabs button.on{background:#235fc4;color:white;border-color:#235fc4;box-shadow:0 5px 15px #235fc422}.fu-role-tabs b{display:block;font-size:22px}.fu-role-tabs small{display:block;margin-top:6px;opacity:.8}.fu-role-tabs button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.fu-method{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid #356bcc;padding:17px 22px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.85}.fu-method summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}.fu-method p{color:var(--ink2)}.fu-badge.stale{background:#fff0f0;color:#ab2836}.fu-badge.unknown{background:#fff4d9;color:#8c5900}.fu-badge.recent{background:#e6f5ef;color:#10744e}.fu-metrics .recent{border-top-color:#16966e}.fu-evidence{text-align:left;min-width:155px}.fu-evidence small,.fu-evidence strong{display:block;margin-top:5px}.fu-evidence small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.fu-evidence strong{color:#ae3843}.fu-note-excerpt{display:block;min-width:210px;max-width:350px;white-space:normal;text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}.fu-empty{padding:30px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:700px){.fu-role-tabs button{padding:15px}.fu-role-tabs b{font-size:18px}}

/* Shared legibility scale for every dashboard view. */
:root{--f-body:18px;--f-tbl:18px;--f-th:16px;--f-axis:18px;--f-h2:22px;--f-sub:16px;--f-note:16px;--f-kpi-lab:17px;--f-kpi-sub:15px}
body{font-size:18px;line-height:1.65}
.main{max-width:none}
.main :is(.v10-panel h3,.perf-comment-head h3,.easy-lead h2){font-size:22px}
.perf-slide-head h2,#sectTitle{font-size:28px}
.main :is(.v10-note,.easy-lead p,.perf-slide-head p,#easySubtitle,.easy-period-note,.perf-region-guide,.v10-print-note,.perf-comment-head p,.perf-comment-columns label>span,.perf-comment-block-title>span){font-size:16px;line-height:1.65}
.main :is(.legend,.legend span,.tip,.tip .row,.easy-tag,.easy-preset,.btn,.btn.sm,.easy-subnav button,.easy-link,.easy-conditions label,.perf-staff-picker,.perf-band-summary){font-size:16px}
.main :is(input,select,textarea){font-size:17px}
.rail button.nav,.rail .btn{font-size:16px}
.main :is(.v10-goal-head,.v10-settings label,.v10-insight p,.easy-summary,.easy-secondary span,.contract-source,.contract-basis small,.contract-filter-grid label,.fu-filter-grid label,.fu-method,.fu-raw,.fu-detail-fields dt,.fu-history li,.fu-detail a,.fu-actions a,.fu-content,.fu-note-excerpt){font-size:16px}
.main :is(.fu-detail-fields dd,.fu-detail h3){font-size:18px}
.main :is(.fu-metrics small,.fu-badge,.fu-evidence small,.fu-history small){font-size:15px}
.main .fu-metrics span{font-size:18px}
.main :is(.v10-kpi .label,.perf-source-card h3){font-size:19px}
.main :is(.v10-kpi small,.perf-source-card>span,.perf-source-card p,.perf-source-card p b,.perf-source-card strong small){font-size:15px}
.main :is(.v10-kpi strong,.perf-source-card strong){font-size:36px}
.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) table{font-size:18px;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) :is(th,td){text-align:center!important;vertical-align:middle;padding:14px 10px;line-height:1.5}
.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) th{font-size:16px;white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all}
.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) td{font-size:18px}
.perf-slide :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) table{table-layout:fixed;min-width:680px}
.perf-source-table table{min-width:1050px!important}
.perf-source-table th:first-child:not([colspan]){width:9%}
.perf-source-table thead tr:first-child th[colspan]{font-size:22px}
.perf-values-always table{min-width:860px!important}
.perf-values-always th:first-child,.perf-values-always td:first-child{width:150px;white-space:normal}
.perf-capacity-table table{min-width:1400px!important}
.perf-staff-table table{min-width:1120px!important}
.main .perf-staff-table td b,.perf-band-rank b{font-size:20px}
.main .perf-staff-table td small{font-size:15px;white-space:normal}
.main .perf-staff-table .perf-person-head{font-size:24px}
.main .perf-staff-month-total td b{font-size:28px}
.perf-staff-month-total td span,.perf-rank small,.perf-band-rank small{font-size:13px}
.perf-rank{justify-content:center}
.perf-week-table th:first-child{width:21%}.perf-week-table th:nth-child(2){width:12%}.perf-week-table th:nth-child(5){width:23%}
.perf-contract-table{align-self:center}.perf-contract-table table{min-width:560px!important}
.perf-contract-table>.v10-note{text-align:center}
.perf-source-charts{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.chartbox{overflow-x:auto}.chartbox svg.chart{min-width:600px;max-height:460px}
.main svg.chart text,.main svg.chart text.val{font-size:var(--chart-readable-font,18px)!important}
.main .legend{gap:18px;margin-top:14px}
.main .perf-comment-editor textarea{font-size:19px}
.perf-inquiry-metrics h4{font-size:19px}.perf-inquiry-metrics dt,.perf-inquiry-metrics dd{font-size:17px}
.perf-inquiry-metrics dl>div{gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.perf-inquiry-metrics dd{margin-left:auto}
.perf-value-highlight{display:inline;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:#fff0ad;color:inherit;font-weight:750;box-decoration-break:clone;print-color-adjust:exact}
@media(max-width:1450px){.perf-two{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.perf-inquiry-metrics{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:800px){.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) :is(th,td){padding:12px 8px}.v10-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.perf-slide-head h2{font-size:24px}}
@media print{.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) table{min-width:0!important;table-layout:auto;font-size:12px}.main :is(.v10-table,.tblwrap) :is(th,td){font-size:12px;padding:7px 4px}.chartbox{overflow:visible}.chartbox svg.chart{min-width:0;max-height:none}.perf-source-charts,.perf-two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.main .perf-staff-table td small{font-size:11px}.perf-selected-month,.perf-selected-month-row>td{print-color-adjust:exact}}

.sales-period-picker {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #9fb9dc;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7faff 0%, #edf4ff 100%);
}
.sales-period-picker-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.sales-period-picker-head p { margin: 0 0 3px; color: #2769c7; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; }
.sales-period-picker-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; }
.sales-period-picker-head label {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 360px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
}
.sales-period-picker-head select {
  min-height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #88a8d3;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  background: var(--card);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 700 15px/1.4 inherit;
}
.sales-period-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) minmax(220px, .8fr); gap: 10px; }
.sales-period-cards article,
.sales-period-status { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid #c7d4e5; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--card); }
.sales-period-cards article span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.sales-period-cards article b { font-size: 18px; }
.sales-period-cards article strong { color: #1e5fae; font-size: 16px; }
.sales-period-cards article small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.sales-period-status { align-content: center; }
.sales-period-status b { font-size: 16px; }
.sales-period-status span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; }
.sales-period-status.is-match { border-color: #9bd5b4; background: #effbf4; color: #17683c; }
.sales-period-status.is-warning { border-color: #edc37b; background: #fff8e8; color: #8a5700; }
.sales-minutes-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, .6fr) minmax(300px, 1.4fr) minmax(300px, 1.5fr);
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--soft);
}
.sales-minutes-controls label {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
}
.sales-minutes-controls input,
.sales-minutes-controls textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  background: var(--card);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 500 16px/1.45 inherit;
  resize: vertical;
}
.sales-actions-field textarea { min-height: 70px; }
.sales-minutes-report {
  max-width: 1040px;
  margin: 20px auto 26px;
  padding: 22px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #111;
  border: 1px solid #9ca8b8;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(25, 46, 75, .08);
}
.minutes-report-title { margin: 0 0 9px; font-size: 22px; color: #111; }
.minutes-report-title span { margin-right: 2px; font-size: 16px; }
.minutes-report-box { border: 1.5px solid #111; padding: 0 10px 12px; }
.minutes-box-title {
  margin: 0 -10px 9px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted #555;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 900;
}
.minutes-period-basis {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 2px 10px;
  margin: 7px 0 9px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  border: 1px solid #8da5c5;
  background: #eef5ff;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.minutes-period-basis b { white-space: nowrap; }
.minutes-period-warning { margin: 5px 0; color: #b52b1d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
.sales-minutes-report h3 { margin: 13px 0 6px; font-size: 17px; color: #111; }
.sales-minutes-report h3 span { font-size: 15px; }
.minutes-table-wrap { width: 100%; overflow: auto; }
.sales-minutes-report table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.sales-minutes-report th,
.sales-minutes-report td {
  border: 1px solid #111;
  padding: 5px 6px;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
  color: #111;
}
.minutes-source-gs { background: #cdddf4 !important; }
.minutes-source-sp { background: #d9a3dc !important; }
.minutes-source-ugs { background: #fff0bd !important; }
.minutes-source-ref { background: #f5dcc4 !important; }
.minutes-source-sum { background: #d6e8d1 !important; }
.minutes-row-total th { background: #00ef21 !important; font-weight: 700; }
.minutes-row-business th { background: #fff200 !important; font-weight: 700; }
.minutes-row-business td,
.minutes-count { color: #d7191c !important; font-weight: 900; }
.minutes-top-table th:first-child { width: 62px; }
.minutes-top-table td:nth-child(even) { text-align: left; }
.minutes-extra { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.minutes-meeting-list {
  margin: 2px 0 12px;
  padding-left: 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.minutes-meeting-list li { padding: 2px 0; }
.minutes-meeting-list strong { display: block; color: #d7191c; font-weight: 900; }
.minutes-summary {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 10px 10px 4px 26px;
  border-top: 1px solid #111;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.minutes-actions {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px dashed #7a8798;
  background: #f7f9fc;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sales-source-details { margin-top: 18px; }
.sales-source-details > summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--card);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 800;
}
.sales-source-details[open] > summary { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.sales-source-details .sales-copy-root { margin-top: 14px; }
@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  .sales-period-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .sales-period-status { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .sales-minutes-controls { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .sales-actions-field { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .sales-period-picker-head { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .sales-period-picker-head label { min-width: 0; }
  .sales-period-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sales-period-status { grid-column: auto; }
  .sales-minutes-controls { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sales-actions-field { grid-column: auto; }
  .sales-minutes-report { padding: 12px; }
  .sales-minutes-report table { min-width: 720px; }
  .minutes-report-title { font-size: 20px; }
  .minutes-report-box { padding: 0 7px 9px; }
  .minutes-box-title { margin: 0 -7px 7px; }
  .sales-minutes-report h3 { font-size: 16px; }
}

/* Shared navigation sits above each independent business dashboard. */
:root{--business-header-height:88px}
.business-header{height:var(--business-header-height);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:70;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 2px 12px #12253f05;padding-right:32px}
.business-brand{width:220px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding-left:24px;color:var(--ink)}
.business-brand-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:11px;background:#2364d2;color:#fff;font-size:20px;font-weight:750}
.business-brand small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.5}
.business-brand strong{display:block;font-size:19px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.business-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.business-tabs button{appearance:none;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--ink2);font:inherit;font-size:19px;font-weight:650;min-width:108px;min-height:48px;padding:9px 24px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.business-tabs button:hover{background:var(--plane);color:var(--ink)}
.business-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{background:#2364d2;color:white;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #2364d21a}
.business-tabs button:focus-visible,.business-return:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #78a6ee;outline-offset:3px}
.business-wordmark{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.business-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.business-panel.shell{min-height:calc(100vh - var(--business-header-height))}
.business-panel .rail{top:var(--business-header-height);height:calc(100vh - var(--business-header-height))}
.business-placeholder{min-height:calc(100vh - var(--business-header-height));padding:64px 24px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--plane)}
.business-empty{width:min(100%,760px);padding:72px 32px;text-align:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #12253f05}
.business-status{display:inline-block;background:var(--plane);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--ink2);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.business-empty h1{font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ink);margin:22px 0 14px}
.business-empty p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 32px;word-break:keep-all}
.business-return{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 20px;font:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:650;background:var(--surface);color:var(--s1);cursor:pointer}
.business-return:hover{background:var(--plane)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.business-wordmark{display:none}.business-header{gap:20px;padding-right:20px}.business-tabs button{min-width:88px;padding-inline:20px}}
@media(max-width:650px){:root{--business-header-height:132px}.business-header{height:var(--business-header-height);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:10px;padding:12px 16px}.business-brand{width:auto;padding:0;gap:10px}.business-brand-mark{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:16px;border-radius:8px}.business-brand small{font-size:11px}.business-brand strong{font-size:16px}.business-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.business-tabs button{min-width:0;min-height:44px;font-size:17px;padding:8px 4px}.business-placeholder{padding:24px 16px}.business-empty{padding:48px 16px}.business-empty h1{font-size:29px}.business-empty p{font-size:16px}.business-return{font-size:14px;gap:12px}}
@media print{.business-header{display:none!important}.business-panel.shell{min-height:0}.business-panel .rail{top:0}}

.cw-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.cw-controls label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:16px}.cw-controls select{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
.cw-controls strong{margin-left:auto;font-size:22px}.cw-periods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}.cw-periods>div{padding:18px 22px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid #2364d2;background:var(--surface)}.cw-periods>div+div{border-left-color:#8b5ac4}.cw-periods span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:5px}.cw-periods b{font-size:24px}.cw-panels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:18px}.cw-panels>section{min-width:0}.cw-selected{font-weight:800;background:#eaf2ff;border-radius:5px;padding:4px 8px}.cw-open{color:#1854b1;border-color:#adc9ee}
.cw-weekly #periodbar .easy-preset:not(.cw-open),.cw-weekly #easyMonth,.cw-weekly #easyFilterToggle,.cw-weekly #easyConditions,.cw-weekly #easyCustom,.cw-weekly #basisNote{display:none!important}.cw-weekly .cw-open{background:#2364d2;color:#fff}.cw-weekly .foot>div:first-child{display:none}
@media(max-width:1000px){.cw-panels{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:600px){.cw-periods{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cw-controls strong{width:100%;margin:0}}

<body>
<header class="business-header">
<div class="business-brand"><span class="business-brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">G</span><div><small>에너지사업부</small><strong>통합 대시보드</strong></div></div>
<nav class="business-tabs" id="businessTabs" role="tablist" aria-label="사업 파트 선택">
<button type="button" id="part-tab-consulting" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="part-panel-consulting" data-business-part="consulting">컨설팅</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-field" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-field" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="field">필드</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-outsourcing" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-outsourcing" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="outsourcing">외주</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-bidding" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-bidding" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="bidding">입찰</button>
</nav>
<span class="business-wordmark">GRANDSUN</span>
</header>
<div class="shell business-panel" id="part-panel-consulting" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="part-tab-consulting">
<aside class="rail" id="rail">
<div class="brand">
<div class="brand-mark">G</div>
<div><b>컨설팅 성과<br>대시보드</b><small>GRANDSUN</small></div>
</div>
<div id="nav"></div>
<div class="railfoot">
<button class="btn sm" id="refreshBtn">새로고침</button>
<button class="btn sm" id="syncToggle">데이터 연결</button>
<button class="btn sm" id="themeBtn">다크</button>
</div>
</aside>
<main class="main">
<div class="topbar">
<button class="btn railtoggle" id="railBtn">☰</button>
<h1 id="sectTitle">전체 실적</h1>
<div class="spacer"></div>
<span class="chip" id="statusChip"><span class="dot"></span><span id="statusTxt">내장 데이터</span></span>
</div>
<section class="sync hide" id="syncPanel">
<h3>구글 시트 연결</h3>
<p>Apps Script 웹앱 주소로 열면 <b>열 때마다 시트를 새로 읽습니다.</b></p>
<div class="field"><span><b>연결 주소 (Apps Script 웹앱)</b></span>
<input type="url" id="urlScript" placeholder="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycb...../exec">
<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)">문제가 있으면
<a id="openScript" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--s1)">이 주소를 브라우저에서 직접 열어</a>
보세요.</span></div>
<div class="field"><span>통계 시트 CSV 주소 (예비)</span>
<input type="url" id="urlTongye" placeholder="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-.../pub?...output=csv"></div>
<div class="field"><span>말 시트 CSV 주소 (예비)</span>
<input type="url" id="urlMal" placeholder="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-.../pub?...output=csv"></div>
<div class="actions">
<button class="btn primary" id="connectBtn">연결하고 불러오기</button>
<button class="btn" id="clearBtn">기본값으로</button>
<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)">
<input type="checkbox" id="autoChk" checked> 열 때마다 자동으로 불러오기</label>
</div>
<div class="msg" id="syncMsg"></div>
<div class="sched">
<div class="sched-row">
<label><input type="checkbox" id="dailyChk" checked> <b>매일 지정 시각에 자동 갱신</b></label>
<input type="time" id="dailyTime" value="14:40" step="60">
</div>
<div class="sched-row">
<label><input type="checkbox" id="everyChk"> 열려 있는 동안 주기적으로 갱신</label>
<span><input type="number" id="everyMin" value="30" min="5" max="720" step="5"> 분마다</span>
</div>
<p id="nextRun" class="next-run"></p>
</div>
<div class="drop" id="dropZone">또는 <b>상담일지 엑셀(.xlsx)</b>을 여기로 끌어다 놓으세요 · 클릭해서 선택
<input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.csv" class="hide"></div>
</section>
<section class="periodbar" id="periodbar">
<div class="prow">
<span class="plabel">기간</span>
<div class="seg" id="pmode">
<button data-mode="all">전체</button>
<button data-mode="quarter">분기</button>
<button data-mode="month">월</button>
<button data-mode="cumulative">누적</button>
<button data-mode="year">년도</button>
</div>
<div class="pills" id="ppills"></div>
<div class="spacer" style="flex:1"></div>
<span class="psum" id="psum"></span>
</div>
<div class="prow">
<span class="plabel" id="pbasisLab">기준</span>
<div class="seg" id="pbasis">
<button data-basis="cohort">문의 온 달</button>
<button data-basis="exec">미팅 간 달</button>
</div>
<div class="filters" style="flex:1">
<label>담당자<select id="fOwner"></select></label>
<label>사업형태<select id="fType"></select></label>
<label>유입<select id="fSrc"></select></label>
<label>법인<select id="fCorp"></select></label>
<label class="grow">검색<input type="search" id="fQuery" placeholder="상담번호 · 지역 · 담당자 · 사업형태"></label>
</div>
<button class="btn sm" id="resetBtn">초기화</button>
</div>
</section>
<p class="basis-note" id="basisNote"></p>
<div id="view"></div>
<footer class="foot">
<div><b>문의 온 달</b> — 상담번호 앞 두 자리(문의가 들어온 달)로 묶습니다. 8월에 온 문의는 미팅을 9·10·11월에 가도 <b>8월 실적</b>으로 남습니다. 매월 보고서가 쓰는 기준입니다.</div>
<div><b>미팅 간 달</b> — 미팅날짜가 속한 달로 묶습니다. 8월에 다녀온 미팅이면 문의가 1·2·3월에 왔더라도 <b>8월</b>에 셉니다. 그 달에 실제로 얼마나 움직였는지 볼 때 씁니다.</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>전체 문의</b>는 말 시트 <code>A:H</code>(발전사업·O&amp;M·정부사업 등 총칭),
<b>발전사업 문의·미팅·계약</b>은 통계 시트 <code>BO:CH</code>(21개 사업형태 × 그랜드썬·SP·유지에스·소개),
<b>미팅 간 달</b>은 말 시트 <code>AY:BK</code>, <b>권역별</b>은 통계 시트 <code>CU:IJ</code>,
<b>용량·담당자·원장</b>은 통계 시트 미팅 원장 <code>C5:N</code>을 씁니다.</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>목표</b> — 전체 문의 월 1,500건 · 발전사업 문의 월 787건(마케팅 700 + 소개 87) ·
미팅 월 72건(주 17건) · 계약 용량 연 150MW(월 목표는 말 시트 <code>CE</code>열).</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px">계약 건수는 통계 BO:CH 기준입니다. 미팅 원장 기준은 미팅을 거쳐 맺은 계약만이라 조금 적습니다.</div>
<div id="footStamp" style="margin-top:8px"></div>
</footer>
</main>
</div>
<section class="business-panel business-placeholder" id="part-panel-field" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="part-tab-field" tabindex="0" hidden>

</section>

<div class="business-empty"><span class="business-status">준비 중</span><h1>외주 대시보드</h1><p>외주 업무에 맞는 데이터와 화면을<br>추후 이곳에 구성할 예정입니다.</p><button type="button" class="business-return" data-business-return>컨설팅 대시보드로 돌아가기 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button></div>
</section>

<div class="business-empty"><span class="business-status">준비 중</span><h1>입찰 대시보드</h1><p>입찰 업무에 맞는 데이터와 화면을<br>추후 이곳에 구성할 예정입니다.</p><button type="button" class="business-return" data-business-return>컨설팅 대시보드로 돌아가기 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button></div>
</section>
<script>
window.__INLINE_DATA__ = <?!= DATA ?>;
const EMBEDDED = null;
</script>
<script>
"use strict";
const store = {
get(k, d){ try{ const v = localStorage.getItem('gs_dash_'+k); return v===null?d:JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return d;} },
set(k, v){ try{ localStorage.setItem('gs_dash_'+k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} },
del(k){ try{ localStorage.removeItem('gs_dash_'+k); }catch(e){} }
};
const NF = new Intl.NumberFormat('ko-KR');
const NF1 = new Intl.NumberFormat('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
const NF2 = new Intl.NumberFormat('ko-KR',{minimumFractionDigits:1,maximumFractionDigits:1});
const i = n => NF.format(Math.round(n||0));
const d1 = n => NF1.format(n||0);
const pct = (a,b) => b ? (a/b*100) : 0;
const pctS = (a,b) => d1(pct(a,b))+'%';
function capS(kw){
kw = kw||0;
return kw>=10000 ? NF2.format(kw/1000)+' MW' : NF1.format(kw)+' kW';
}
function num(v){
if(v===null||v===undefined) return 0;
if(typeof v==='number') return v;
const hit=String(v).match(/-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?/);
const n=hit?parseFloat(hit[0].replace(/,/g,'')):NaN;
return isNaN(n)?0:n;
}
function txt(v){ return v===null||v===undefined ? '' : String(v).trim(); }
const esc = s => String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const REGIONS = ['수도권','충청권','강원권','영남권','호남권','제주','기타'];
function regionOf(raw){
const t = txt(raw).replace(/^[0-9]+[.\s]*/,'');
if(!t) return '미분류';
if(/서울|경기|인천/.test(t)) return '수도권';
if(/충남|충북|충청|대전|세종/.test(t)) return '충청권';
if(/강원/.test(t)) return '강원권';
if(/부산|대구|울산|경북|경남|경상/.test(t)) return '영남권';
if(/광주|전북|전남|전라/.test(t)) return '호남권';
if(/제주/.test(t)) return '제주';
return '기타';
}
function typeGroup(t){
t = txt(t);
if(!t) return '미분류';
const m = t.match(/^([^(]+)/);
return m ? m[1].trim() : t;
}
const isContract = r => /계약/.test(r.ct) && !/미계약|계약\s*(취소|예정|검토)|계약\s*전/.test(r.ct);
function parseCSV(text){
const rows=[]; let row=[], cell='', q=false;
text = text.replace(/^﻿/,'');
for(let p=0;p<text.length;p++){
const c=text[p];
if(q){
if(c==='"'){ if(text[p+1]==='"'){cell+='"';p++;} else q=false; }
else cell+=c;
} else {
if(c==='"') q=true;
else if(c===','){ row.push(cell); cell=''; }
else if(c==='\n'){ row.push(cell); rows.push(row); row=[]; cell=''; }
else if(c==='\r'){}
else cell+=c;
}
}
if(cell!==''||row.length){ row.push(cell); rows.push(row); }
return rows;
}
const at = (rows,r,c) => (rows[r] && rows[r][c]!==undefined) ? rows[r][c] : '';
function parseCapN(v){
const t=txt(v);
if(!t) return {cap:0,n:0};
const mc=t.match(/([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*kW/i);
const mn=t.match(/([\d,]+)\s*건/);
return { cap: mc?num(mc[1]):0, n: mn?num(mn[1]):0 };
}
function parseTongye(rows){
const out=[];
for(let r=4; r<rows.length; r++){
const no = txt(at(rows,r,3));
if(!no) continue;
const dt = txt(at(rows,r,4));
const m = dt.match(/(\d{4})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})/);
const cm = no.match(/^(?:(?:sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-/i);
const cmo = cm ? parseInt(cm[1],10) : 0;
out.push({
no, seq: num(at(rows,r,2)),
date: m ? `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}` : '',
em: m ? parseInt(m[2],10) : 0,
cmo: (cmo>=1&&cmo<=12) ? cmo : 0,
src: txt(at(rows,r,5)),
ct:  txt(at(rows,r,6)),
cap: num(at(rows,r,7)),
corp:txt(at(rows,r,8)),
type:txt(at(rows,r,9)),
prop:txt(at(rows,r,10)),
cons:txt(at(rows,r,11)),
own: txt(at(rows,r,12)) || '미지정',
reg: txt(at(rows,r,13))
});
}
return out;
}
function parseMal(rows){
const months=[];
for(let m=1;m<=12;m++){
const b = 3 + (m-1)*47 - 1;              // 0-based 시작행
const weeks=[];
for(let k=2;k<=6;k++){
const wk = txt(at(rows,b+k,3));
if(!wk || wk==='합계') continue;
weeks.push({ label:txt(at(rows,b+k,2)), wk,
total:num(at(rows,b+k,4)), gs:num(at(rows,b+k,5)),
sp:num(at(rows,b+k,6)), ug:num(at(rows,b+k,7)) });
}
const t=b+7;
const inq={ total:num(at(rows,t,4)), gs:num(at(rows,t,5)), sp:num(at(rows,t,6)), ug:num(at(rows,t,7)) };
const bt=[];
for(let r=b+3;r<=b+24;r++){
const nm=txt(at(rows,r,9));
if(!nm||nm==='합계') continue;
bt.push({ name:nm,
iq:{gs:num(at(rows,r,10)),sp:num(at(rows,r,11)),ug:num(at(rows,r,12)),ref:num(at(rows,r,13)),tot:num(at(rows,r,14))},
mt:{tot:num(at(rows,r,20))}, ctr:{tot:num(at(rows,r,26))} });
}
const C=(r,c)=>at(rows,r,c);
const wmeet=[];
for(let k=2;k<=6;k++){
const wl=txt(C(b+k,51));
if(!wl || wl==='합계') continue;
wmeet.push({label:txt(C(b+k,50)), wk:wl,
cap:num(C(b+k,52)), n:num(C(b+k,53)),
mkCap:num(C(b+k,54)), mkN:num(C(b+k,55)),
refCap:num(C(b+k,56)), refN:num(C(b+k,57))});
}
const mtTot={cap:num(C(b+7,52)), n:num(C(b+7,53)),
mkCap:num(C(b+7,54)), mkN:num(C(b+7,55)),
refCap:num(C(b+7,56)), refN:num(C(b+7,57))};
const corpMt={gsCap:num(C(b+14,52)), gsN:num(C(b+14,53)),
spCap:num(C(b+14,54)), spN:num(C(b+14,55)),
ugCap:num(C(b+14,56)), ugN:num(C(b+14,57)),
mkCtr:num(C(b+14,59)), refCtr:num(C(b+14,60)), totCtr:num(C(b+14,61))};
const buckets=[];
for(let c=51;c<=58;c++){
const lab=txt(C(b+16,c));
if(!lab) continue;
buckets.push({label:lab, n:num(C(b+17,c))});
}
const bkTot=num(C(b+17,59)), bkAvg=num(C(b+17,60));
const ownWk=[];
for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
const nm=txt(C(b+19,52+k*2));
if(!nm) continue;
ownWk.push({name:nm,
mk:parseCapN(C(b+26,52+k*2)),
ref:parseCapN(C(b+26,53+k*2))});
}
months.push({m,weeks,inq,bt,wmeet,mtTot,corpMt,buckets,bkTot,bkAvg,ownWk});
}
const msum=[];
for(let r=3;r<20;r++){
const mv=num(at(rows,r,70));
if(!(mv>=1&&mv<=12)) continue;
msum.push({ m:mv,
inqTot:num(at(rows,r,71)), gs:num(at(rows,r,72)), sp:num(at(rows,r,73)), ug:num(at(rows,r,74)),
mkInq:num(at(rows,r,75)), refInq:num(at(rows,r,76)),
mkPwrInq:num(at(rows,r,77)), refPwrInq:num(at(rows,r,78)),
mkMt:num(at(rows,r,79)), refMt:num(at(rows,r,80)), ctr:num(at(rows,r,81)),
goalCtr:num(at(rows,r,82)), goalDirect:num(at(rows,r,83)), goalMt:num(at(rows,r,84)),
achv:txt(at(rows,r,85)),
mtCap:num(at(rows,r,86)), mtN:num(at(rows,r,87)), avgCap:num(at(rows,r,88)),
achvCap:txt(at(rows,r,89)) });
const last=msum[msum.length-1];
const p=parseFloat(String(last.achvCap).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''));
last.goalMtN = (p>0 && last.mtN>0) ? Math.round(last.mtN/(p/100)) : 100;
}
const years=[];
for(let r=2;r<24;r++){
const y=num(at(rows,r,63));
if(y>=2000&&y<=2100) years.push({y, inq:num(at(rows,r,64))});
}
const curSum = msum.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.inqTot,0);
if(curSum>0){
const lastY = years.length? Math.max(...years.map(x=>x.y)) : 0;
years.push({y:lastY+1, inq:curSum, partial:true});
}
const ytdBt=[];
let ytdTot=null;
for(let r=4;r<32;r++){
const nm=txt(at(rows,r,30));
if(!nm) continue;
const rec={name:nm, iq:num(at(rows,r,31)), mt:num(at(rows,r,33)), ctr:num(at(rows,r,35))};
if(nm==='합계') ytdTot=rec; else ytdBt.push(rec);
}
return {months,msum,years,ytdBt,ytdTot};
}
let DB = null;
const state = {
sect:'overall',
basis:'cohort',                 /* cohort=문의월 · exec=미팅월 */
mode:'all',                     /* all | year | quarter | month | cumulative */
quarters:[],                    /* 선택 분기 [1..4] */
months:[],                      /* 선택 월 [1..12] */
owner:'전체', cons:'전체', type:'전체', src:'전체', corp:'전체', query:'',
kpiOpen:null                    /* 펼쳐 놓은 KPI 카드 */
};
const SECTIONS = [
{k:'overall',    t:'전체',                g:'실적',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'inquiry',    t:'문의',                g:'실적',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'meetCoh',    t:'미팅 · 문의 온 달',   g:'실적',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'meetExe',    t:'미팅 · 미팅 간 달',   g:'실적',   basis:'exec'},
{k:'contract',   t:'계약',                g:'실적',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'source',     t:'유입별',              g:'분석',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'region',     t:'지역별',              g:'분석',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'goal',       t:'목표 달성',           g:'분석',   basis:'cohort'},
{k:'capacity',   t:'용량 분석',           g:'분석',   basis:'both'},
{k:'owner',      t:'담당자 실적',         g:'분석',   basis:'both'},
{k:'insight',    t:'종합 분석',           g:'리포트', basis:'cohort'},
{k:'records',    t:'미팅 원장',           g:'리포트', basis:'both'}
];
const sectOf = k => SECTIONS.find(x=>x.k===k) || SECTIONS[0];
const QMONTHS = {1:[1,2,3], 2:[4,5,6], 3:[7,8,9], 4:[10,11,12]};
const qOf = m => Math.floor((m-1)/3)+1;
const mOf = r => state.basis==='cohort' ? r.cmo : r.em;
function dataMonths(){
const s=new Set();
if(!DB) return [1];
(DB.ledger||[]).forEach(r=>{ const m=mOf(r); if(m>=1&&m<=12) s.add(m); });
if(DB.sum) DB.sum.months.forEach(x=>{ if(x.inq>0||x.mt>0) s.add(x.m); });
const arr=[...s].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
return arr.length?arr:[1];
}
const activeMonths = dataMonths;      /* 하위 호환 */
const lastDataMonth = () => dataMonths().slice(-1)[0];
function selMonths(){
const all=dataMonths();
if(state.mode==='quarter'){
if(!state.quarters.length) return all;
const s=new Set();
state.quarters.forEach(q=>QMONTHS[q].forEach(m=>{ if(all.includes(m)) s.add(m); }));
return [...s].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
if(state.mode==='month'){
if(!state.months.length) return all;
return state.months.filter(m=>all.includes(m)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
if(state.mode==='cumulative'){
const end = state.months.length ? Math.max(...state.months) : all[all.length-1];
return all.filter(m=>m<=end);
}
return all;
}
function compareGroups(){
const all=dataMonths();
if(state.mode==='quarter'){
const qs = state.quarters.length ? state.quarters.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b)
: [...new Set(all.map(qOf))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
return qs.map(q=>({key:'Q'+q, label:q+'분기',
months:QMONTHS[q].filter(m=>all.includes(m))})).filter(g=>g.months.length);
}
if(state.mode==='month'){
const ms = state.months.length ? state.months.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b) : all;
return ms.filter(m=>all.includes(m)).map(m=>({key:'M'+m, label:m+'월', months:[m]}));
}
if(state.mode==='cumulative'){
const ms=selMonths();
return ms.map((m,ix)=>({key:'C'+m, label:'~'+m+'월', months:ms.slice(0,ix+1)}));
}
if(state.mode==='year'){
return [{key:'Y', label:(DB.year||'')+'년', months:all}];
}
const qs=[...new Set(all.map(qOf))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
return qs.map(q=>({key:'Q'+q, label:q+'분기',
months:QMONTHS[q].filter(m=>all.includes(m))})).filter(g=>g.months.length);
}
function periodLabel(){
const ms=selMonths();
if(!ms.length) return '기간 없음';
if(state.mode==='quarter' && state.quarters.length)
return state.quarters.slice().sort().map(q=>q+'분기').join(' · ');
if(state.mode==='month' && state.months.length)
return state.months.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b).map(m=>m+'월').join(' · ');
if(state.mode==='cumulative') return `1~${ms[ms.length-1]}월 누적`;
if(state.mode==='year') return `${DB.year||''}년 전체`;
return `${ms[0]}~${ms[ms.length-1]}월 전체`;
}
function dimOK(r){
if(state.owner!=='전체' && r.own!==state.owner) return false;
if(state.cons!=='전체' && (txt(r.cons)||'미지정')!==state.cons) return false;
if(state.type!=='전체' && txt(r.type)!==state.type) return false;
if(state.src!=='전체' && r.src!==state.src) return false;
if(state.corp!=='전체' && r.corp!==state.corp) return false;
return true;
}
function rowsSel(){
const ms=selMonths();
return DB.ledger.filter(r=>dimOK(r) && ms.includes(mOf(r)));
}
function rowsIn(months){
return DB.ledger.filter(r=>dimOK(r) && months.includes(mOf(r)));
}
function rowsAll(){ return DB.ledger.filter(dimOK); }
function rowsFiltered(opts){ return (opts&&opts.allMonths) ? rowsAll() : rowsSel(); }
function sumRows(rows){
const o={n:rows.length,cap:0,ctr:0,ctrCap:0,mk:0,ref:0,mkCap:0,refCap:0,
mkCtr:0,refCtr:0,mkCtrCap:0,refCtrCap:0};
rows.forEach(r=>{
o.cap+=r.cap;
const isMk = r.src==='마케팅';
if(isMk){ o.mk++; o.mkCap+=r.cap; } else if(r.src==='소개'){ o.ref++; o.refCap+=r.cap; }
if(isContract(r)){
o.ctr++; o.ctrCap+=r.cap;
if(isMk){ o.mkCtr++; o.mkCtrCap+=r.cap; } else if(r.src==='소개'){ o.refCtr++; o.refCtrCap+=r.cap; }
}
});
o.avg = o.n ? o.cap/o.n : 0;
o.ctrAvg = o.ctr ? o.ctrCap/o.ctr : 0;
return o;
}
function byMonth(rows){
const out={};
for(let m=1;m<=12;m++) out[m]={m,n:0,cap:0,ctr:0,ctrCap:0,mk:0,ref:0,mkCtr:0,refCtr:0,mkCap:0,refCap:0};
rows.forEach(r=>{
const m=mOf(r); if(!(m>=1&&m<=12)) return;
const o=out[m]; o.n++; o.cap+=r.cap;
if(r.src==='마케팅'){ o.mk++; o.mkCap+=r.cap; }
else if(r.src==='소개'){ o.ref++; o.refCap+=r.cap; }
if(isContract(r)){ o.ctr++; o.ctrCap+=r.cap;
if(r.src==='마케팅') o.mkCtr++; else if(r.src==='소개') o.refCtr++; }
});
return out;
}
const CAP_BANDS = [
{label:'50kW 미만',      lo:0,    hi:50},
{label:'100kW 미만',     lo:50,   hi:100},
{label:'300kW 미만',     lo:100,  hi:300},
{label:'500kW 미만',     lo:300,  hi:500},
{label:'1,000kW 미만',   lo:500,  hi:1000},
{label:'1,500kW 미만',   lo:1000, hi:1500},
{label:'2,000kW 미만',   lo:1500, hi:2000},
{label:'2,000kW 이상',   lo:2000, hi:Infinity}
];
function capBands(rows){
return CAP_BANDS.map(b=>{
const rs=rows.filter(r=>r.cap>=b.lo && r.cap<b.hi);
const cs=rs.filter(isContract);
return {label:b.label, n:rs.length, cap:rs.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.cap,0),
ctr:cs.length, ctrCap:cs.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.cap,0)};
});
}
function inqFor(months){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const pick=(DB.msum||[]).filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m));
const o={total:0,gs:0,sp:0,ug:0,mk:0,ref:0,mkPwr:0,refPwr:0,
goalCtr:0,goalDirect:0,goalMt:0,goalMtN:0,mtCap:0,mtN:0};
pick.forEach(x=>{ o.total+=x.inqTot; o.gs+=x.gs; o.sp+=x.sp; o.ug+=x.ug;
o.mk+=x.mkInq; o.ref+=x.refInq; o.mkPwr+=x.mkPwrInq; o.refPwr+=x.refPwrInq;
o.goalCtr+=x.goalCtr; o.goalDirect+=x.goalDirect; o.goalMt+=x.goalMt;
o.goalMtN+=(x.goalMtN||100); o.mtCap+=x.mtCap; o.mtN+=x.mtN; });
o.pwr = o.mkPwr + o.refPwr;
return o;
}
function malMeetFor(months){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const pick=(DB.months||[]).filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m));
const o={cap:0,n:0,mkCap:0,mkN:0,refCap:0,refN:0,
gsCap:0,gsN:0,spCap:0,spN:0,ugCap:0,ugN:0,mkCtr:0,refCtr:0,totCtr:0};
pick.forEach(x=>{
const t=x.mtTot||{}, c=x.corpMt||{};
o.cap+=t.cap||0; o.n+=t.n||0; o.mkCap+=t.mkCap||0; o.mkN+=t.mkN||0;
o.refCap+=t.refCap||0; o.refN+=t.refN||0;
o.gsCap+=c.gsCap||0; o.gsN+=c.gsN||0; o.spCap+=c.spCap||0; o.spN+=c.spN||0;
o.ugCap+=c.ugCap||0; o.ugN+=c.ugN||0;
o.mkCtr+=c.mkCtr||0; o.refCtr+=c.refCtr||0; o.totCtr+=c.totCtr||0;
});
return o;
}
function malOwnersFor(months){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const map=new Map();
(DB.months||[]).filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m)).forEach(x=>{
(x.ownWk||[]).forEach(o=>{
const cur=map.get(o.name)||{name:o.name,mkCap:0,mkN:0,refCap:0,refN:0};
cur.mkCap+=o.mk.cap; cur.mkN+=o.mk.n;
cur.refCap+=o.ref.cap; cur.refN+=o.ref.n;
map.set(o.name,cur);
});
});
return [...map.values()].map(o=>({...o, cap:o.mkCap+o.refCap, n:o.mkN+o.refN}))
.sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n);
}
const inquiryUsable = () =>
state.owner==='전체' && state.cons==='전체' && state.type==='전체' &&
state.corp==='전체' && state.src==='전체' && !state.query;
const sheetSplitBlocked = () =>
state.owner!=='전체' || state.cons!=='전체' || !!state.query;
function dominantYear(ledger){
const c={};
ledger.forEach(r=>{ const y=r.date.slice(0,4); if(/^\d{4}$/.test(y)) c[y]=(c[y]||0)+1; });
let best='', n=-1;
Object.keys(c).forEach(y=>{ if(c[y]>n){ n=c[y]; best=y; } });
return best;
}
function oddYearRows(ledger, year){
return ledger.filter(r=>r.date && r.date.slice(0,4)!==year);
}
function parseTongyeSummary(rows){
const LAB = 27;                    /* AB열 */
const YEAR = 28;                   /* AC열 = 연간 합계 */
const M0 = 29;                     /* AD열 = 01월 */
let head = -1;
for(let r=150; r<Math.min(rows.length, 400); r++){
if(/01\s*월/.test(txt(at(rows,r,M0))) && /전체/.test(txt(at(rows,r,YEAR)))){ head=r; break; }
}
if(head<0) return null;
const want = [
['inq',   /^전체\s*문의$/],
['pwr',   /^(?:발전사업|전체\s*사업)\s+문의$/],
['pwrMk', /^마케팅$/],
['pwrRef',/^소개$/],
['prog',  /^총\s*진행건$/],
['progMk',/^마케팅$/],
['progRef',/^소개$/],
['prop',  /^총\s*제안서$/],
['propMk',/^마케팅$/],
['propRef',/^소개$/],
['mt',    /^총\s*미팅건$/],
['mtMk',  /^마케팅$/],
['mtRef', /^소개$/],
['ctr',   /^총\s*계약$/],
['ctrMk', /^마케팅$/],
['ctrRef',/^소개$/]
];
const found = {};
let wi = 0;
for(let r=head+1; r<Math.min(rows.length, head+40) && wi<want.length; r++){
const lab = txt(at(rows,r,LAB)).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
if(!lab) continue;
if(want[wi][1].test(lab)){ found[want[wi][0]] = r; wi++; }
}
if(found.inq===undefined || found.mt===undefined) return null;
const pick = (key, m) => found[key]===undefined ? 0 : num(at(rows, found[key], M0 + (m-1)));
const pickYear = key => found[key]===undefined ? 0 : num(at(rows, found[key], YEAR));
const months = [];
for(let m=1;m<=12;m++){
months.push({
m,
inq: pick('inq',m),
pwr: pick('pwr',m), pwrMk: pick('pwrMk',m), pwrRef: pick('pwrRef',m),
prog:pick('prog',m), progMk:pick('progMk',m), progRef:pick('progRef',m),
prop:pick('prop',m), propMk:pick('propMk',m), propRef:pick('propRef',m),
mt:  pick('mt',m),   mtMk:  pick('mtMk',m),   mtRef:  pick('mtRef',m),
ctr: pick('ctr',m),  ctrMk: pick('ctrMk',m),  ctrRef: pick('ctrRef',m)
});
}
const year = {};
['inq','pwr','pwrMk','pwrRef','prog','progMk','progRef','prop','propMk','propRef',
'mt','mtMk','mtRef','ctr','ctrMk','ctrRef'].forEach(k=>{ year[k]=pickYear(k); });
return {months, year};
}
const SUMKEYS=['inq','pwr','pwrMk','pwrRef','prog','progMk','progRef',
'prop','propMk','propRef','mt','mtMk','mtRef','ctr','ctrMk','ctrRef'];
function sumFor(months){
const S=DB.sum;
if(!S) return null;
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const rows=S.months.filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m));
const o={};
SUMKEYS.forEach(k=>{ o[k]=rows.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x[k]||0),0); });
return o;
}
const RG_ORDER = ['수도권','충청권','강원권','영남권','호남권','제주'];
const REG_C0=98, REG_C1=243;
const SIDO_SHORT = {
'서울특별시':'서울','부산광역시':'부산','대구광역시':'대구','인천광역시':'인천',
'광주광역시':'광주','대전광역시':'대전','울산광역시':'울산','세종특별자치시':'세종',
'경기도':'경기','강원도':'강원','강원특별자치도':'강원',
'충청북도':'충북','충청남도':'충남','전라북도':'전북','전북특별자치도':'전북',
'전라남도':'전남','경상북도':'경북','경상남도':'경남',
'제주도':'제주','제주특별자치도':'제주'
};
function regNorm(v){
let t=txt(v).replace(/^[0-9]+\s*[.)]\s*/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
if(!t) return '미기재';
const p=t.split(' ');
p[0]=SIDO_SHORT[p[0]]||p[0];
if(p.length===1) return p[0];
if(!/(시|군|구)$/.test(p[1])) return p[0];
return p[0]+' '+p[1];
}
const RG_AREA_FALLBACK = {
'수도권':'경기, 서울, 인천',
'충청권':'충청남도, 충남, 충청북도, 충북, 대전, 세종',
'강원권':'강원',
'영남권':'경상남도, 경남, 경상북도, 경북, 부산, 대구, 울산',
'호남권':'전라남도, 전남, 전라북도',
'제주':'제주'
};
function parseRegionDefs(rows){
const found={};
for(let r=0;r<=40;r++){
const nm=txt(at(rows,r,95));
if(!RG_ORDER.includes(nm)) continue;
if(!found[nm]) found[nm]=txt(at(rows,r,96));
}
return RG_ORDER.map(nm=>({name:nm, area:found[nm] || RG_AREA_FALLBACK[nm] || ''}));
}
function parseRegionTables(rows){
const out=[];
for(let m=1;m<=12;m++){
const h=2+(m-1)*10, hd=h+1;
const mm=String(m).padStart(2,'0')+'월';
const groups=[];
for(let c=REG_C0;c<=REG_C1;c++){
if(txt(at(rows,hd,c))!==mm) continue;
const cols=[];
for(let cc=c+1;cc<=REG_C1;cc++){
const lab=txt(at(rows,hd,cc));
if(!lab) break;
cols.push({c:cc,label:lab});
}
if(!cols.length) continue;
let title=txt(at(rows,h,c)), detail='';
for(let cc=c+1;cc<=c+cols.length;cc++){
const t2=txt(at(rows,h,cc));
if(t2){ detail=t2; break; }
}
const regions=[]; let tot=null;
for(let k=2;k<=9;k++){
const nm=txt(at(rows,h+k,c));
if(!nm) continue;
const vals=cols.map(x=>num(at(rows,h+k,x.c)));
if(nm==='합계') tot={region:nm,vals};
else regions.push({region:nm,vals});
}
if(cols.some(x=>/^\d{1,2}\s*월$/.test(x.label))) continue;
if(regions.filter(r=>RG_ORDER.includes(r.region)).length < 4) continue;
groups.push({c, title:title||'표', detail, cols, regions, tot});
}
out.push({m, groups});
}
return out;
}
function regionGrid(title){
const AX=chartAxis();
const val=(m,rg)=>{
const b=(DB.regions||[]).find(x=>x.m===m); if(!b) return 0;
const g=b.groups.find(x=>x.title===title); if(!g) return 0;
const r=g.regions.find(x=>x.region===rg); if(!r) return 0;
return r.vals.reduce((a,v)=>a+v,0);
};
const names=[...RG_ORDER];
(DB.regions||[]).forEach(b=>b.groups.filter(g=>g.title===title)
.forEach(g=>g.regions.forEach(r=>{ if(!names.includes(r.region)) names.push(r.region); })));
const ms=selMonths();
const rows=names.map(rg=>{
const vals=AX.map(g=>g.months.reduce((a,m)=>a+val(m,rg),0));
return {region:rg, vals, sum:ms.reduce((a,m)=>a+val(m,rg),0)};
});
const tot=AX.map((_,k)=>rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.vals[k],0));
return {cols:AX.map(g=>g.label), rows, tot,
totSum:rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.sum,0)};
}
function regionFor(months){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const blocks=(DB.regions||[]).filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m) && x.groups.length);
if(!blocks.length) return [];
const shape=blocks.find(b=>b.groups.length)||blocks[0];
return shape.groups.map((g0,gi)=>{
const map=new Map();
RG_ORDER.forEach(rg=>map.set(rg, g0.cols.map(()=>0)));
let tot=g0.cols.map(()=>0);
blocks.forEach(b=>{
const g=b.groups[gi]; if(!g) return;
g.regions.forEach(r=>{
if(!map.has(r.region)) map.set(r.region, g0.cols.map(()=>0));
const a=map.get(r.region);
r.vals.forEach((v,ix)=>{ if(ix<a.length) a[ix]+=v; });
});
});
const regions=[...map.entries()].map(([region,vals])=>({region,vals,
sum:vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)}));
regions.forEach(r=>r.vals.forEach((v,ix)=>tot[ix]+=v));
return {title:g0.title, detail:g0.detail, cols:g0.cols.map(x=>x.label),
regions, tot, totSum:tot.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)};
});
}
const RG_OWNERS = ['조성현','최창민','진으뜸','임준길'];
const OW_C = {name:15, mtCap:16, mtN:17, mkN:18, refN:19,
ctrCap:20, ctrN:21, mkCtrCap:22, mkCtrN:23, refCtrCap:24, refCtrN:25};
function owRow(rows, r){
const o={name:txt(at(rows,r,OW_C.name))};
if(!o.name) return null;
Object.keys(OW_C).forEach(k=>{ if(k!=='name') o[k]=num(at(rows,r,OW_C[k])); });
return o;
}
function owBlock(rows, h){
const list=[]; let tot=null;
for(let k=2;k<=8;k++){
const o=owRow(rows,h+k);
if(!o) continue;
if(o.name==='전체'){ tot=o; break; }
list.push(o);
}
return {list, tot};
}
function parseOwnerStats(rows){
if(txt(at(rows,3,OW_C.name))!=='담당자') return null;
const year=owBlock(rows,2);
const months={};
for(let m=1;m<=12;m++){
const h=12+(m-1)*10;
if(txt(at(rows,h+1,OW_C.name))!=='담당자') continue;
months[m]=owBlock(rows,h);
}
return {year, months};
}
const OW_KEYS=['mtCap','mtN','mkN','refN','ctrCap','ctrN','mkCtrCap','mkCtrN','refCtrCap','refCtrN'];
function ownerStatFor(months, name){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const OS = DB.owners;
if(!OS) return null;
const acc=new Map();
ms.forEach(m=>{
const b=OS.months[m]; if(!b) return;
b.list.forEach(o=>{
if(name && o.name!==name) return;
if(!acc.has(o.name)){ const z={name:o.name}; OW_KEYS.forEach(k=>z[k]=0); acc.set(o.name,z); }
const z=acc.get(o.name); OW_KEYS.forEach(k=>z[k]+=o[k]||0);
});
});
const list=[...acc.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.mtN-a.mtN);
const tot={name:'전체'}; OW_KEYS.forEach(k=>tot[k]=list.reduce((a,o)=>a+o[k],0));
return {list, tot};
}
const CORP_KEY = {'그랜드썬':'gs','SP':'sp','유지에스':'ug','UGS':'ug'};
const SEC_Z = () => ({gs:0,sp:0,ug:0,ref:0,tot:0});
function grpFilt(g){
if(!g) return SEC_Z();
if(state.corp==='전체' && state.src==='전체') return g;
const z=SEC_Z();
if(state.corp!=='전체'){
const k=CORP_KEY[state.corp];
if(!k) return z;
if(state.src==='소개') return z;              /* 소개는 법인으로 나뉘지 않는다 */
z[k]=g[k]||0; z.tot=z[k]; return z;
}
if(state.src==='마케팅'){ z.gs=g.gs||0; z.sp=g.sp||0; z.ug=g.ug||0; z.tot=grpMk(g); return z; }
if(state.src==='소개'){ z.ref=g.ref||0; z.tot=z.ref; return z; }
return z;
}
function grpPick(g){
if(state.corp!=='전체'){ const k=CORP_KEY[state.corp]; return k? (g[k]||0) : 0; }
if(state.src==='마케팅') return grpMk(g);
if(state.src==='소개')   return g.ref||0;
return g.tot||0;
}
function meetCtrFor(months){
const ms = Array.isArray(months) ? months : selMonths();
const noQuery = !state.query;
const noOwner = state.owner==='전체' && state.cons==='전체';
if(noQuery && noOwner){
const SC=sectorFor(ms);
let inqG, mtG, ctrG, note='통계 BO:CH';
if(state.type==='전체'){ inqG=SC.tot.inq; mtG=SC.tot.mt; ctrG=SC.tot.ctr; }
else{
const row=SC.list.find(r=>r.sec===state.type);
if(!row) return {ok:true, src:'통계 BO:CH', inq:0, mt:0, ctr:0,
inqMk:0, inqRef:0, mtMk:0, mtRef:0, ctrMk:0, ctrRef:0, empty:true};
inqG=row.inq; mtG=row.mt; ctrG=row.ctr; note=`통계 BO:CH · ${state.type}`;
}
if(state.corp!=='전체') note+=` · ${state.corp}`;
else if(state.src!=='전체') note+=` · ${state.src}`;
return {ok:true, src:note,
inq:grpPick(inqG), inqMk:grpMk(inqG), inqRef:inqG.ref,
mt: grpPick(mtG),  mtMk: grpMk(mtG),  mtRef: mtG.ref,
ctr:grpPick(ctrG), ctrMk:grpMk(ctrG), ctrRef:ctrG.ref};
}
if(ownerOnlyFilter()){
const O=ownerStatFor(ms, state.owner);
if(O && O.list.length){
const t=O.tot;
return {ok:true, src:`통계 P:Z · ${state.owner}`, owner:state.owner, noInq:true,
inq:null, inqMk:null, inqRef:null,
mt:t.mtN,  mtMk:t.mkN,     mtRef:t.refN,
ctr:t.ctrN, ctrMk:t.mkCtrN, ctrRef:t.refCtrN,
mtCap:t.mtCap, ctrCap:t.ctrCap};
}
}
return {ok:false, src:''};
}
function chartAxis(){

if(state.mode==='quarter'){
const qs = state.quarters.length ? state.quarters.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b)
: [...new Set(all.map(qOf))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
return qs.map(q=>({label:q+'분기', months:QMONTHS[q].filter(m=>all.includes(m))}))
.filter(g=>g.months.length);
}
if(state.mode==='cumulative'){
const ms=selMonths();

}

.map(m=>({label:m+'월', months:[m]}));
