````html
/* Calendar weeks connect two independently dated source reports. */
const CW={weeks:store.get('v10_consultingWeeks',{}),loading:false,error:''};
const cwISO=d=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const cwShift=(iso,n)=>{const d=new Date(iso+'T00:00:00Z');d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+n);return cwISO(d);};
function cwWeekOne(year){const d=new Date(Date.UTC(year,0,4));d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-(d.getUTCDay()+6)%7);return cwISO(d);}
function cwWeekCount(year){return Math.round((Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year+1))-Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year)))/604800000);}
function cwRange(year,week){const start=cwShift(cwWeekOne(year),(week-1)*7);return {year,week,start,end:cwShift(start,4),meetingStart:cwShift(start,-3),meetingEnd:cwShift(start,3)};}
function cwSelected(year){const saved=Number(CW.weeks[year]);if(saved>=1&&saved<=cwWeekCount(year))return saved;return Math.max(1,Math.min(cwWeekCount(year),1+Math.floor((Date.parse(v10Today())-Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year)))/604800000)));}
function cwPeriod(raw,year,month){
 const m=String(raw||'').match(/(\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{1,2})\s*[~～–—-]\s*(\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{1,2})/);if(!m)return null;
 const sm=Number(m[1]),em=Number(m[3]);let sy=year;if(month===1&&sm===12)sy--;if(month===12&&sm===1)sy++;
 const start=`${sy}-${String(sm).padStart(2,'0')}-${m[2].padStart(2,'0')}`,end=`${sy+(em<sm?1:0)}-${String(em).padStart(2,'0')}-${m[4].padStart(2,'0')}`;
 if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(start))||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(end))||cwISO(new Date(start+'T00:00:00Z'))!==start||cwISO(new Date(end+'T00:00:00Z'))!==end)return null;
 return {start,end};
}
const cwValue=v=>txt(v)===''?null:num(v);
function cwInquiryRows(payload){
 const report=smParseInquiryReport(payload?.tongye);
 return report.weekly.map(w=>({...w,...cwPeriod(w.period,report.year,report.month),year:report.year,month:report.month})).filter(w=>w.start&&new Date(w.start+'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay()===1&&cwShift(w.start,4)===w.end);
}
function cwMeetingRows(payload){
 const found=new Map();
 for(const sh of payload?.weeklyMeetings?.sheets||[]){
  const name=sh.sheet.match(/^(\d{2})\.(\d{2})$/);if(!name)continue;
  const year=sh.year||2000+Number(name[1]),month=sh.month||Number(name[2]);
  const header=(sh.rows||[]).find(row=>txt(row[0])==='날짜')||[];
  const hasMarketingCapacity=/마케팅.*미팅.*용량/.test(txt(header[4])),hasMarketingCount=/마케팅.*미팅.*건수/.test(txt(header[5]));
  for(const row of sh.rows||[]){
   if(!/^\d+주차$/.test(txt(row[1])))continue;
   const dates=cwPeriod(row[0],year,month);if(!dates||new Date(dates.start+'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay()!==5||cwShift(dates.start,6)!==dates.end)continue;
   const item={...dates,sheet:sh.sheet,gid:sh.gid,period:txt(row[0]),week:txt(row[1]),capacity:cwValue(row[2]),count:cwValue(row[3]),marketingCapacity:hasMarketingCapacity?cwValue(row[4]):null,marketingCount:hasMarketingCount?cwValue(row[5]):null};
   // A week repeated at a month boundary must not be counted twice.
   if(!found.has(item.start)||item.count!==null)found.set(item.start,item);
  }
 }
 return [...found.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.start.localeCompare(b.start));
}
function cwData(year,week){
 const range=cwRange(year,week),inquiry=cwInquiryRows(V10.payload).find(r=>r.start===range.start&&r.end===range.end),meeting=cwMeetingRows(V10.payload).find(r=>r.start===range.meetingStart&&r.end===range.meetingEnd);
 return {range,inquiry,meeting};
}
const cwLabel=(a,b)=>`${a.slice(5).replace('-','/')} ~ ${b.slice(5).replace('-','/')}`;
const cwMetric=(inquiry,index)=>cwValue(inquiry?.metrics?.[index]?.values?.[4]);
const cwShow=(value,unit='건')=>value===null||value===undefined?'—':`${Number(value).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:3})}${unit}`;
function cwCard(label,value,note,color){return `<article class="v10-kpi" style="--metric:${color}"><span class="label">${esc(label)}</span><strong>${esc(value)}</strong><small>${esc(note)}</small></article>`;}
function cwView(){
 const year=Number(DB.year),week=cwSelected(year),{range:r,inquiry,meeting}=cwData(year,week),count=cwWeekCount(year);
 const source=smParseInquiryReport(V10.payload?.tongye),available=cwInquiryRows(V10.payload),meetingRows=cwMeetingRows(V10.payload);
 const selector=`<div class="cw-controls"><button class="btn" data-cw-step="-1" ${week===1?'disabled':''}>이전 주</button><label>연간 주차<select id="consultingWeek" aria-label="연간 주차">${Array.from({length:count},(_,n)=>{const w=cwRange(year,n+1);return `<option value="${n+1}" ${week===n+1?'selected':''}>${n+1}주차 · ${cwLabel(w.start,w.end)}</option>`;}).join('')}</select></label><button class="btn" data-cw-step="1" ${week===count?'disabled':''}>다음 주</button><button class="btn" data-cw-today>이번 주</button><strong>${year}년 ${week}주차</strong></div>`;
 const periods=`<div class="cw-periods"><div><span>문의 · 월요일~금요일</span><b>${cwLabel(r.start,r.end)}</b></div><div><span>미팅 · 금요일~목요일</span><b>${cwLabel(r.meetingStart,r.meetingEnd)}</b></div></div>`;
 const inquiryBody=inquiry?smMetricsTable(inquiry.metrics):v10Empty('이 주의 문의 원본 자료가 연결되지 않았습니다.');
 const meetingBody=meeting?v10Table(['구분','미팅 건수','미팅 용량'],[['전체',cwShow(meeting.count),cwShow(meeting.capacity,' kW')],['마케팅',cwShow(meeting.marketingCount),cwShow(meeting.marketingCapacity,' kW')]]):v10Empty(CW.loading?'미팅 원본을 불러오는 중입니다.':'이 주의 미팅 원본 자료가 연결되지 않았습니다.');
 const rows=Array.from({length:count},(_,n)=>{const w=cwRange(year,n+1),a=available.find(x=>x.start===w.start),b=meetingRows.find(x=>x.start===w.meetingStart);return [`<button class="easy-link ${n+1===week?'cw-selected':''}" data-cw-week="${n+1}">${n+1}주차</button>`,cwLabel(w.start,w.end),cwShow(cwMetric(a,0)),cwShow(cwMetric(a,1)),cwLabel(w.meetingStart,w.meetingEnd),cwShow(b?.count),cwShow(b?.capacity,' kW')];});
 return easyLead('컨설팅 주간 실적','문의와 미팅의 원본 보고 기간을 각각 확인합니다.','주간 · 부서 전체')+selector+periods
 +`<div class="v10-kpis">${cwCard('전체 주간 문의',cwShow(cwMetric(inquiry,0)),'월~금 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[0])}${cwCard('발전사업 주간 문의',cwShow(cwMetric(inquiry,1)),'월~금 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[1])}${cwCard('보고 미팅 건수',cwShow(meeting?.count),'금~목 · 원본 보고 미팅',V10.colors[3])}${cwCard('보고 미팅 용량',cwShow(meeting?.capacity,' kW'),'금~목 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[4])}</div>`
 +`<div class="cw-panels">${v10Panel('유입별 주간 문의',`${cwLabel(r.start,r.end)} · 월~금`,inquiryBody+`<p class="v10-note">문의 원본: 통계 AB~AH · 현재 ${source.year||'—'}년 ${source.month||'—'}월 표가 연결되어 있습니다. 빈칸은 —, 원본의 0은 0으로 표시합니다.</p><a class="easy-link" href="${SALES_MEETING_SOURCE.inquiry}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">문의 원본 열기 ↗</a>`)}${v10Panel('주간 미팅 실적',`${cwLabel(r.meetingStart,r.meetingEnd)} · 금~목`,meetingBody+`<p class="v10-note">미팅 원본: ${esc(meeting?.sheet||'월별 시트')} J~O. 예정 미팅이 포함된 경우 원본 집계 그대로 표시합니다.</p><a class="easy-link" href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DkUE6SYR9uyS3TGzlRTq28yuGluYpnuF2yuyCt_2lx8/edit?gid=${meeting?.gid||1866167974}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">미팅 원본 열기 ↗</a>`)}</div>`
 +((CW.error||V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings?.errors?.length)?`<div class="v10-callout" role="status">미팅 자료 연결 확인 필요: ${esc(CW.error||V10.payload.weeklyMeetings.errors.join(' / '))}</div>`:'')
 +`<p class="v10-note">주차는 ISO 연간 주차를 사용합니다.${count===53?' '+year+'년은 달력상 53주차가 있어 연말 누락 없이 표시합니다.':''} 서로 다른 기간의 문의와 미팅으로 전환율을 계산하지 않습니다. 문의 과거 주차는 원본에 확인된 자료만 표시합니다.</p>`
 +v10Panel('연간 주차별 비교','주차를 누르면 해당 주의 상세 자료로 이동합니다.',v10Table(['주차','문의 기간 (월~금)','전체 문의','발전사업 문의','미팅 기간 (금~목)','미팅 건수','미팅 용량'],rows))
 +`<p class="v10-note">미팅 자료 갱신: ${esc(V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings?.at?new Date(V10.payload.weeklyMeetings.at).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul'}):'연결 대기')}</p>`;
}
function cwLoad(){
 if(V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings||CW.loading||CW.error||typeof google==='undefined'||!google.script?.run)return;
 CW.loading=true;google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(d=>{CW.loading=false;V10.payload.weeklyMeetings=d;if(state.sect==='weekly')render();}).withFailureHandler(e=>{CW.loading=false;CW.error=String(e.message||e);if(state.sect==='weekly')render();}).collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10();
}
SECTIONS.push({k:'weekly',t:'주간 실적',g:'실적',basis:'exec'});
VIEWS.weekly=()=>{cwLoad();return cwView();};
EASY_MENU.find(x=>x.k==='summary').items.push(['weekly','주간 실적']);
const cwOriginalPeriod=renderPeriod;
renderPeriod=function(){cwOriginalPeriod();document.body.classList.toggle('cw-weekly',state.sect==='weekly');if(state.sect==='weekly'){$('#easyPeriodNote').textContent=`${DB.year}년 · 연간 주차 조회 · 문의 월~금 / 미팅 금~목 · 부서 전체`;} };
const cwToolbar=document.querySelector('.easy-toolbar');
if(cwToolbar){const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='easy-preset cw-open';button.dataset.v10Section='weekly';button.textContent='주간 조회';cwToolbar.insertBefore(button,cwToolbar.firstChild);}
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.id==='consultingWeek'){CW.weeks[DB.year]=Number(e.target.value);store.set('v10_consultingWeeks',CW.weeks);render();}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-cw-week],[data-cw-step],[data-cw-today]');if(!b)return;const year=Number(DB.year);if(b.hasAttribute('data-cw-today')){delete CW.weeks[year];}else CW.weeks[year]=Math.max(1,Math.min(cwWeekCount(year),b.dataset.cwWeek?Number(b.dataset.cwWeek):cwSelected(year)+Number(b.dataset.cwStep)));store.set('v10_consultingWeeks',CW.weeks);render();});

v10Boot();
</script>
<script>
// Keep consulting mounted so draft comments and filters survive tab changes.
(function installBusinessParts(){
 const tabs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-business-part]'));
 if(!tabs.length)return;
 let current='consulting';
 const scrollPositions=new Map();
 function selectPart(part,focus=false){
  const selected=tabs.find(tab=>tab.dataset.businessPart===part);
  if(!selected)return;
  scrollPositions.set(current,window.scrollY);
  tabs.forEach(tab=>{
   const active=tab===selected;
   tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(active));
   tab.tabIndex=active?0:-1;
   document.getElementById(tab.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden=!active;
  });
  current=part;
  document.querySelector('.rail')?.classList.remove('open');
  window.scrollTo({top:scrollPositions.get(part)||0,behavior:'instant'});
  if(focus)selected.focus();
 }
 tabs.forEach((tab,index)=>{
  tab.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPart(tab.dataset.businessPart));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
   let next;
   if(event.key==='ArrowRight')next=(index+1)%tabs.length;
   else if(event.key==='ArrowLeft')next=(index+tabs.length-1)%tabs.length;
   else if(event.key==='Home')next=0;
   else if(event.key==='End')next=tabs.length-1;
   else return;
   event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();selectPart(tabs[next].dataset.businessPart,true);
  });
 });
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-business-return]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPart('consulting',true)));
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>

````

### 대시보드.gs

````javascript
/**
 * 그랜드썬 컨설팅 성과 대시보드 — 웹앱 (v9, 담당자별 P~Z 추가)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * v7에서 바뀐 것
 *   1) 캐시를 미리 채운다 — 30분마다 도는 트리거가 시트를 대신 읽어 둔다.
 *      사용자는 시트 읽기를 기다리지 않는다. (이게 가장 큰 개선)
 *   2) 캐시가 따뜻하면 화면에 데이터를 바로 실어 보낸다 — 왕복 1회로 끝난다.
 *      캐시가 비어 있을 때만 화면 먼저 → 데이터 나중 방식으로 넘어간다.
 *   3) 읽는 열을 파서가 실제로 쓰는 것만 남겼다.  5.0만 셀 → 3.1만 셀
 *   4) Sheets 고급 서비스가 켜져 있으면 batchGet 한 번으로 읽는다 (2~4배 빠름).
 *      꺼져 있으면 예전 방식으로 자동 대체되므로 그냥 두어도 동작한다.
 *   5) 캐시 유지 시간 10분 → 6시간
 *
 * 처음 한 번 해야 할 일 — 트리거 등록 (아래 둘 중 하나)
 *   (가) 편집기 왼쪽 ⏰ 트리거 → 트리거 추가 →
 *        함수 `캐시채우기` · 시간 기반 · 분 단위 타이머 · 30분마다 → 저장
 *   (나) 함수 목록에서 `설치` 를 골라 실행 (권한 화면이 한 번 더 뜬다)
 *
 * 주소 뒤 옵션:  ?data=1 → JSON   ?callback=함수 → JSONP   ?fresh=1 → 캐시 무시
 * 시트는 읽기만 하며 수정하지 않습니다.
 */

var SHEET_ID  = '1PR1M6AfYkzmvYlzFKkV4KRhJWTWs0rzZBmroZ3CSwyc';
var CACHE_SEC = 300;               /* 6시간 (CacheService 최대값) */
var CACHE_KEY = 'gsdash_v10';
var CHUNK     = 24000;               /* 값 1개 100KB 한도 아래로 */

/* 읽을 영역 — [시작행, 끝행(0이면 마지막행까지), 시작열, 끝열]  모두 1부터 셈
   파서가 실제로 건드리는 열만 남겼다. 좌표는 시트와 똑같이 유지된다. */
var BLOCKS = [
  { sheet: '통계', max: 2100, ranges: [
      [  1,   0,   1,  14],   /* C~N   미팅 원장 (마지막 행까지) */
      [  1, 135,  16,  26],   /* P~Z   담당자별 미팅·계약 (연간 + 월별) */
      [  1, 225,  28,  41],   /* AB~AO 영업회의용 주간 문의 + 월별 집계표 */
      [  1, 305,  67,  86],   /* BO~CH 사업형태별 문의·미팅·계약 (월 21섹터) */
      [  1, 130,  96, 244]    /* CR~IJ 권역 정의 + 권역별 문의·미팅·담당자 */
  ]},
  { sheet: '말',   max: 560,  ranges: [
      [  1, 550,   3,  15],   /* C~O   주차별 전체문의 · 사업형태별 */
      [  1, 550,  21,  27],   /* U~AA  미팅 · 계약 */
      [  1, 550,  31,  36],   /* AE~AJ 연간 사업형태별 */
      [  1, 550,  51,  63],   /* AY~BK 미팅 간 달 · 용량구간 · 담당자 */
      [  1,  30,  64,  65],   /* BL~BM 연도별 전체문의 */
      [  1,  30,  71,  90]    /* BS~CL 월별 요약 · 목표 */
  ]},
  { sheet: '미팅26', max: 70, ranges: [
      [  1,  70,  14,  31]    /* N~AE 영업회의용 이번 주 미팅 목록 · 요약 */
  ]}
];

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- 진입점 */
function doGet(e) {
  var p = (e && e.parameter) ? e.parameter : {};
  if (p.weekly === '1') return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10())).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  if (p.health === '1') return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:true,release:'ce17343ad93030eb0da97a44a3e93806d9a83b50'})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  var fresh = !!p.fresh;

  if (p.data || p.callback) {
    var json = getPayloadJson(fresh);
    if (p.callback && /^[A-Za-z0-9_$]{1,64}$/.test(p.callback)) {
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(p.callback + '(' + json + ');')
        .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JAVASCRIPT);
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(json)
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }

  /* 캐시가 이미 차 있으면 데이터를 화면에 같이 실어 보낸다 (왕복 1회).
     비어 있으면 null 을 실어 보내고, 브라우저가 화면을 먼저 그린 뒤 따로 받아 간다. */
  var warm = null;
  var t = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('index');
  t.DATA = 'null';
  return t.evaluate()
    .setTitle('그랜드썬 컨설팅 성과 대시보드')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}

/* 브라우저가 google.script.run 으로 부르는 함수 */
function getDashboardData(fresh) {
  return getPayloadJson(!!fresh);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------- 트리거 (미리 채우기) */
function 캐시채우기() {
  var t0 = new Date().getTime();
  var json = getPayloadJson(true);
  Logger.log('캐시 갱신 ' + (new Date().getTime() - t0) + 'ms · '
             + Math.round(json.length / 1024) + 'KB');
}

function 설치() {
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) {
    if (t.getHandlerFunction() === '캐시채우기') ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
  });
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('캐시채우기').timeBased().everyMinutes(30).create();
  캐시채우기();
  Logger.log('30분마다 캐시를 미리 채우도록 등록했습니다.');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ 캐시 계층 */
function readCache() {
  var cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  var meta = cache.get(CACHE_KEY + '_n');
  if (!meta) return null;
  var n = parseInt(meta, 10), parts = [];
  for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    var s = cache.get(CACHE_KEY + '_' + k);
    if (s === null) return null;          /* 일부만 남았으면 무효 */
    parts.push(s);
  }
  return parts.join('');
}

function writeCache(json) {
  try {
    var cache = CacheService.getScriptCache(), map = {}, i = 0, k = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < json.length; i += CHUNK) map[CACHE_KEY + '_' + (k++)] = json.substring(i, i + CHUNK);
    map[CACHE_KEY + '_n'] = String(k);
    cache.putAll(map, CACHE_SEC);
  } catch (err) { /* 캐시는 실패해도 넘어간다 */ }
}

function getPayloadJson(fresh) {
  if (!fresh) {
    var hit = readCache();
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  var json = JSON.stringify(collectData());
  if (!JSON.parse(json).error) writeCache(json);
  return json;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ 데이터 수집 */
function collectData() {
  try {
    var out = { at: new Date().toISOString(), version: 10 };
    var viaApi = false;
    try { viaApi = (typeof Sheets !== 'undefined' && Sheets.Spreadsheets); } catch (e) { viaApi = false; }
    if (viaApi) {
      var got = readViaApi();
      out.tongye = got['통계'];
      out.mal    = got['말'];
      out.meeting26 = got['미팅26'];
      out.via    = 'api';
    } else {
      var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID);
      out.tongye = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[0]);
      out.mal    = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[1]);
      out.meeting26 = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[2]);
      out.via    = 'app';
    }
    out.yearData = collectYearDataV10(SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID));
    return out;
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err) };
  }
}

/* --- 빠른 경로: Sheets 고급 서비스 batchGet (요청 1회) --- */
function readViaApi() {
  var ranges = [], plan = [];
  BLOCKS.forEach(function (blk) {
    blk.ranges.forEach(function (r) {
      ranges.push("'" + blk.sheet + "'!" + colA1(r[2]) + r[0] + ':' + colA1(r[3]) + (r[1] ? r[1] : ''));
      plan.push({ sheet: blk.sheet, r0: r[0], c0: r[2], max: blk.max });
    });
  });
  var res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.Values.batchGet(SHEET_ID, {
    ranges: ranges,
    valueRenderOption: 'FORMATTED_VALUE',
    dateTimeRenderOption: 'FORMATTED_STRING'
  });
  var grids = {};
  (res.valueRanges || []).forEach(function (vr, ix) {
    var q = plan[ix];
    if (!grids[q.sheet]) grids[q.sheet] = {};
    paint(grids[q.sheet], vr.values || [], q.r0, q.c0, q.max);
  });
  var out = {};
  BLOCKS.forEach(function (blk) { out[blk.sheet] = flatten(grids[blk.sheet] || {}); });
  return out;
}

/* --- 대체 경로: SpreadsheetApp --- */
function readViaSheet(ss, blk) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(blk.sheet);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('"' + blk.sheet + '" 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다.');
  var lastRow = Math.min(sh.getLastRow() || 1, blk.max);
  var lastCol = sh.getMaxColumns();
  var grid = {};
  blk.ranges.forEach(function (r) {
    var r0 = r[0], r1 = r[1] ? Math.min(r[1], blk.max) : lastRow;
    var c0 = r[2], c1 = Math.min(r[3], lastCol);
    if (r1 < r0 || c1 < c0) return;
    paint(grid, sh.getRange(r0, c0, r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1).getDisplayValues(), r0, c0, blk.max);
  });
  return flatten(grid);
}

/* 읽어 온 직사각형을 시트와 같은 절대 좌표에 얹는다 */
function paint(grid, vals, r0, c0, max) {
  for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
    var rIx = r0 - 1 + i;
    if (rIx >= max) break;
    var row = vals[i];
    if (!row) continue;
    for (var j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
      var v = row[j];
      if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) continue;
      if (!grid[rIx]) grid[rIx] = {};
      grid[rIx][c0 - 1 + j] = (typeof v === 'string') ? v : String(v);
    }
  }
}

/* 성긴 좌표표를 배열로 — 빈 칸은 '', 뒤쪽 여백은 잘라낸다 */
function flatten(grid) {
  var maxR = -1, r, c;
  for (var k in grid) { r = parseInt(k, 10); if (r > maxR) maxR = r; }
  var out = [];
  for (r = 0; r <= maxR; r++) {
    var g = grid[r];
    if (!g) { out.push([]); continue; }
    var e = -1;
    for (var k2 in g) { c = parseInt(k2, 10); if (c > e) e = c; }
    var line = new Array(e + 1);
    for (c = 0; c <= e; c++) line[c] = (g[c] === undefined) ? '' : g[c];
    out.push(line);
  }
  return out;
}

function colA1(n) {
  var s = '';
  while (n > 0) { var m = (n - 1) % 26; s = String.fromCharCode(65 + m) + s; n = (n - m - 1) / 26; }
  return s;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- 점검용 (수동 실행) */
function 속도점검() {
  var t0 = new Date().getTime();
  var r = collectData();
  var t1 = new Date().getTime();
  if (r.error) { Logger.log('오류: ' + r.error); return; }
  var json = JSON.stringify(r);
  Logger.log('읽기 ' + (t1 - t0) + 'ms · 경로 ' + r.via
             + ' · 통계 ' + r.tongye.length + '행 · 말 ' + r.mal.length + '행');
  Logger.log('전송량 약 ' + Math.round(json.length / 1024) + 'KB');
  Logger.log('원장 5행: ' + r.tongye[4].slice(2, 9).join(' | '));
  var t2 = new Date().getTime();
  readCache();
  Logger.log('캐시에서 읽기 ' + (new Date().getTime() - t2) + 'ms'
             + (readCache() ? '' : ' — 캐시가 비어 있습니다'));
}

function 캐시비우기() {
  var c = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  var n = parseInt(c.get(CACHE_KEY + '_n') || '0', 10);
  var keys = [CACHE_KEY + '_n'];
  for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) keys.push(CACHE_KEY + '_' + k);
  c.removeAll(keys);
  Logger.log('캐시를 비웠습니다.');
}

/* v10 additions: year discovery and a compact, read-only inquiry ledger. */
function collectYearDataV10(ss) {
  var result = {};
  ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh) {
    var year = sh.getName();
    if (!/^20\d{2}$/.test(year) || Number(year) < 2025) return;
    var last = sh.getLastRow();
    var records = [];
    if (last >= 3) {
      var rows = sh.getRange(3, 1, last - 2, Math.min(sh.getMaxColumns(),13)).getDisplayValues();
      rows.forEach(function(v) {
        var no = String(v[0] || '').trim();
        var match = no.match(/^(?:(sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-(\d{2})\d+/i);
        // Number-only preallocated rows are not actual inquiries.
        if (!match || !v.slice(1).some(function(cell) { return String(cell || '').trim(); })) return;
        var month = Number(match[2]);
        if (month < 1 || month > 12) return;
        var day = Number(match[3]);
        var inquiryDate = day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? year+'-'+('0'+month).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+day).slice(-2) : '';
        var dt = String(v[9] || '').match(/(20\d{2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})/);
        var date = dt ? dt[1]+'-'+('0'+dt[2]).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+dt[3]).slice(-2) : '';
        var status = String(v[1] || '').trim();
        var area = String(v[4] || '');
        var reg = /서울|경기|인천/.test(area)?'수도권':/충남|충북|충청|대전|세종/.test(area)?'충청권':/강원/.test(area)?'강원권':/부산|대구|울산|경남|경북|경상/.test(area)?'영남권':/광주|전남|전북|전라/.test(area)?'호남권':/제주/.test(area)?'제주':area?'기타':'미분류';
        records.push({no:no,year:Number(year),cmo:month,inquiryDate:inquiryDate,date:date,em:dt?Number(dt[2]):0,meetingYear:dt?Number(dt[1]):0,
          ct:status,src:/소개/.test(status)?'소개':status?'마케팅':'미분류',type:String(v[2]||''),reg:reg,
          prop:String(v[5]||''),cons:String(v[6]||''),own:String(v[7]||'미지정'),
          cap:parseFloat(String(v[10]||'').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''))||0,
          corp:match[1]?match[1].toUpperCase():'그랜드썬'});
      });
    }
    result[year] = {records:records,source:year+' 문의 원장',sourceRule:'소개 상태는 소개, 나머지 기재 상태는 마케팅; 법인은 상담번호 접두어 기준'};
  });
  return result;
}

/* Private follow-up workspace. No personal fields are added to public JSON/cache. */
var FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH_ = '225e67703980313ff77a9a0482c1462076d44619e0a5ef303a78de555db6e6c3';
function fuHash_(s) { return Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,String(s),Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).map(function(b){return ('0'+((b+256)%256).toString(16)).slice(-2);}).join(''); }
function fuProps_(){return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();}
function fuToday_(){return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(),'Asia/Seoul','yyyy-MM-dd');}
function fuDate_(s){s=String(s||'');if(!s)return '';if(!/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)||isNaN(new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z').getTime())||new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==s)throw Error('날짜 형식을 확인하세요.');return s;}
function fuAuth_(code){
 if(typeof code!=='string'||code.length<20||code.length>100)throw Error('접속 코드를 확인하세요.');
 var hash=fuHash_(code);
 if(hash===FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH_)return {admin:true,name:'관리자',role:'all'};
 var p=fuProps_(),raw=p.getProperty('fu_access_'+hash);
 if(raw)return JSON.parse(raw);
 var sessionRaw=p.getProperty('fu_session_'+hash);
 if(sessionRaw){
  try{
   var session=JSON.parse(sessionRaw);
   // A remembered browser stays authorized until the user explicitly signs
   // out (or an administrator revokes its token). Legacy 180-day sessions
   // are intentionally accepted as permanent so existing registrations are
   // not interrupted by this policy change.
   if(session.actor)return session.actor;
  }catch(ignore){}
  p.deleteProperty('fu_session_'+hash);
 }
 throw Error('접속 코드가 올바르지 않거나 해제되었습니다.');
}
function fuActor_(code){
 // The dashboard owner is already authenticated by Google. When Apps Script
 // can identify that signed-in account, open the protected workspace without
 // asking for a second code. Public/anonymous visitors have no active email
 // here and still fall back to the scoped access-code check below.
 try{
  if(typeof Session!=='undefined'){
   var active=String(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail()||'').toLowerCase();
   var effective=String(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail()||'').toLowerCase();
   if(active&&effective&&active===effective)return {admin:true,name:'관리자',role:'all',google:true};
  }
 }catch(ignore){}
 return fuAuth_(code);
}
function fuAllowed_(actor,r){return actor.admin||r[actor.role]===actor.name;}
function rememberFollowupAccess(code){
 var actor=fuActor_(code),token=Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'')+Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');
 var p=fuProps_(),hash=fuHash_(token),all=p.getProperties();
 Object.keys(all).filter(function(k){return k.indexOf('fu_session_')===0;}).forEach(function(k){try{if(!JSON.parse(all[k]).actor)p.deleteProperty(k);}catch(ignore){p.deleteProperty(k);}});
 p.setProperty('fu_session_'+hash,JSON.stringify({actor:{admin:!!actor.admin,name:actor.name,role:actor.role},persistent:true,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}));
 return {code:token,persistent:true};
}
function forgetFollowupAccess(code){
 if(typeof code==='string'&&code.length>=20&&code.length<=100)fuProps_().deleteProperty('fu_session_'+fuHash_(code));
 return true;
}
function fuText_(s,max){return String(s||'').trim().slice(0,max||500);}
function fuStatus_(s){
 s=String(s||'').replace(/\s/g,'');
 if(/종료|취소|거절|포기|실주/.test(s))return '종료';
 if(/계약/.test(s)&&!/미계약|계약전|계약예정|계약검토|계약대기/.test(s))return '계약';
 if(/진행|상담|미팅|검토|제안|대기|보류|예정/.test(s))return '진행 중';
 if(/미계약/.test(s))return '미계약';
 return '미분류';
}
function fuContact_(v){
 var contact=String(v[3]||''),notes=String(v[12]||''),phones=contact.match(/(?:\+82[- .]?)?0?\d{1,2}[- .]?\d{3,4}[- .]?\d{4}/g)||[];
 var emails=contact.match(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/ig)||[];
 var name=contact;phones.concat(emails).forEach(function(s){name=name.replace(s,'');});
 return {customer:name.replace(/^[\s,;/]+|[\s,;/]+$/g,'').trim(),phone:phones.join(' / '),email:emails.join(' / '),address:String(v[4]||'')};
}
function fuExtract_(v,headers){
 var base=fuContact_(v),contact=String(v[3]||''),notes=String(v[12]||'');
 function field(rx,lineRx){var out=[];headers.forEach(function(h,i){if(i>=13&&rx.test(h)&&v[i])out.push(String(v[i]));});return out.length?out.join('\n'):notes.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function(s){return lineRx.test(s);}).join('\n');}
 return Object.assign(base,{contactRaw:contact,content:notes,kepco:field(/한전|선로|계통/,/한전|선로|계통/),municipality:field(/지자체|개발행위|인허가/,/지자체|개발행위|인허가/)});
}
function fuRows_(actor){
 var ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID),out=[];
 ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh){
  var year=Number(sh.getName());if(!/^20\d{2}$/.test(sh.getName())||year<2025||sh.getLastRow()<3)return;
  var values=sh.getRange(3,1,sh.getLastRow()-2,13).getDisplayValues();
  values.forEach(function(v,ix){
   var no=String(v[0]||'').trim(),m=no.match(/^(?:(?:sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-\d+/i);
   if(!m||Number(m[1])<1||Number(m[1])>12||(!v[2]&&!v[3]&&!v[12]))return;
   var r={id:year+':'+no.toLowerCase(),no:no,year:year,month:Number(m[1]),sourceRow:ix+3,sourceSheet:sh.getName(),gid:sh.getSheetId(),
    statusRaw:String(v[1]||''),status:fuStatus_(v[1]),type:String(v[2]||''),cons:String(v[6]||'').trim()||'미지정',own:String(v[7]||'').trim()||'미지정',meetingDate:String(v[9]||''),capacity:String(v[10]||'')};
   if(fuAllowed_(actor,r))out.push(Object.assign(r,fuContact_(v),{meetingISO:fuSourceDate_(v[9],year),noteEvidence:fuNoteEvidence_(v[12],year,fuToday_()),noteFingerprint:fuHash_(String(v[12]||'')).slice(0,24)}));
  });
 });
 var counts={};out.forEach(function(r){counts[r.id]=(counts[r.id]||0)+1;});out.forEach(function(r){r.duplicate=counts[r.id]>1;});return out;
}
function fuStateKey_(id){return 'fu_record_'+fuHash_(id);}
function getFollowupWorkspace(code){
 var actor=fuActor_(code),rows=fuRows_(actor),observationWarning=fuObserveNotes_(rows),props=fuProps_().getProperties();
 rows.forEach(function(r){r.followup=props[fuStateKey_(r.id)]?JSON.parse(props[fuStateKey_(r.id)]):{version:0,lastContact:'',nextContact:'',note:'',history:[]};});
 rows.forEach(function(r){delete r.noteFingerprint;});
 return {actor:actor,rows:rows,at:new Date().toISOString(),today:fuToday_(),observationWarning:observationWarning};
}
function getFollowupDetail(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);input=input||{};
 var year=Number(input.year),row=Number(input.sourceRow),id=String(input.id||'');
 if(!/^20\d{2}$/.test(String(year))||year<2025||!Number.isInteger(row)||row<3||id.indexOf(year+':')!==0)throw Error('상담 위치를 확인하세요.');
 var ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID),sh=ss.getSheetByName(String(year));
 if(!sh||row>sh.getLastRow())throw Error('원본 상담을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
 var cols=Math.min(sh.getMaxColumns(),40),headers=sh.getRange(1,1,2,cols).getDisplayValues();
 var names=headers[0].map(function(x,i){return String(x)+' '+headers[1][i];});
 var dataCols=13;names.forEach(function(h,i){if(i>=13&&/한전|선로|계통|지자체|개발행위|인허가/.test(h))dataCols=i+1;});
 var v=sh.getRange(row,1,1,dataCols).getDisplayValues()[0],no=String(v[0]||'').trim(),m=no.match(/^(?:(?:sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-\d+/i);
 if(!m||(year+':'+no.toLowerCase())!==id)throw Error('원본 상담번호가 변경되었습니다. 목록을 새로고침하세요.');
 var r={id:id,no:no,year:year,month:Number(m[1]),sourceRow:row,sourceSheet:String(year),gid:sh.getSheetId(),statusRaw:String(v[1]||''),status:fuStatus_(v[1]),type:String(v[2]||''),cons:String(v[6]||'').trim()||'미지정',own:String(v[7]||'').trim()||'미지정',meetingDate:String(v[9]||''),capacity:String(v[10]||'')};
 if(!fuAllowed_(actor,r))throw Error('이 상담의 조회 권한이 없습니다.');
 var p=fuProps_(),raw=p.getProperty(fuStateKey_(id));
 r.followup=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{version:0,lastContact:'',nextContact:'',note:'',history:[]};
 return Object.assign(r,fuExtract_(v,names),{meetingISO:fuSourceDate_(v[9],year),noteEvidence:fuNoteEvidence_(v[12],year,fuToday_())});
}
function saveFollowupRecord(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);input=input||{};
 var rows=fuRows_(actor).filter(function(r){return r.id===input.id;});
 if(rows.length!==1)throw Error('상담번호가 중복되었거나 조회 권한이 없습니다. 원본을 확인하세요.');
 var r=rows[0],next=fuDate_(input.nextContact),last=fuDate_(input.lastContact),today=fuToday_();
 if(last&&last>today)throw Error('마지막 연락일은 오늘 이후로 저장할 수 없습니다.');
 var note=fuText_(input.note,300),recipient=fuText_(input.recipient,80),action=String(input.action||'schedule');
 if(['schedule','contact','request','resolve'].indexOf(action)<0)throw Error('알 수 없는 처리입니다.');
 if(action==='contact'&&!last)throw Error('연락한 날짜를 입력하세요.');
 if(action==='request'&&(!next||!recipient||[r.cons,r.own].indexOf(recipient)<0||recipient==='미지정'))throw Error('알림 수신 담당자와 연락 예정일을 지정하세요.');
 if(action==='schedule'&&!next)throw Error('다음 연락일을 입력하세요.');
 if(action==='resolve'&&!note)throw Error('알림을 해제하는 이유를 적어 주세요.');
 var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(15000);
 try{
  var p=fuProps_(),key=fuStateKey_(r.id),raw=p.getProperty(key),old=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{version:0,history:[]};
  if(Number(input.version)!==Number(old.version))throw Error('다른 사람이 먼저 수정했습니다. 새로고침 후 다시 저장하세요.');
  var event={at:new Date().toISOString(),by:actor.name,action:action,note:note,lastContact:last,nextContact:next,recipient:recipient};
  var data={version:old.version+1,lastContact:last||old.lastContact||'',nextContact:action==='resolve'?'':next,note:note,recipient:action==='request'?recipient:(old.recipient||r.cons),
   requested:action==='request'?true:action==='resolve'||action==='contact'?false:!!old.requested,updatedAt:event.at,updatedBy:actor.name,history:(old.history||[]).concat([event]).slice(-5)};
  var json=JSON.stringify(data),bytes=Utilities.newBlob(json).getBytes().length;
  if(bytes>8500)throw Error('기록이 너무 깁니다. 메모를 줄여 주세요.');
  var all=p.getProperties(),size=Object.keys(all).reduce(function(n,k){return n+Utilities.newBlob(k+all[k]).getBytes().length;},0);
  if(size+bytes>450000)throw Error('연락 기록 저장 공간이 부족합니다. 관리자에게 기록 보관을 요청하세요.');
  p.setProperty(key,json);return data;
 }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}
function issueFollowupAccess(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);if(!actor.admin)throw Error('관리자만 발급할 수 있습니다.');
 var role=String(input.role||'cons'),name=fuText_(input.name,80);if(['cons','own'].indexOf(role)<0||name==='미지정')throw Error('담당자를 선택하세요.');
 if(!fuRows_(actor).some(function(r){return r[role]===name;}))throw Error('원본에 없는 담당자입니다.');
 var token=Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'')+Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');
 var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(15000);
 try{
  var p=fuProps_(),who=fuHash_(role+':'+name),old=p.getProperty('fu_member_'+who);
  if(old)p.deleteProperty('fu_access_'+old);
  var hash=fuHash_(token);p.setProperty('fu_access_'+hash,JSON.stringify({admin:false,name:name,role:role}));p.setProperty('fu_member_'+who,hash);
 }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
 return {name:name,role:role,code:token};
}

/* Source evidence only. Never infer an actual phone call from an edit. */
function fuSourceDate_(value,year){
 var s=String(value||'').trim(),m=s.match(/^(?:(20\d{2})\s*[.\/-]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[.\/-]\s*(\d{1,2})|(\d{1,2})\s*\/\s*(\d{1,2})|(\d{1,2})\s*월\s*(\d{1,2})\s*일)(?!\d)/);
 if(!m)return '';
 var d=String(m[1]||year)+'-'+('0'+(m[2]||m[4]||m[6])).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+(m[3]||m[5]||m[7])).slice(-2);
 try{return fuDate_(d);}catch(e){return '';}
}
function fuNoteEvidence_(notes,year,today){
 var latest={date:'',excerpt:'',inferredYear:false},future=0;
 String(notes||'').split(/\r?\n/).forEach(function(line){
  var s=line.trim().replace(/^[▶►●>*\-\s]+/,'').replace(/^[\[(]\s*/,'');
  // Only dated paragraph headings; ignore embedded grid/permit dates and phone numbers.
  var date=fuSourceDate_(s,year);if(!date)return;
  if(date>today){future++;return;}
  if(date>=latest.date)latest={date:date,excerpt:line.trim().slice(0,160),inferredYear:!/^20\d{2}[.\/-]/.test(s)};
 });
 latest.futureHeadings=future;return latest;
}
function fuObserveNotes_(rows){
 // One compact, private snapshot. No raw M contents or personal fields are stored.
 var lock=LockService.getScriptLock(),locked=false;
 try{
  lock.waitLock(15000);locked=true;
  var p=fuProps_(),all=p.getProperties(),manifest=all.fu_note_manifest?JSON.parse(all.fu_note_manifest):null,map={};
  if(manifest){
   if(!Number.isInteger(manifest.count)||manifest.count<1||manifest.count>60||!/^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/.test(manifest.generation))throw Error('내용 변경 추적 색인 오류');
   var encoded='';for(var j=0;j<manifest.count;j++){var chunk=all['fu_note_'+manifest.generation+'_'+j];if(!chunk)throw Error('내용 변경 추적 저장소를 확인하세요.');encoded+=chunk;}
   map=JSON.parse(Utilities.ungzip(Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(encoded),'application/gzip')).getDataAsString());
  }
  var today=fuToday_(),dirty=false;
  rows.forEach(function(r){
   if(r.duplicate||!r.noteFingerprint)return;
   var key=fuHash_(r.id).slice(0,24),old=map[key],hash=r.noteFingerprint;
   if(!old){old=[hash,today,''];map[key]=old;dirty=true;}
   else if(old[0]!==hash){old=[hash,old[1],today];map[key]=old;dirty=true;}
   r.noteObserved={since:old[1],changed:old[2]};
  });
  if(dirty){
   var data=Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.gzip(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify(map),'application/json')).getBytes());
   var existing=Object.keys(all).reduce(function(n,k){return n+Utilities.newBlob(k+all[k],'text/plain').getBytes().length;},0);
   if(existing+data.length>440000)throw Error('내용 변경 추적 공간이 부족합니다. 관리자 확인이 필요합니다.');
   var gen=Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,''),n=Math.ceil(data.length/7500);
   // Commit the manifest last; do not replace the prior snapshot until all chunks exist.
   for(var k=0;k<n;k++)p.setProperty('fu_note_'+gen+'_'+k,data.slice(k*7500,(k+1)*7500));
   p.setProperty('fu_note_manifest',JSON.stringify({generation:gen,count:n}));
   if(manifest)for(var z=0;z<manifest.count;z++)p.deleteProperty('fu_note_'+manifest.generation+'_'+z);
  }
  return '';
 }catch(e){rows.forEach(function(r){delete r.noteObserved;});return 'M열 변경 감지 미확인: '+e.message;}
 finally{if(locked)lock.releaseLock();}
}

/* Monthly performance-presentation comments shared by every dashboard browser. */
var PRESENTATION_COMMENT_PREFIX = 'performance_presentation_comment_v1_';
var PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX = 10000;

function presentationCommentPeriod_(year, month) {
  var y = Number(year), m = Number(month);
  if (!isFinite(y) || Math.floor(y) !== y || y < 2018 || y > 2100) {
    throw new Error('코멘트 연도를 확인하세요.');
  }
  if (!isFinite(m) || Math.floor(m) !== m || m < 1 || m > 12) {
    throw new Error('코멘트 월을 확인하세요.');
  }
  return { year: y, month: m, key: PRESENTATION_COMMENT_PREFIX + y + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m };
}

function presentationCommentBlank_(period) {
  return { year: period.year, month: period.month, text: '', updatedAt: '', updatedBy: '' };
}

function getPresentationComment(year, month) {
  var period = presentationCommentPeriod_(year, month);
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);
  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    var raw = props.getProperty(period.key);
    if (!raw) return presentationCommentBlank_(period);
    var saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (saved.parts) {
      var chunks = saved.parts.map(function(key) {
        var chunk = props.getProperty(key);
        if (chunk === null) throw new Error('저장된 코멘트 일부를 불러오지 못했습니다. 다시 시도하세요.');
        return chunk;
      });
      saved = JSON.parse(chunks.join(''));
    }
    return {
      year: period.year,
      month: period.month,
      text: String(saved.text || '').slice(0, PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX),
      updatedAt: String(saved.updatedAt || ''),
      updatedBy: String(saved.updatedBy || '')
    };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function presentationCommentCleanup_(props, keys) {
  (keys || []).forEach(function(key) {
    // Cleanup must not turn an already committed save into a failed save.
    try { props.deleteProperty(key); } catch (err) {}
  });
}

function savePresentationComment(input) {
  input = input || {};
  var period = presentationCommentPeriod_(input.year, input.month);
  var text = String(input.text == null ? '' : input.text).replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').trim();
  if (text.length > PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX) {
    throw new Error('코멘트는 ' + PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX + '자까지 저장할 수 있습니다.');
  }
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);
  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    var previous = props.getProperty(period.key);
    var oldParts = [];
    try { oldParts = previous ? (JSON.parse(previous).parts || []) : []; } catch (err) {}
    if (!text) {
      props.deleteProperty(period.key);
      presentationCommentCleanup_(props, oldParts);
      return presentationCommentBlank_(period);
    }
    var email = '';
    try { email = Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail() || ''; } catch (err) { email = ''; }
    var saved = {
      year: period.year,
      month: period.month,
      text: text,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedBy: email
    };
    // Values are limited to 9 KB. Split by Unicode code point so long Korean
    // comments (or emoji) can be saved without breaking a surrogate pair.
    var points = Array.from(JSON.stringify(saved));
    var prefix = period.key + '_part_' + Utilities.getUuid() + '_';
    var parts = [];
    try {
      for (var offset = 0; offset < points.length; offset += 1000) {
        var key = prefix + parts.length;
        parts.push(key);
        props.setProperty(key, points.slice(offset, offset + 1000).join(''));
      }
      // Publish only after every chunk exists; a failed write preserves the old record.
      props.setProperty(period.key, JSON.stringify({parts: parts}));
    } catch (err) {
      presentationCommentCleanup_(props, parts);
      throw err;
    }
    presentationCommentCleanup_(props, oldParts);
    return saved;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/* Read only the requested weekly meeting summaries; never customer rows. */
function collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10() {
  var id = '1DkUE6SYR9uyS3TGzlRTq28yuGluYpnuF2yuyCt_2lx8';
  var result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), spreadsheetId: id, sheets: [], errors: [] };
  try {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh) {
      var m = sh.getName().match(/^(\d{2})\.(\d{2})$/);
      if (!m || Number(m[1]) < 25 || Number(m[2]) < 1 || Number(m[2]) > 12) return;
      try {
        result.sheets.push({ sheet: sh.getName(), gid: sh.getSheetId(), year: 2000 + Number(m[1]), month: Number(m[2]), rows: sh.getRange('J1:O8').getDisplayValues() });
      } catch (e) { result.errors.push(sh.getName() + ': ' + e.message); }
    });
  } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); }
  return result;
}

````

## 2부. 분리된 개발·빌드·배포·테스트 소스

이 파일들은 1부의 두 배포 파일을 재생성하고 검증하는 원본입니다. 비공개 원본 파일과 OAuth 인증값은 포함하지 않습니다.

### .github/workflows/deploy-dashboard.yml

````yaml
name: Deploy dashboard
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: consulting-dashboard-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: github.repository == 'kdhvebiz-a11y/Dashboard' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Build with private inputs
        env:
          CONTRACT_DATA_GZIP_BASE64: ${{ secrets.CONTRACT_DATA_GZIP_BASE64 }}
          FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH: ${{ secrets.FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH }}
        run: node scripts/build-dashboard-v10.mjs
      - name: Test before publishing
        run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs
      - name: Deploy existing Apps Script URL and check health
        env:
          GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/deploy-dashboard.mjs

````

### apps-script/v10/business-parts.js

````javascript
// Keep consulting mounted so draft comments and filters survive tab changes.
(function installBusinessParts(){
 const tabs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-business-part]'));
 if(!tabs.length)return;
 let current='consulting';
 const scrollPositions=new Map();
 function selectPart(part,focus=false){
  const selected=tabs.find(tab=>tab.dataset.businessPart===part);
  if(!selected)return;
  scrollPositions.set(current,window.scrollY);
  tabs.forEach(tab=>{
   const active=tab===selected;
   tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(active));
   tab.tabIndex=active?0:-1;
   document.getElementById(tab.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden=!active;
  });
  current=part;
  document.querySelector('.rail')?.classList.remove('open');
  window.scrollTo({top:scrollPositions.get(part)||0,behavior:'instant'});
  if(focus)selected.focus();
 }
 tabs.forEach((tab,index)=>{
  tab.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPart(tab.dataset.businessPart));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
   let next;
   if(event.key==='ArrowRight')next=(index+1)%tabs.length;
   else if(event.key==='ArrowLeft')next=(index+tabs.length-1)%tabs.length;
   else if(event.key==='Home')next=0;
   else if(event.key==='End')next=tabs.length-1;
   else return;
   event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();selectPart(tabs[next].dataset.businessPart,true);
  });
 });
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-business-return]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>selectPart('consulting',true)));
})();
````

````javascript
/* Contract source: read-only import of the user's RPS workbook detail sheets. */
const CONTRACT_DATA = __CONTRACT_DATA__;
const contractFilter={basis:'report',business:'전체',source:'전체',consultant:'전체',owner:'전체',corporation:'전체',region:'전체',query:''};
const contractBasisLabel=()=>'계약 원장 연도·보고 월';
const contractMoney=n=>n===null?'—':(n/100000000).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})+'억원';
const contractCap=n=>n===null?'—':capS(n).replace('MW','MWp').replace(/kW$/,'kWp');
const contractSourceForYear=year=>CONTRACT_DATA.sources.find(s=>Number(s.reportYear)===Number(year));
function contractGoal(category,months){
 const values=contractSourceForYear(DB.year)?.goals?.[category];
 return Array.isArray(values)?months.reduce((sum,m)=>sum+(Number(values[m-1])||0),0):null;
}
function contractCategoryAggregate(months,category='전체'){
 const rows=CONTRACT_DATA.records.filter(r=>r.reportYear===Number(DB.year)&&months.includes(r.reportMonth)&&!r.cancelled&&(category==='전체'||r.category===category));
 return {rows,count:rows.length,capacity:v10Sum(rows,'capacity')};
}
function contractGoalProgress(){
 const year=Number(DB.year),annual=CONTRACT_ANNUAL_GOALS[year]??null;
 if(annual===null)return '';
 const ms=selMonths(),selected=contractAggregate(ms,{filtered:false}),all=contractAggregate(Array.from({length:12},(_,j)=>j+1),{filtered:false});
 const periodGoal=contractGoal('전체',ms);
 const months=[...new Set(ms)].sort((a,b)=>a-b),contiguous=months.every((m,j)=>j===0||m===months[j-1]+1);
 const period=months.length===1?months[0]+'월':months.length===3&&contiguous&&(months[0]-1)%3===0?`${Math.ceil(months[0]/3)}분기 (${months[0]}~${months[2]}월)`:contiguous?`${months[0]}~${months[months.length-1]}월`:months.map(m=>m+'월').join('·');
 const progress=(title,actual,goal,scope,color)=>{
  const known=actual!==null&&goal!==null&&goal>0,rate=known?pct(actual,goal):0,fmt=n=>d1(n/1000)+'MW';
  const summary=`${goal===null?'목표 미설정':'목표 <b>'+fmt(goal)+'</b>'} ${actual===null?'· 계약 실적 확인 필요':'중 <b>'+fmt(actual)+' 계약</b>'}${known?' · <b>'+d1(rate)+'% 달성</b>':''}`;
  const remaining=!known?'목표 또는 계약 실적을 확인해 주세요.':actual>=goal?`${scope} 목표를 달성했습니다.${actual>goal?' 목표보다 '+fmt(actual-goal)+' 초과':''}`:`${scope} 목표 달성에 <b>${fmt(goal-actual)} 더 필요</b>`;
  return `<div class="v10-goal"><div class="v10-goal-head"><strong>${esc(title)}</strong></div><p class="v10-note">${summary}</p><div class="v10-track"><span style="width:${Math.min(Math.max(rate,0),100)}%;background:${color}"></span></div><small>${remaining}</small></div>`;
 };
 return `<div class="contract-goal-progress">${progress(period+' 목표, 얼마나 달성했나요?',selected.capacity,periodGoal,period,V10.colors[0])}${progress(year+'년 연간 목표, 얼마나 달성했나요?',all.capacity,annual,'연간',V10.colors[4])}<p class="v10-note">위는 원본의 월별 목표 합계와 선택 기간 실적을, 아래는 ${year}년 원장 전체와 연간 목표를 비교합니다.<br>부서 전체 · 계약 원장 연도·보고 월 기준${all.missingCapacity?' · 용량 미기재 '+all.missingCapacity+'건 제외':''}${!CONTRACT_DATA.sources.some(s=>s.reportYear===year)?' · 해당 연도 전체 원장 미연결':''}</p></div>`;
}
const contractMap=r=>r.address?'https://map.kakao.com/link/search/'+encodeURIComponent(r.address):'';
function contractMatch(r){
 return ['business','source','consultant','owner','corporation','region'].every(k=>contractFilter[k]==='전체'||r[k]===contractFilter[k])&&(!contractFilter.query||[r.plant,r.inquiryNo,r.address,r.consultant,r.owner].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(contractFilter.query.toLowerCase()));
}
function contractAggregate(months,{filtered=true,basis='report'}={}){
 const y=Number(DB.year);
 const covered=CONTRACT_DATA.sources.some(s=>s.reportYear===y);
 const candidates=CONTRACT_DATA.records.filter(r=>{
  if(filtered&&!contractMatch(r))return false;
  return r.reportYear===y&&months.includes(r.reportMonth);
 });
 const cancelled=candidates.filter(r=>r.cancelled),rows=candidates.filter(r=>!r.cancelled);
 const capKnown=rows.filter(r=>r.capacity!==null),amountKnown=rows.filter(r=>r.amount!==null);
 return {covered,rows,count:covered?rows.length:null,capacity:covered&&(!rows.length||capKnown.length)?v10Sum(rows,'capacity'):null,amount:covered&&(!rows.length||amountKnown.length)?v10Sum(rows,'amount'):null,
  missingCapacity:rows.length-capKnown.length,missingAmount:rows.length-amountKnown.length,avg:capKnown.length?v10Sum(capKnown,'capacity')/capKnown.length:null,cancelled:cancelled.length,future:0};
}
function contractSourceNote(){
 const s=CONTRACT_DATA.sources;
 return `<p class="v10-note">계약 원본: ${s.map(x=>esc(x.name)).join(', ')}<br>파일 가져온 시각: ${esc(new Date(CONTRACT_DATA.importedAt).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul'}))} · 엑셀 스냅샷 (시트 자동 갱신과 별개)</p>`;
}
function contractControls(all,filters){
 return `<section class="contract-controls"><div class="contract-heading"><h3>계약 원장 연도·보고 월 기준</h3><button class="btn" data-v10-section="followup">담당 상담 · 연락 관리 →</button></div><p class="v10-note">${esc(DB.year)}년 계약 파일에 포함된 행을 ${esc(DB.year)}년 실적으로 보고, 원장의 보고 월로 월별 집계합니다. 계약일은 상세 정보로만 표시합니다.</p><div class="contract-filter-grid">${filters.map(([key,label])=>`<label>${label}<select aria-label="계약 ${label}" data-contract-filter="${key}"><option>전체</option>${[...new Set(all.map(r=>r[key]||'미지정'))].sort().map(v=>`<option ${contractFilter[key]===v?'selected':''}>${esc(v)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`).join('')}<label class="contract-search">발전소 · 주소 · 상담번호<input data-contract-search value="${esc(contractFilter.query)}" placeholder="검색어 입력 후 Enter"></label></div><div class="contract-toolbar"><span class="v10-note">${esc(DB.year)}년 ${esc(periodLabel())} · ${esc(contractBasisLabel())} 기준</span><div><button class="btn" data-contract-action="reset">계약 조건 초기화</button> <button class="btn" data-contract-action="csv">계약 내역 내려받기</button></div></div></section><details class="contract-source"><summary>계약 원본과 집계 안내</summary>${contractSourceNote()}<p>상단 연도·기간과 위 계약 조건을 적용합니다. 문의·미팅 상세 조건은 적용하지 않습니다. ‘그 외’ 유입은 마케팅으로 단정하지 않습니다.</p></details>`;
}
function contractKpis(a){return `<div class="v10-kpis">${v10Card('계약 등록 건수',v10Number(a.count)+' 건','발전소별 원장 행 기준 · 취소 제외',V10.colors[4],'contract')}${v10Card('계약 용량',contractCap(a.capacity),`원본 단위 kWp · 미기재 ${a.missingCapacity}건`,V10.colors[3],'contract')}${v10Card('공사금액 (VAT 제외)',contractMoney(a.amount),`금액 기재분 합계 · 미기재 ${a.missingAmount}건`,V10.colors[0],'contract')}${v10Card('평균 계약 용량',a.avg===null?'—':d1(a.avg)+' kWp','용량 기재 건 기준 평균',V10.colors[5],'contract')}</div>`;}
function contractTable(rows){return v10Table(['발전소 · 위치','계약일 / 보고 월','사업형태','용량 (kWp)','공사금액 (VAT 제외)','컨설팅 / 담당자','유입 / 시공사','상담번호 / 상태','원본'],rows.map(r=>[
 `<strong>${esc(r.plant)}</strong><br>${esc(r.address||'주소 미기재')}${contractMap(r)?`<br><a href="${esc(contractMap(r))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">카카오맵에서 위치 보기 ↗</a>`:''}`,
 `${esc(r.date||r.dateRaw+' (날짜 확인)')}<br><small>${r.reportYear}년 ${r.reportMonth||'미지정'}월</small>`,esc(r.business),r.capacity===null?'—':d1(r.capacity),r.amount===null?'미기재':r.amount.toLocaleString('ko-KR')+'원',`${esc(r.consultant)} / ${esc(r.owner)}`,`${esc(r.source)}<br>${esc(r.corporation)}`,`${esc(r.inquiryNo||'미기재')}<br>${esc(r.status)}`,`${esc(r.sheet)} ${r.row}행`
 ]));}
function contractGroup(rows,key){
 const names=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[key]||'미지정'))];
 return names.map(name=>{const a=rows.filter(r=>(r[key]||'미지정')===name),missing=a.filter(r=>r.amount===null).length;return [key==='consultant'?`<button data-fu-person="${esc(name)}" data-fu-role="cons">${esc(name)} · 상담 보기</button>`:esc(name),i(a.length),contractCap(a.some(r=>r.capacity!==null)?v10Sum(a,'capacity'):null),contractMoney(missing===a.length?null:v10Sum(a,'amount'))+(missing?`<br><small>금액 미기재 ${missing}건</small>`:'')];}).sort((a,b)=>Number(b[1].replaceAll(',',''))-Number(a[1].replaceAll(',','')));
}
function contractView(){
 const a=contractAggregate(selMonths()),axis=easyTrendAxis(),vals=axis.map(g=>contractAggregate(g.months));
 const report=contractFilter.basis==='report';
 const all=CONTRACT_DATA.records.filter(r=>r.reportYear===Number(DB.year)||r.date?.startsWith(DB.year+'-'));
 const filters=[['business','사업형태'],['source','유입'],['consultant','컨설팅 담당'],['owner','현장 담당'],['corporation','시공사'],['region','지역']];
 const issues=CONTRACT_DATA.issues.map(x=>{const r=CONTRACT_DATA.records.find(r=>r.id===x.id);return [esc(r?.sheet||''),r?.row||'',esc(r?.plant||''),esc(x.message),esc(x.value)];});
 const partial=!CONTRACT_DATA.sources.some(s=>s.reportYear===Number(DB.year));
 return easyLead('실제 계약 실적','RPS 계약 원장을 기준으로 계약 건수·용량·공사금액·설치 위치를 확인합니다.',contractBasisLabel())
 +contractControls(all,filters)
 +(partial?'<div class="v10-callout">선택 연도의 전체 계약 파일이 없습니다. 다른 연도 원장에 포함된 계약만 표시되므로 연간 전체 실적으로 사용하지 마세요.</div>':'')
 +contractKpis(a)+(contractGoalProgress()?v10Panel('실제 계약 목표 달성','선택 기간과 연간 계약 용량',contractGoalProgress()):'')
 +`<p class="v10-note">계약서 수가 아닌 발전소별 원장 행을 셉니다. 동일 상담번호의 여러 발전소를 합치지 않습니다. 취소 ${a.cancelled}건 제외. 계약일이 과거 연도이거나 형식 오류여도 ${DB.year}년 원장과 보고 월이 있으면 ${DB.year}년 실적에 포함합니다.</p>`
 +`<div class="v10-grid">${v10Line('계약 건수 추세',contractBasisLabel()+' 기준',axis,[{name:'계약',color:V10.colors[4],values:vals.map(x=>x.count)}])}${v10Line('계약 용량 추세','원본 계약용량 · 단위 kWp',axis,[{name:'계약 용량',color:V10.colors[3],values:vals.map(x=>x.capacity)}],'kWp')}</div>`
 +v10Line('공사금액 추세','VAT 제외 · 금액 기재분만 합산',axis,[{name:'공사금액',color:V10.colors[0],values:vals.map(x=>x.amount===null?null:x.amount/100000000)}],'억원')
 +`<div class="v10-grid">${v10Panel('컨설팅 담당자별 계약','원본 M열 컨설팅',v10Table(['담당자','건수','용량','공사금액'],contractGroup(a.rows,'consultant')))}${v10Panel('사업형태별 계약','사업별 상세 시트 기준',v10Table(['사업형태','건수','용량','공사금액'],contractGroup(a.rows,'business')))}</div>`
 +v10Panel('계약 상세와 위치',`${a.rows.length}행 · 주소 기반 지도 검색 링크이며 현장 좌표를 검증한 것은 아닙니다.`,contractTable(a.rows))
 +`<details class="easy-details"><summary>계약 원본 확인 · 날짜 오류 ${issues.length}건 / 요약 대조</summary>${v10Table(['시트','행','발전소','확인 항목','원본 값'],issues)}${v10Table(['원본 파일','상세 행 수','요약표 건수','상세 용량','요약 용량','상세 공사금액','요약 공사금액'],CONTRACT_DATA.sources.map(s=>[esc(s.name),s.rows,v10Number(s.control.count),capS(s.detailCapacity),capS(s.control.capacity||0),contractMoney(s.detailAmount),contractMoney(s.control.amount??null)]))}<p>집계표의 수식 결과와 상세 원장에 차이가 있어도 원본을 수정하거나 행을 임의 삭제하지 않습니다. 파일명 날짜는 실제 계약일이나 데이터 마감일로 사용하지 않습니다.</p></details>`;
}
function contractReport(){const a=contractAggregate(selMonths(),{filtered:false});return v10Panel('실제 계약 실적','계약 원장 연도·보고 월 기준 · 문의·미팅 조건과 독립',contractSourceNote()+contractKpis(a)+contractGoalProgress());}
VIEWS.contract=contractView;
const contractOldSecondary=easySecondary;
easySecondary=function(a){
 const c=contractAggregate(selMonths(),{filtered:false});
 const label=v10Scoped()?'계약 전용 조회 →':c.covered?`${i(c.count)}건 · ${contractMoney(c.amount)} →`:'해당 연도 자료 없음 →';
 return contractOldSecondary(a).replace('엑셀 자료 대기 →',label);
};
const contractOldInsights=v10Insights;
v10Insights=function(){const c=contractAggregate(selMonths(),{filtered:false}),body=c.covered?`선택 기간 실제 계약은 ${i(c.count)}건, 계약 용량은 ${contractCap(c.capacity)}, 공사금액은 ${contractMoney(c.amount)}입니다.`:'선택 기간에 확인된 실제 계약 원장 실적이 없습니다.';return contractOldInsights().replace(/<h4>계약 분석 대기<\/h4>[\s\S]*?<\/p>/,`<h4>실제 계약 실적</h4><p>${body}</p>`);};
const contractOldReport=VIEWS.report;
VIEWS.report=()=>contractOldReport().replace('계약 자료 안내','실제 계약 상세').replace('계약 확정 실적은 계약 엑셀을 받은 뒤 연결합니다.','계약은 RPS 원장의 계약연도·보고 월을 기준으로 별도 집계합니다.')+contractReport();
const contractOldGoals=VIEWS.goal;
VIEWS.goal=()=>(contractGoalProgress()?v10Panel('실제 계약 목표 달성','선택 기간과 연간 실적',contractGoalProgress()):'')+contractOldGoals().replace('계약 실적은 엑셀 자료 수신 후 연결합니다.','계약 실적은 RPS 엑셀의 계약연도·보고 월 기준입니다.');
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{const k=e.target.dataset?.contractFilter;if(k&&Object.hasOwn(contractFilter,k)){contractFilter[k]=e.target.value;render();}});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.hasAttribute?.('data-contract-search')&&e.key==='Enter'){contractFilter.query=e.target.value.trim();render();}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const b=e.target.closest('[data-contract-action],#v10ResetAll');if(!b)return;
 if(b.id==='v10ResetAll'||b.dataset.contractAction==='reset'){Object.assign(contractFilter,{basis:'report',business:'전체',source:'전체',consultant:'전체',owner:'전체',corporation:'전체',region:'전체',query:''});render();}
 if(b.dataset.contractAction==='csv')v10Download(`계약실적_${DB.year}_${contractBasisLabel()}.csv`,[['발전소','계약일','보고연도','보고월','사업형태','용량(kWp)','공사금액(VAT제외,원)','컨설팅','담당자','유입','시공사','상담번호','상태','설치장소','지도링크','파일','시트','행'],...contractAggregate(selMonths()).rows.map(r=>[r.plant,r.date||r.dateRaw,r.reportYear,r.reportMonth,r.business,r.capacity,r.amount,r.consultant,r.owner,r.source,r.corporation,r.inquiryNo,r.status,r.address,contractMap(r),r.file,r.sheet,r.row])]);
});

````

### apps-script/v10/dashboard.css

````css
/* Working and department-report surfaces. */
:root { --plane:#f3f6fb; --surface:#fff; --ink:#14263d; --ink2:#465974; --muted:#65758b; --s1:#2364d2; --border:#dbe3ef; }
html[data-theme="dark"] { --plane:#101927; --surface:#192638; --ink:#edf3ff; --ink2:#bfcee2; --muted:#9aacbf; --border:#34445b; }
body {font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}
.rail {width:218px;background:var(--surface);padding-top:24px}
.rail .nav {font-size:14px;min-height:42px;margin-bottom:4px}
.rail .nav.on {background:#2364d2;color:white}
.rail .nav.on .ix {color:white}
main.main {margin-left:0}
.periodbar {position:relative;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #17294805}
.filters label,.plabel,.pill,.btn,.seg button,.basis-note {font-size:14px}
.filters select,.filters input {font-size:14px;min-height:38px}
.v10-top {display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.v10-top label {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px}
.v10-top select {background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font:inherit}
.v10-top .version {margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.v10-reset {background:#edf3ff!important;color:#194fa7!important;border-color:#b8cdf0!important;font-weight:600}
.v10-banner {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;border-left:4px solid #2364d2;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:18px}
.v10-banner h2 {font-size:21px;margin:0 0 4px}
.v10-banner p {margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.v10-kpis {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.v10-kpi {display:block;text-align:left;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-top:3px solid var(--metric);border-radius:12px;padding:17px;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.v10-kpi:hover {box-shadow:0 4px 18px #17407114;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v10-kpi .label {font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-kpi strong {display:block;font-size:29px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.7px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v10-kpi small {display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
.v10-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
.v10-panel {background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:18px;min-width:0;break-inside:avoid}
.v10-grid>.v10-panel {margin-bottom:0}
.v10-panel h3 {font-size:17px;margin:0 0 4px}
.v10-note {color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:4px 0 14px}
.v10-table {overflow:auto}
.v10-table table {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.v10-table th {background:var(--plane);color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600;padding:11px 12px;text-align:right}
.v10-table td {padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v10-table th:first-child,.v10-table td:first-child {text-align:left}
.v10-table tr:last-child td {border-bottom:0}
.v10-table button {border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--s1);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.v10-empty {padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:12px}
.v10-callout {padding:14px 18px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff5df;color:#714809;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.v10-pair {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.v10-goal {padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.v10-goal-head {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.v10-track {height:8px;background:var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.v10-track span {display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px;background:var(--s1)}
.v10-goal small {color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.v10-settings {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:15px 0}
.v10-settings label {font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-settings input {display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font:inherit}
.v10-actions {display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}
.v10-panel textarea {width:100%;min-height:115px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
.v10-insight {border-left:3px solid #d08a13;padding:8px 16px;margin:14px 0}
.v10-insight h4 {font-size:16px;margin:0 0 5px}
.v10-insight p {margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.v10-panel svg text {font-size:12px}
.v10-panel .chart {overflow:hidden}
.v10-unit {font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.v10-status {font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(min-width:1600px){.v10-kpis {grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:1100px){.v10-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v10-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:760px){.rail{width:200px}.v10-top .version{margin-left:0}.v10-settings{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v10-kpis{gap:8px}.v10-kpi{padding:12px}.v10-kpi strong{font-size:24px}.v10-banner{display:block}.v10-panel{padding:14px}main.main{margin-left:0}}
@media print{
 @page{size:A4 landscape;margin:12mm}
 .rail,.periodbar,.topbar,.basis-note,.foot,.v10-actions,.v10-top,button,.v10-no-print{display:none!important}
 main,main.main,.main,.shell{display:block!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;max-width:none!important}
 body,html{background:#fff!important;color:#14263d!important;font-size:12px;print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
 .v10-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v10-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
 .v10-kpi{display:block!important;padding:10px}.v10-kpi strong{font-size:23px}
 .v10-panel{padding:12px;break-inside:avoid}.v10-table{overflow:visible}.v10-table table{font-size:11px;white-space:normal}
 .v10-table th,.v10-table td{padding:6px}.v10-table button{display:inline!important;color:inherit}
 textarea{border:0!important;resize:none;overflow:visible}.v10-print-break{break-before:page}
}

````

### apps-script/v10/dashboard.js

````javascript
/* v10: shared reporting model; no write operation against source worksheets. */
const V10 = { payload:null, current:null, selectedYear:null, booted:false,
  colors:['#2364d2','#d38a00','#e36535','#8b5ac4','#139b78','#cf5185'],
  localGoals:store.get('v10_goals',{}), reportNotes:store.get('v10_reportNotes',{}) };
const v10Today = () => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('sv-SE',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());
const v10Corp = value => /^(?:SP|그랜드썬SP)$/i.test(txt(value)) ? 'SP' : /UGS|유지에스|유지스/i.test(txt(value)) ? 'UGS' : /그랜드|그랜/.test(txt(value)) ? '그랜드썬' : txt(value)||'미분류';
const v10Source = value => /소개/.test(txt(value)) ? '소개' : /마케팅/.test(txt(value)) ? '마케팅' : '미분류';
const v10OriginalRegion=regionOf;
regionOf=function(value){return [...RG_ORDER,'기타','미분류'].includes(txt(value))?txt(value):v10OriginalRegion(value);};
const v10Date = value => { const m=txt(value).match(/(20\d{2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})/); return m ? `${m[1]}-${m[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${m[3].padStart(2,'0')}` : ''; };
const v10Number = value => value===null || value===undefined ? '—' : i(value);
const v10Rate = (a,b) => a===null || b===null || !b ? '—' : pctS(a,b);
const v10Sum = (rows,key) => rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(Number(r[key])||0),0);
const v10Panel = (title,sub,body) => `<section class="v10-panel"><h3>${esc(title)}</h3><p class="v10-note">${esc(sub||'')}</p>${body}</section>`;
const v10Empty = text => `<div class="v10-empty">${esc(text)}</div>`;
function v10Table(headers,rows){return `<div class="v10-table"><table><thead><tr>${headers.map(h=>`<th>${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.length?rows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map(x=>`<td>${x}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join(''):`<tr><td colspan="${headers.length}">선택 조건에 해당하는 데이터가 없습니다.</td></tr>`}</tbody></table></div>`;}
function v10Card(label,value,note,color,section){return `<button class="v10-kpi" style="--metric:${color}" data-v10-section="${section}"><span class="label">${esc(label)}</span><strong>${esc(value)}</strong><small>${esc(note)}</small></button>`;}
function v10Line(title,sub,axis,series,unit='건',options={}){
 const usable=series.filter(s=>s.values.some(v=>v!==null));
 if(!usable.length) return v10Panel(title,sub,v10Empty('이 조건의 추세를 계산할 자료가 없습니다.'));
 // Unknown values are not converted into zeroes. Separate contiguous known segments.
 const known=axis.map((_,ix)=>usable.every(s=>s.values[ix]!==null));
 const ix=axis.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>known[i]);
 if(!ix.length)return v10Panel(title,sub,v10Empty('이 조건의 추세를 계산할 자료가 없습니다.'));
 return v10Panel(title,sub+(known.some(x=>!x)?' · 자료 없는 기간 제외':''),chartLine({labels:ix.map(i=>axis[i].label),series:usable.map(s=>({...s,values:ix.map(i=>s.values[i])})),unit,height:245,...options}));
}
const v10OriginalRebuild = rebuild;
function v10GroupedBars(title,sub,axis,series,unit='건'){
 const usable=series.filter(s=>s.values.some(v=>v!==null&&v!==undefined));
 const ix=axis.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>usable.length&&usable.every(s=>s.values[i]!==null&&s.values[i]!==undefined));
 if(!ix.length)return v10Panel(title,sub,v10Empty('이 조건의 실적을 계산할 자료가 없습니다.'));
 return v10Panel(title,sub+(ix.length<axis.length?' · 자료 없는 기간 제외':''),chartBars({labels:ix.map(i=>axis[i].label),series:usable.map(s=>({...s,values:ix.map(i=>s.values[i])})),unit,height:270,stacked:false}));
}
rebuild = function(tongye,mal,source){
 if(!Array.isArray(tongye)||!Array.isArray(mal))throw new Error('통계·말 시트가 필요합니다.');
 // The original parser assumes a nonempty meeting ledger. An empty new year is valid.
 if(tongye.some((r,i)=>i>=4&&txt(r[3])))v10OriginalRebuild(tongye,mal,source);
 else { const p=parseMal(mal); DB={ledger:[],...p,sum:parseTongyeSummary(tongye),regions:parseRegionTables(tongye),regionDefs:parseRegionDefs(tongye),sectors:parseSectors(tongye),owners:parseOwnerStats(tongye),source,stamp:Date.now()}; }
 const sheetYear=Number(at(tongye,0,5));
 DB.year=String(sheetYear>=2025?sheetYear:Number(DB.year)||Number(v10Today().slice(0,4)));
 DB.ledger=DB.ledger.map(r=>({...r,corp:v10Corp(r.corp),src:v10Source(r.src),year:Number(DB.year),meetingYear:Number(r.date.slice(0,4))||Number(DB.year)}));
 V10.current=DB;
 const y=V10.selectedYear||Number(DB.year);
 v10ActivateYear(y,false);
 if(!V10.booted){v10CurrentMonth();V10.booted=true;}
};
function v10AcceptPayload(d,source){
 if(d?.error)throw new Error(d.error);
 if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.tongye)||!Array.isArray(d.mal))throw new Error('통계·말 시트 응답을 확인해 주세요.');
 V10.payload=d; rebuild(d.tongye,d.mal,source);
 DB.stamp=d.at||Date.now(); if(V10.current)V10.current.stamp=DB.stamp;
}
function v10Years(){
 const p=V10.payload||{};
 return [...new Set([Number(V10.current?.year),...Object.keys(p.yearSheets||{}).map(Number),...Object.keys(p.yearData||{}).map(Number)])].filter(y=>y>=2025&&y<=2100).sort((a,b)=>b-a);
}
function v10LegacyYear(y){
 const raw=V10.payload?.yearSheets?.[y]; if(!raw)return null;
 return raw.filter(v=>v.slice(1,9).some(x=>txt(x))).map(v=>{
  const match=txt(v[0]).match(/^(?:(sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-/i),date=v10Date(v[7]);
  return {no:txt(v[0]),year:Number(y),cmo:match?Number(match[2]):0,date,em:Number(date.slice(5,7)),meetingYear:Number(date.slice(0,4)),
   ct:txt(v[1]),src:/소개/.test(txt(v[1]))?'소개':txt(v[1])?'마케팅':'미분류',type:txt(v[2]),reg:regionOf(v[3]),prop:txt(v[4]),cons:txt(v[5]),own:txt(v[6])||'미지정',cap:num(v[8]),corp:match?.[1]?v10Corp(match[1]):'그랜드썬'};
 });
}
function v10ActivateYear(y,draw=true){
 y=Number(y);V10.selectedYear=y;
 if(y===Number(V10.current?.year))DB=V10.current;
 else {
  const records=V10.payload?.yearData?.[y]?.records || v10LegacyYear(y) || [];
  DB={year:String(y),ledger:records.filter(r=>r.date).map(r=>({...r,corp:v10Corp(r.corp),src:v10Source(r.src)})),inquiries:records,
   months:[],msum:[],years:[],sum:null,sectors:[],regions:[],regionDefs:[],owners:null,source:'연도별 문의 원장',stamp:V10.payload?.at||Date.now(),rawYear:true};
 }
 if(draw){state.owner='전체';state.cons='전체';state.type='전체';state.src='전체';state.corp='전체';state.query='';state.region='전체';v10CurrentMonth();refreshFilters();render();}
}
function v10CurrentMonth(){state.mode='month';state.quarters=[];state.months=[Number(v10Today().slice(5,7))];}
// All twelve months remain selectable, including a new or empty month.
dataMonths = () => Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>i+1);
function v10ObservedMonths(){
 const all=new Set();
 DB.ledger.forEach(r=>{if(r.cmo)all.add(r.cmo);if(r.em&&r.meetingYear===Number(DB.year))all.add(r.em);});
 (DB.sum?.months||[]).forEach(r=>{if(r.inq||r.mt)all.add(r.m);});
 (DB.months||[]).forEach(r=>{if(r.mtTot?.n||r.inq?.total)all.add(r.m);});
 return [...all].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}
function v10TrendAxis(){
 if(state.mode==='quarter')return compareGroups();
 if(state.mode==='cumulative')return compareGroups();
 if(state.mode==='month'&&state.months.length>1)return compareGroups();
 const selected=selMonths(),end=Math.max(...v10ObservedMonths(),...selected,1);
 return Array.from({length:end},(_,i)=>({label:`${i+1}월`,months:[i+1]}));
}
function v10Match(r,ignore){
 if(ignore!=='own'&&state.owner!=='전체'&&r.own!==state.owner)return false;
 if(ignore!=='cons'&&state.cons!=='전체'&&(txt(r.cons)||'미지정')!==state.cons)return false;
 if(ignore!=='type'&&state.type!=='전체'&&r.type!==state.type)return false;
 if(ignore!=='src'&&state.src!=='전체'&&v10Source(r.src)!==state.src)return false;
 if(ignore!=='corp'&&state.corp!=='전체'&&v10Corp(r.corp)!==v10Corp(state.corp))return false;
 if(ignore!=='reg'&&state.region&&state.region!=='전체'&&regionOf(r.reg)!==state.region&&r.reg!==state.region)return false;
 const q=state.query.trim().toLowerCase();
 return !q||[r.no,r.own,r.cons,r.reg,r.type,r.corp].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q);
}
function v10ReportWeekBounds(label,month){
 const match=txt(label).match(/(\d{1,2})\s*\/\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[~～]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*\/\s*(\d{1,2})/);
 if(!match)return null;
 const sm=Number(match[1]),em=Number(match[3]),year=Number(DB.year),sy=sm>Number(month)?year-1:year,ey=em<sm?sy+1:sy;
 const iso=(y,m,d)=>`${y}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
 return {start:iso(sy,sm,match[2]),end:iso(ey,em,match[4])};
}
function v10ReportRanges(ms){
 return ms.flatMap(m=>(DB.months?.find(x=>x.m===m)?.wmeet||[]).map(w=>v10ReportWeekBounds(w.label,m)).filter(Boolean));
}
function v10ReportPeriodLabel(ms){
 const ranges=v10ReportRanges(ms).sort((a,b)=>a.start.localeCompare(b.start));
 return ranges.length?'보고 주차 기준 · '+ranges[0].start.slice(5).replace('-','/')+'~'+ranges[ranges.length-1].end.slice(5).replace('-','/'):'미팅일 기준 · 보고 주차 자료 없음';
}
function v10Rows(ms,basis=state.basis,ignore){
 if(basis==='exec'){
  // A reporting month owns complete source weeks, including adjacent calendar months.
  const ranges=v10ReportRanges(ms),withoutRanges=ms.filter(m=>!v10ReportRanges([m]).length);
  return DB.ledger.filter(r=>r.date&&v10Match(r,ignore)&&(ranges.some(w=>r.date>=w.start&&r.date<=w.end)||(withoutRanges.includes(r.em)&&r.meetingYear===Number(DB.year)&&r.date<=v10Today()&&r.meetingYear>=r.year)));
 }
 return DB.ledger.filter(r=>r.date&&r.date<=v10Today()&&r.meetingYear>=r.year&&v10Match(r,ignore)&&ms.includes(basis==='exec'?r.em:r.cmo)&&(basis!=='exec'||r.meetingYear===Number(DB.year)));
}
function v10Scoped(){return state.owner!=='전체'||state.cons!=='전체'||state.type!=='전체'||state.src!=='전체'||state.corp!=='전체'||(state.region&&state.region!=='전체')||!!state.query;}
function v10ReportLedgerComplete(ms){
 return ms.every(m=>{
  const block=DB.months?.find(x=>x.m===m),ranges=v10ReportRanges([m]);
  if(!ranges.length||!block?.mtTot)return false;
  const rows=DB.ledger.filter(r=>r.date&&ranges.some(w=>r.date>=w.start&&r.date<=w.end));
  return rows.length===block.mtTot.n&&Math.abs(v10Sum(rows,'cap')-block.mtTot.cap)<0.1;
 });
}
function v10Aggregate(ms){
 const rows=v10Rows(ms,'cohort'),exeRows=v10Rows(ms,'exec');
 const led=sumRows(rows),run=sumRows(exeRows);
 let total=null,power=null,inqMk=null,inqRef=null,pwrMk=null,pwrRef=null;
 let actualN=run.n,actualCap=run.cap,actualMk=run.mk,actualRef=run.ref,actualSource='통계 미팅 원장 · 보고 주차',cohortSource='통계 미팅 원장 · 문의월';
 const sum=sumFor(ms),sector=sectorFor(ms);
 const unknownPerson=state.owner!=='전체'||state.cons!=='전체'||!!state.query||(state.region&&state.region!=='전체');
 if(DB.rawYear){
  const iq=DB.inquiries.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.cmo)&&v10Match(r));
  total=iq.length;power=iq.filter(r=>/^발전사업/.test(r.type)).length;
  inqMk=iq.filter(r=>r.src==='마케팅').length;inqRef=iq.filter(r=>r.src==='소개').length;
  pwrMk=iq.filter(r=>/^발전사업/.test(r.type)&&r.src==='마케팅').length;pwrRef=iq.filter(r=>/^발전사업/.test(r.type)&&r.src==='소개').length;
 } else {
  if(!unknownPerson&&state.type==='전체'&&state.src==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체')total=sum?sum.inq:inqFor(ms).total;
  if(!unknownPerson&&state.type==='전체'&&state.src==='전체'&&state.corp!=='전체'){
   const key=CORP_KEY[state.corp];total=key?(DB.msum||[]).filter(x=>ms.includes(x.m)).reduce((s,r)=>s+(r[key]||0),0):null;
  }
  if(!unknownPerson&&state.type==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체'){
   const q=inqFor(ms);inqMk=q.mk;inqRef=q.ref;
   if(state.src==='마케팅')total=q.mk;
   if(state.src==='소개')total=q.ref;
  }
  if(!unknownPerson){
   // Summary row is the authoritative development-inquiry total; sector table supplies available breakdowns.
   if(state.type==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체'&&sum){pwrMk=sum.pwrMk;pwrRef=sum.pwrRef;power=state.src==='마케팅'?pwrMk:state.src==='소개'?pwrRef:sum.pwr;}
   else if(state.type==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체'&&DB.msum?.length){const q=inqFor(ms);pwrMk=q.mkPwr;pwrRef=q.refPwr;power=state.src==='마케팅'?pwrMk:state.src==='소개'?pwrRef:pwrMk+pwrRef;}
   else if(DB.sectors?.some(b=>b.rows.length)){power=sector.tot.inq.tot;pwrMk=grpMk(sector.tot.inq);pwrRef=sector.tot.inq.ref;}
  }
  const coarse=state.cons==='전체'&&state.type==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체'&&!state.query&&(!state.region||state.region==='전체');
  if(coarse&&state.owner==='전체'){
   const m=malMeetFor(ms);actualSource='말 시트 · 보고 주차 기준';
   actualN=state.src==='마케팅'?m.mkN:state.src==='소개'?m.refN:m.n;
   actualCap=state.src==='마케팅'?m.mkCap:state.src==='소개'?m.refCap:m.cap;
   actualMk=state.src==='소개'?0:m.mkN;actualRef=state.src==='마케팅'?0:m.refN;
  }else if(coarse&&!v10ReportLedgerComplete(ms)){
   const o=malOwnersFor(ms).find(r=>r.name===state.owner);
   if(o){actualN=state.src==='마케팅'?o.mkN:state.src==='소개'?o.refN:o.n;actualCap=state.src==='마케팅'?o.mkCap:state.src==='소개'?o.refCap:o.cap;actualSource='말 시트 · 미팅 담당자별';actualMk=state.src==='소개'?0:o.mkN;actualRef=state.src==='마케팅'?0:o.refN;}
  }
 }
 if(!DB.rawYear&&state.corp!=='전체'&&state.src==='소개'){total=null;power=null;pwrMk=null;pwrRef=null;inqMk=null;inqRef=null;}
 const provisional=(sum&&!v10Scoped())?sum.ctr:led.ctr;
 return {total,power,inqMk,inqRef,pwrMk,pwrRef,cohort:led.n,powerCohort:rows.filter(r=>/^발전사업/.test(r.type)).length,cohortCap:led.cap,actual:actualN,actualCap,actualMk,actualRef,avg:actualN?actualCap/actualN:0,
  provisional,provisionalCap:led.ctrCap,actualSource,cohortSource,rows,exeRows,scheduled:v10ReportRanges(ms).length?exeRows.filter(r=>r.date>v10Today()).length:DB.ledger.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.em)&&r.meetingYear===Number(DB.year)&&r.date>v10Today()&&v10Match(r)).length,
  gap:actualN-run.n,contractConfirmed:null};
}
const CONTRACT_ANNUAL_GOALS={2026:150000}; // kWp; 150 MW annual commitment.
function v10GoalMonth(m){
 const saved=V10.localGoals[`${DB.year}-${m}`];if(saved)return {...saved,source:'직접 설정 · 이 브라우저'};
 const x=DB.msum?.find(x=>x.m===m);
 const reportWeeks=DB.months?.find(x=>x.m===m)?.wmeet?.length||0;
 const stated=reportWeeks?reportWeeks*17:num(V10.payload?.mal?.[0]?.[86]);
 const sourceGoal=typeof contractGoal==='function'?contractGoal('전체',[m]):null;
 return {total:EASY_INQUIRY_TARGETS.monthly,power:DB.rawYear?null:GOAL.inqPwr,meeting:DB.rawYear?null:(stated>0?stated:null),contractCount:null,contractCap:sourceGoal??(x?.goalCtr>0?x.goalCtr:null),source:sourceGoal!==null?'전체 문의 월 1,500건 / 주 17건 × 보고 주차 수 / RPS 원장 월별 계약 목표':'전체 문의 월 1,500건 / 주 17건 × 보고 주차 수 / CE 계약 용량'};

function v10Goals(ms){

 const all=ms.map(v10GoalMonth),out={};
 ['total','power','meeting','contractCount','contractCap'].forEach(k=>out[k]=all.every(x=>x[k]!==null&&x[k]!==undefined)?v10Sum(all,k):null);
 return out;

function v10GoalBar(label,actual,goal,unit,color){
 const has=goal!==null&&goal>0&&actual!==null,p=has?pct(actual,goal):0;
 const format=n=>unit==='MW'?d1(n):v10Number(n);
 return `<div class="v10-goal"><div class="v10-goal-head"><span>${esc(label)}</span><b>${has?d1(p)+'%':'—'}</b></div><div class="v10-track"><span style="width:${Math.min(p,100)}%;background:${color}"></span></div><small>${actual===null?'실적 미확정':format(actual)+unit} / ${goal===null?'목표 미설정':format(goal)+unit} ${has?' · '+(actual>=goal?'목표 달성':`잔여 ${format(goal-actual)}${unit}`):''}</small></div>`;

  v10Card('접수월 기준 미팅',i(a.cohort)+' 건','선택한 달의 문의가 이후 미팅으로 이어진 건',c[2],'meetCoh'),

  v10Card('평균 미팅 용량',d1(a.avg)+' kW',`실제 미팅 ${i(a.actual)}건 기준`,c[5],'capacity'),

function v10PeriodTable(){

 if(role==='own'&&basis==='exec'&&!DB.rawYear&&!v10ReportLedgerComplete(ms)&&state.cons==='전체'&&state.type==='전체'&&state.corp==='전체'&&!state.query&&(!state.region||state.region==='전체')){
  people=malOwnersFor(ms).filter(o=>state.owner==='전체'||o.name===state.owner).map(o=>{
   const mk=state.src==='소개'?0:o.mkN,ref=state.src==='마케팅'?0:o.refN,n=mk+ref;
   const cap=(state.src==='소개'?0:o.mkCap)+(state.src==='마케팅'?0:o.refCap);
   return {...o,mk,ref,n,cap,avg:n?cap/n:0,ctr:null};
  });
  // The monthly owner table has a fixed number of name slots. If its named
  // rows do not add up to the authoritative monthly total, keep the difference
  // visible instead of silently dropping those meetings.
  if(state.owner==='전체'){
   const all=malMeetFor(ms),targetMk=state.src==='소개'?0:all.mkN,targetRef=state.src==='마케팅'?0:all.refN;
   const targetMkCap=state.src==='소개'?0:all.mkCap,targetRefCap=state.src==='마케팅'?0:all.refCap;
   const used=people.reduce((o,p)=>({mk:o.mk+p.mk,ref:o.ref+p.ref,mkCap:o.mkCap+(state.src==='소개'?0:p.mkCap),refCap:o.refCap+(state.src==='마케팅'?0:p.refCap)}),{mk:0,ref:0,mkCap:0,refCap:0});
   const mk=Math.max(0,targetMk-used.mk),ref=Math.max(0,targetRef-used.ref),mkCap=Math.max(0,targetMkCap-used.mkCap),refCap=Math.max(0,targetRefCap-used.refCap),n=mk+ref,cap=mkCap+refCap;
   if(n||cap)people.push({name:'담당자별 표 미분류',mk,ref,n,mkCap,refCap,cap,avg:n?cap/n:0,ctr:null});
  }
  people.sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n);source='말 시트 담당자 집계';
 }
 return {people,source};
}
function v10PeoplePanel(role,basis){

 ])));

function v10Breakdown(kind){

 const data=names.map(name=>{

   if(DB.rawYear){const ir=DB.inquiries.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.cmo)&&(kind==='src'?r.src===name:r.corp===name));iq=ir.length;power=ir.filter(r=>/^발전사업/.test(r.type)).length;}
````
