````javascript
/* Private follow-up workspace. No personal fields are added to public JSON/cache. */
var FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH_ = '__FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH__';
function fuHash_(s) { return Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,String(s),Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).map(function(b){return ('0'+((b+256)%256).toString(16)).slice(-2);}).join(''); }
function fuProps_(){return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();}
function fuToday_(){return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(),'Asia/Seoul','yyyy-MM-dd');}
function fuDate_(s){s=String(s||'');if(!s)return '';if(!/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)||isNaN(new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z').getTime())||new Date(s+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==s)throw Error('날짜 형식을 확인하세요.');return s;}
function fuAuth_(code){
 if(typeof code!=='string'||code.length<20||code.length>100)throw Error('접속 코드를 확인하세요.');
 var hash=fuHash_(code);
 if(hash===FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH_)return {admin:true,name:'관리자',role:'all'};
 var p=fuProps_(),raw=p.getProperty('fu_access_'+hash);
 if(raw)return JSON.parse(raw);
 var sessionRaw=p.getProperty('fu_session_'+hash);
 if(sessionRaw){
  try{
   var session=JSON.parse(sessionRaw);
   // A remembered browser stays authorized until the user explicitly signs
   // out (or an administrator revokes its token). Legacy 180-day sessions
   // are intentionally accepted as permanent so existing registrations are
   // not interrupted by this policy change.
   if(session.actor)return session.actor;
  }catch(ignore){}
  p.deleteProperty('fu_session_'+hash);
 }
 throw Error('접속 코드가 올바르지 않거나 해제되었습니다.');
}
function fuActor_(code){
 // The dashboard owner is already authenticated by Google. When Apps Script
 // can identify that signed-in account, open the protected workspace without
 // asking for a second code. Public/anonymous visitors have no active email
 // here and still fall back to the scoped access-code check below.
 try{
  if(typeof Session!=='undefined'){
   var active=String(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail()||'').toLowerCase();
   var effective=String(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail()||'').toLowerCase();
   if(active&&effective&&active===effective)return {admin:true,name:'관리자',role:'all',google:true};
  }
 }catch(ignore){}
 return fuAuth_(code);
}
function fuAllowed_(actor,r){return actor.admin||r[actor.role]===actor.name;}
function rememberFollowupAccess(code){
 var actor=fuActor_(code),token=Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'')+Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');
 var p=fuProps_(),hash=fuHash_(token),all=p.getProperties();
 Object.keys(all).filter(function(k){return k.indexOf('fu_session_')===0;}).forEach(function(k){try{if(!JSON.parse(all[k]).actor)p.deleteProperty(k);}catch(ignore){p.deleteProperty(k);}});
 p.setProperty('fu_session_'+hash,JSON.stringify({actor:{admin:!!actor.admin,name:actor.name,role:actor.role},persistent:true,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}));
 return {code:token,persistent:true};
}
function forgetFollowupAccess(code){
 if(typeof code==='string'&&code.length>=20&&code.length<=100)fuProps_().deleteProperty('fu_session_'+fuHash_(code));
 return true;
}
function fuText_(s,max){return String(s||'').trim().slice(0,max||500);}
function fuStatus_(s){
 s=String(s||'').replace(/\s/g,'');
 if(/종료|취소|거절|포기|실주/.test(s))return '종료';
 if(/계약/.test(s)&&!/미계약|계약전|계약예정|계약검토|계약대기/.test(s))return '계약';
 if(/진행|상담|미팅|검토|제안|대기|보류|예정/.test(s))return '진행 중';
 if(/미계약/.test(s))return '미계약';
 return '미분류';
}
function fuContact_(v){
 var contact=String(v[3]||''),notes=String(v[12]||''),phones=contact.match(/(?:\+82[- .]?)?0?\d{1,2}[- .]?\d{3,4}[- .]?\d{4}/g)||[];
 var emails=contact.match(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/ig)||[];
 var name=contact;phones.concat(emails).forEach(function(s){name=name.replace(s,'');});
 return {customer:name.replace(/^[\s,;/]+|[\s,;/]+$/g,'').trim(),phone:phones.join(' / '),email:emails.join(' / '),address:String(v[4]||'')};
}
function fuExtract_(v,headers){
 var base=fuContact_(v),contact=String(v[3]||''),notes=String(v[12]||'');
 function field(rx,lineRx){var out=[];headers.forEach(function(h,i){if(i>=13&&rx.test(h)&&v[i])out.push(String(v[i]));});return out.length?out.join('\n'):notes.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function(s){return lineRx.test(s);}).join('\n');}
 return Object.assign(base,{contactRaw:contact,content:notes,kepco:field(/한전|선로|계통/,/한전|선로|계통/),municipality:field(/지자체|개발행위|인허가/,/지자체|개발행위|인허가/)});
}
function fuRows_(actor){
 var ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID),out=[];
 ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh){
  var year=Number(sh.getName());if(!/^20\d{2}$/.test(sh.getName())||year<2025||sh.getLastRow()<3)return;
  var values=sh.getRange(3,1,sh.getLastRow()-2,13).getDisplayValues();
  values.forEach(function(v,ix){
   var no=String(v[0]||'').trim(),m=no.match(/^(?:(?:sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-\d+/i);
   if(!m||Number(m[1])<1||Number(m[1])>12||(!v[2]&&!v[3]&&!v[12]))return;
   var r={id:year+':'+no.toLowerCase(),no:no,year:year,month:Number(m[1]),sourceRow:ix+3,sourceSheet:sh.getName(),gid:sh.getSheetId(),
    statusRaw:String(v[1]||''),status:fuStatus_(v[1]),type:String(v[2]||''),cons:String(v[6]||'').trim()||'미지정',own:String(v[7]||'').trim()||'미지정',meetingDate:String(v[9]||''),capacity:String(v[10]||'')};
   if(fuAllowed_(actor,r))out.push(Object.assign(r,fuContact_(v),{meetingISO:fuSourceDate_(v[9],year),noteEvidence:fuNoteEvidence_(v[12],year,fuToday_()),noteFingerprint:fuHash_(String(v[12]||'')).slice(0,24)}));
  });
 });
 var counts={};out.forEach(function(r){counts[r.id]=(counts[r.id]||0)+1;});out.forEach(function(r){r.duplicate=counts[r.id]>1;});return out;
}
function fuStateKey_(id){return 'fu_record_'+fuHash_(id);}
function getFollowupWorkspace(code){
 var actor=fuActor_(code),rows=fuRows_(actor),observationWarning=fuObserveNotes_(rows),props=fuProps_().getProperties();
 rows.forEach(function(r){r.followup=props[fuStateKey_(r.id)]?JSON.parse(props[fuStateKey_(r.id)]):{version:0,lastContact:'',nextContact:'',note:'',history:[]};});
 rows.forEach(function(r){delete r.noteFingerprint;});
 return {actor:actor,rows:rows,at:new Date().toISOString(),today:fuToday_(),observationWarning:observationWarning};
}
function getFollowupDetail(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);input=input||{};
 var year=Number(input.year),row=Number(input.sourceRow),id=String(input.id||'');
 if(!/^20\d{2}$/.test(String(year))||year<2025||!Number.isInteger(row)||row<3||id.indexOf(year+':')!==0)throw Error('상담 위치를 확인하세요.');
 var ss=SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID),sh=ss.getSheetByName(String(year));
 if(!sh||row>sh.getLastRow())throw Error('원본 상담을 찾을 수 없습니다.');
 var cols=Math.min(sh.getMaxColumns(),40),headers=sh.getRange(1,1,2,cols).getDisplayValues();
 var names=headers[0].map(function(x,i){return String(x)+' '+headers[1][i];});
 var dataCols=13;names.forEach(function(h,i){if(i>=13&&/한전|선로|계통|지자체|개발행위|인허가/.test(h))dataCols=i+1;});
 var v=sh.getRange(row,1,1,dataCols).getDisplayValues()[0],no=String(v[0]||'').trim(),m=no.match(/^(?:(?:sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-\d+/i);
 if(!m||(year+':'+no.toLowerCase())!==id)throw Error('원본 상담번호가 변경되었습니다. 목록을 새로고침하세요.');
 var r={id:id,no:no,year:year,month:Number(m[1]),sourceRow:row,sourceSheet:String(year),gid:sh.getSheetId(),statusRaw:String(v[1]||''),status:fuStatus_(v[1]),type:String(v[2]||''),cons:String(v[6]||'').trim()||'미지정',own:String(v[7]||'').trim()||'미지정',meetingDate:String(v[9]||''),capacity:String(v[10]||'')};
 if(!fuAllowed_(actor,r))throw Error('이 상담의 조회 권한이 없습니다.');
 var p=fuProps_(),raw=p.getProperty(fuStateKey_(id));
 r.followup=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{version:0,lastContact:'',nextContact:'',note:'',history:[]};
 return Object.assign(r,fuExtract_(v,names),{meetingISO:fuSourceDate_(v[9],year),noteEvidence:fuNoteEvidence_(v[12],year,fuToday_())});
}
function saveFollowupRecord(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);input=input||{};
 var rows=fuRows_(actor).filter(function(r){return r.id===input.id;});
 if(rows.length!==1)throw Error('상담번호가 중복되었거나 조회 권한이 없습니다. 원본을 확인하세요.');
 var r=rows[0],next=fuDate_(input.nextContact),last=fuDate_(input.lastContact),today=fuToday_();
 if(last&&last>today)throw Error('마지막 연락일은 오늘 이후로 저장할 수 없습니다.');
 var note=fuText_(input.note,300),recipient=fuText_(input.recipient,80),action=String(input.action||'schedule');
 if(['schedule','contact','request','resolve'].indexOf(action)<0)throw Error('알 수 없는 처리입니다.');
 if(action==='contact'&&!last)throw Error('연락한 날짜를 입력하세요.');
 if(action==='request'&&(!next||!recipient||[r.cons,r.own].indexOf(recipient)<0||recipient==='미지정'))throw Error('알림 수신 담당자와 연락 예정일을 지정하세요.');
 if(action==='schedule'&&!next)throw Error('다음 연락일을 입력하세요.');
 if(action==='resolve'&&!note)throw Error('알림을 해제하는 이유를 적어 주세요.');
 var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(15000);
 try{
  var p=fuProps_(),key=fuStateKey_(r.id),raw=p.getProperty(key),old=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{version:0,history:[]};
  if(Number(input.version)!==Number(old.version))throw Error('다른 사람이 먼저 수정했습니다. 새로고침 후 다시 저장하세요.');
  var event={at:new Date().toISOString(),by:actor.name,action:action,note:note,lastContact:last,nextContact:next,recipient:recipient};
  var data={version:old.version+1,lastContact:last||old.lastContact||'',nextContact:action==='resolve'?'':next,note:note,recipient:action==='request'?recipient:(old.recipient||r.cons),
   requested:action==='request'?true:action==='resolve'||action==='contact'?false:!!old.requested,updatedAt:event.at,updatedBy:actor.name,history:(old.history||[]).concat([event]).slice(-5)};
  var json=JSON.stringify(data),bytes=Utilities.newBlob(json).getBytes().length;
  if(bytes>8500)throw Error('기록이 너무 깁니다. 메모를 줄여 주세요.');
  var all=p.getProperties(),size=Object.keys(all).reduce(function(n,k){return n+Utilities.newBlob(k+all[k]).getBytes().length;},0);
  if(size+bytes>450000)throw Error('연락 기록 저장 공간이 부족합니다. 관리자에게 기록 보관을 요청하세요.');
  p.setProperty(key,json);return data;
 }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}
function issueFollowupAccess(code,input){
 var actor=fuActor_(code);if(!actor.admin)throw Error('관리자만 발급할 수 있습니다.');
 var role=String(input.role||'cons'),name=fuText_(input.name,80);if(['cons','own'].indexOf(role)<0||name==='미지정')throw Error('담당자를 선택하세요.');
 if(!fuRows_(actor).some(function(r){return r[role]===name;}))throw Error('원본에 없는 담당자입니다.');
 var token=Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'')+Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');
 var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(15000);
 try{
  var p=fuProps_(),who=fuHash_(role+':'+name),old=p.getProperty('fu_member_'+who);
  if(old)p.deleteProperty('fu_access_'+old);
  var hash=fuHash_(token);p.setProperty('fu_access_'+hash,JSON.stringify({admin:false,name:name,role:role}));p.setProperty('fu_member_'+who,hash);
 }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
 return {name:name,role:role,code:token};
}
````

### apps-script/v10/followup.js

````javascript
/* Contact details stay in memory and are loaded only through protected RPCs. */
const FU={key:store.get('fu_access',''),data:null,detail:null,loading:false,detailLoading:false,detailToken:0,autoTried:false,error:'',message:'',role:'own',person:'전체',status:'미대응 확인',year:'전체',period:'all',query:'',selected:'',page:0,issued:null};
const fuStatus=raw=>{const s=txt(raw).replace(/\s/g,'');if(/종료|취소|거절|포기|실주/.test(s))return '종료';if(/계약/.test(s)&&!/미계약|계약전|계약예정|계약검토|계약대기/.test(s))return '계약';if(/진행|상담|미팅|검토|제안|대기|보류|예정/.test(s))return '진행 중';return /미계약/.test(s)?'미계약':'미분류';};
const fuEnd=r=>r.status==='계약';
function fuManualAlert(r,today=FU.data?.today||v10Today()){
 const f=r.followup||{};
 if(f.nextContact&&f.nextContact<today)return {key:'late',label:'연락 기한 지남',rank:0};
 if(f.nextContact===today)return {key:'today',label:'오늘 연락',rank:1};
 if(f.requested)return {key:'request',label:'연락 요청',rank:2};
 if(f.nextContact)return {key:'planned',label:'연락 예정',rank:4};
 if(!fuEnd(r)&&!f.lastContact)return {key:'unknown',label:'연락 기록 확인 필요',rank:3};
 if(!fuEnd(r)&&f.lastContact)return {key:'unscheduled',label:'다음 연락일 미정',rank:3};
 return {key:'closed',label:'별도 연락 일정 없음',rank:5};
}
const fuDays=(date,today)=>date?Math.max(0,Math.floor((Date.parse(today+'T00:00:00Z')-Date.parse(date+'T00:00:00Z'))/86400000)):null;
function fuScope(r,role=FU.role,today=FU.data?.today||v10Today()){
 return !!r[role]&&r[role]!=='미지정'&&(role!=='own'||!!r.meetingISO&&r.meetingISO<=today);
}
function fuAlert(r,today=FU.data?.today||v10Today()){
 if(fuEnd(r))return {key:'closed',label:'계약 · 확인 제외',rank:5,days:null,date:'',basis:'B열 계약 상태'};
 const candidates=[{date:r.noteEvidence?.date,basis:'M열 상담기록 날짜'+(r.noteEvidence?.inferredYear?' (연도 추정)':'')},{date:r.noteObserved?.changed,basis:'M열 변경 감지일'},{date:r.followup?.lastContact,basis:'별도 등록한 실제 연락일'}].filter(x=>x.date&&x.date<=today).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
 if(!candidates.length)return {key:'unknown',label:'기록 날짜 확인 필요',rank:1,days:null,date:'',basis:'과거 수정일·연락일 확인 불가'};
 const evidence=candidates[0],days=fuDays(evidence.date,today);
 // A later meeting is not a new note/contact, but should not be treated as 30 days overdue yet.
 const meetingRecent=r.meetingISO&&r.meetingISO<=today&&fuDays(r.meetingISO,today)<30;
 return {...evidence,days,key:days>=30&&!meetingRecent?'stale':'recent',label:days>=30&&!meetingRecent?'미대응 확인 대상':meetingRecent&&days>=30?'최근 미팅 · 후속 기록 확인':'최근 기록 있음',rank:days>=30&&!meetingRecent?0:3};
}
function fuEvidence(r){const a=fuAlert(r);return `<div class="fu-evidence"><b>${esc(a.date||'날짜 미확인')}</b><small>${esc(a.basis)}</small>${a.days!==null?`<strong>${a.days}일 경과</strong>`:''}${r.meetingISO?`<small>미팅 후 ${fuDays(r.meetingISO,FU.data?.today||v10Today())}일</small>`:''}</div>`;}
function fuRows(ignoreStatus=false){
 const rows=(FU.data?.rows||[]).filter(r=>fuScope(r)&&(FU.person==='전체'||r[FU.role]===FU.person)&&(FU.year==='전체'||r.year===Number(FU.year))&&(FU.period!=='selected'||(r.year===Number(DB.year)&&selMonths().includes(r.month)))&&(!FU.query||[r.no,r.customer,r.phone,r.address,r.cons,r.own].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(FU.query.toLowerCase())));
 return rows.filter(r=>ignoreStatus||FU.status==='전체'||FU.status==='미대응 확인'&&fuAlert(r).key==='stale'||FU.status==='날짜 확인'&&fuAlert(r).key==='unknown'||FU.status==='최근 기록'&&fuAlert(r).key==='recent'||FU.status==='미계약'&&!fuEnd(r)||r.status===FU.status).sort((a,b)=>fuAlert(a).rank-fuAlert(b).rank||(fuAlert(b).days||0)-(fuAlert(a).days||0)||b.year-a.year||b.month-a.month||a.no.localeCompare(b.no));
}
function fuRPC(name,...args){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
 if(typeof google==='undefined'||!google.script?.run){reject(Error('상담 후속관리는 운영 대시보드에서 연결됩니다.'));return;}

});}

}

}
const fuBadge=r=>`<span class="fu-badge ${fuAlert(r).key}">${esc(fuAlert(r).label)}</span>`;
const fuSelect=(label,key,options)=>`<label>${esc(label)}<select data-fu-filter="${key}">${options.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v[0])}" ${String(FU[key])===String(v[0])?'selected':''}>${esc(v[1])}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`;
function fuLink(r){return 'https:'+'/'+'/docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PR1M6AfYkzmvYlzFKkV4KRhJWTWs0rzZBmroZ3CSwyc/edit#gid='+encodeURIComponent(r.gid)+'&range='+encodeURIComponent('A'+r.sourceRow+':M'+r.sourceRow);}
function fuLoading(){return `<section class="fu-lock" role="status"><div class="fu-lock-icon">상담 후속관리</div><h2>담당 상담과 연락 일정을 불러오는 중입니다.</h2><p>이 브라우저에 확인된 관리 권한을 불러오고 있습니다.</p></section>`;}
function fuLogin(){return `<section class="fu-lock"><div class="fu-lock-icon">상담 후속관리</div><h2>이 브라우저는 최초 한 번만 담당자 확인이 필요합니다.</h2><p>확인이 끝나면 접속 종료 전까지 이 메뉴를 누르는 즉시 상담 목록이 열립니다.<br>팀 담당자는 관리자에게 받은 본인 전용 코드를 입력하면 배정된 상담만 볼 수 있습니다.</p><form id="fuLogin"><label>최초 확인용 접속 코드<input name="code" type="password" autocomplete="off" required minlength="20" placeholder="관리자 또는 담당자 접속 코드"></label><button class="btn primary" ${FU.loading?'disabled':''}>${FU.loading?'불러오는 중…':'이 브라우저에서 바로 보기'}</button></form><p class="v10-note">고객 전화번호와 주소를 보호하기 위한 최초 확인입니다. 확인 코드는 저장하지 않고 이 브라우저 전용 권한만 안전하게 기억하며, 접속 종료를 누르면 해제됩니다.</p>${FU.error?`<p class="fu-error" role="alert">${esc(FU.error)}</p>`:''}</section>`;}
function fuDetail(){

 if(FU.detailLoading)return `<section class="fu-detail fu-detail-loading" role="status"><h2>상담 상세를 불러오는 중…</h2><p>목록보다 긴 상담 내용은 선택한 한 건만 안전하게 읽습니다.</p></section>`;
 const r=FU.detail;if(!r)return `<section class="fu-detail fu-detail-loading" role="alert"><h2>상담 상세를 불러오지 못했습니다.</h2><p>${esc(FU.error||'목록을 새로고침한 뒤 다시 선택하세요.')}</p><button class="btn" data-fu-action="close">닫기</button></section>`;

 return `<section class="fu-detail" role="region" aria-label="상담 상세"><header><div><small>${r.year}년 상담일지 · ${esc(r.statusRaw||'상태 미기재')}</small><h2>${esc(r.no)} <span>${esc(r.customer||'고객명 ### apps-script/v10/presentation-comments.gs
````

````javascript
/* Monthly performance-presentation comments shared by every dashboard browser. */
var PRESENTATION_COMMENT_PREFIX = 'performance_presentation_comment_v1_';
var PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX = 10000;

function presentationCommentPeriod_(year, month) {
  var y = Number(year), m = Number(month);
  if (!isFinite(y) || Math.floor(y) !== y || y < 2018 || y > 2100) {
    throw new Error('코멘트 연도를 확인하세요.');
  }
  if (!isFinite(m) || Math.floor(m) !== m || m < 1 || m > 12) {
    throw new Error('코멘트 월을 확인하세요.');
  }
  return { year: y, month: m, key: PRESENTATION_COMMENT_PREFIX + y + '-' + (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m };
}

function presentationCommentBlank_(period) {
  return { year: period.year, month: period.month, text: '', updatedAt: '', updatedBy: '' };
}

function getPresentationComment(year, month) {
  var period = presentationCommentPeriod_(year, month);
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);
  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    var raw = props.getProperty(period.key);
    if (!raw) return presentationCommentBlank_(period);
    var saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (saved.parts) {
      var chunks = saved.parts.map(function(key) {
        var chunk = props.getProperty(key);
        if (chunk === null) throw new Error('저장된 코멘트 일부를 불러오지 못했습니다. 다시 시도하세요.');
        return chunk;
      });
      saved = JSON.parse(chunks.join(''));
    }
    return {
      year: period.year,
      month: period.month,
      text: String(saved.text || '').slice(0, PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX),
      updatedAt: String(saved.updatedAt || ''),
      updatedBy: String(saved.updatedBy || '')
    };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function presentationCommentCleanup_(props, keys) {
  (keys || []).forEach(function(key) {
    // Cleanup must not turn an already committed save into a failed save.
    try { props.deleteProperty(key); } catch (err) {}
  });
}

function savePresentationComment(input) {
  input = input || {};
  var period = presentationCommentPeriod_(input.year, input.month);
  var text = String(input.text == null ? '' : input.text).replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').trim();
  if (text.length > PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX) {
    throw new Error('코멘트는 ' + PRESENTATION_COMMENT_MAX + '자까지 저장할 수 있습니다.');
  }
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);
  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    var previous = props.getProperty(period.key);
    var oldParts = [];
    try { oldParts = previous ? (JSON.parse(previous).parts || []) : []; } catch (err) {}
    if (!text) {
      props.deleteProperty(period.key);
      presentationCommentCleanup_(props, oldParts);
      return presentationCommentBlank_(period);
    }
    var email = '';
    try { email = Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail() || ''; } catch (err) { email = ''; }
    var saved = {
      year: period.year,
      month: period.month,
      text: text,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedBy: email
    };
    // Values are limited to 9 KB. Split by Unicode code point so long Korean
    // comments (or emoji) can be saved without breaking a surrogate pair.
    var points = Array.from(JSON.stringify(saved));
    var prefix = period.key + '_part_' + Utilities.getUuid() + '_';
    var parts = [];
    try {
      for (var offset = 0; offset < points.length; offset += 1000) {
        var key = prefix + parts.length;
        parts.push(key);
        props.setProperty(key, points.slice(offset, offset + 1000).join(''));
      }
      // Publish only after every chunk exists; a failed write preserves the old record.
      props.setProperty(period.key, JSON.stringify({parts: parts}));
    } catch (err) {
      presentationCommentCleanup_(props, parts);
      throw err;
    }
    presentationCommentCleanup_(props, oldParts);
    return saved;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
````


### apps-script/v10/sales-meeting.js

````javascript
/* Copy-ready weekly sales meeting report. Source Sheets stay read-only. */
const SALES_MEETING_SOURCE={
 inquiry:'https:'+'/'+'/docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PR1M6AfYkzmvYlzFKkV4KRhJWTWs0rzZBmroZ3CSwyc/edit?gid=488428713#gid=488428713',
 meeting:'https:'+'/'+'/docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PR1M6AfYkzmvYlzFKkV4KRhJWTWs0rzZBmroZ3CSwyc/edit?gid=843263122#gid=843263122'
};
const salesMeetingState={
 detailKey:txt(store.get('v10_salesMeetingDetailKey','')),
 week:Number(store.get('v10_salesMeetingWeek',0))||0,
 reporter:txt(store.get('v10_salesMeetingReporter','김동호'))||'김동호',
 extra:txt(store.get('v10_salesMeetingExtra','한전수전합리화사업 - 0건 (제안1건)')),
 actions:txt(store.get('v10_salesMeetingActions',''))
};
const SM_COL={AB:27,AC:28,AD:29,AE:30,AF:31,AG:32,AH:33,AI:34,N:13,O:14,P:15,Q:16};
const smCell=(rows,r,c)=>txt(rows?.[r]?.[c]);
const smNumber=value=>{const t=txt(value);return t?`${v10Number(num(t))}`:'—';};
const smDatePad=value=>String(value).padStart(2,'0');
function smPeriodBounds(value,year,monthHint){
 const parts=[...txt(value).matchAll(/(?:(20\d{2})[\/.\-])?(\d{1,2})[\/.\-](\d{1,2})/g)].map(match=>({year:num(match[1]),month:num(match[2]),day:num(match[3])}));
 if(parts.length<2)return null;
 let startYear=parts[0].year||num(year),endYear=parts[1].year||startYear;
 if(!startYear)return null;
 if(!parts[0].year&&monthHint&&parts[0].month+6<num(monthHint))startYear++;
 if(!parts[1].year&&parts[1].month<parts[0].month)endYear=startYear+1;else if(!parts[1].year)endYear=startYear;
 const iso=partYear=>part=>`${partYear}-${smDatePad(part.month)}-${smDatePad(part.day)}`;
 return {start:iso(startYear)(parts[0]),end:iso(endYear)(parts[1])};
}
function smDetailKey(detail){
 const bounds=smPeriodBounds(detail?.period,detail?.year,detail?.month);
 return detail?`${num(detail.year)}-${smDatePad(detail.month)}-${num(detail.week)}-${bounds?.start||txt(detail.period)}`:'';
}
function smDetailMeetingMatch(detail,meeting){
 const inquiryBounds=smPeriodBounds(detail?.period,detail?.year,detail?.month),meetingBounds=smPeriodBounds(meeting?.period,meeting?.year,detail?.month);
 return !!(inquiryBounds&&meetingBounds&&inquiryBounds.start===meetingBounds.start&&inquiryBounds.end===meetingBounds.end);
}
function smSelectDetail(inquiry,meeting){
 const details=inquiry?.details||[];
 if(!details.length)return null;
 const stored=details.find(detail=>smDetailKey(detail)===salesMeetingState.detailKey);
 if(stored)return stored;
 return details.find(detail=>smDetailMeetingMatch(detail,meeting))||details.find(detail=>{
  const bounds=smPeriodBounds(detail.period,detail.year,detail.month);
  return bounds&&bounds.start<=v10Today()&&bounds.end>=v10Today();
 })||details.findLast?.(detail=>{
  const bounds=smPeriodBounds(detail.period,detail.year,detail.month);
  return bounds&&bounds.start<=v10Today();
 })||details.at(-1);
}
function smPeriodLabel(period){return txt(period).replace(/\s*~\s*/,' ~ ');}
const smMetric=(rows,row)=>({label:smCell(rows,row,SM_COL.AC),values:[SM_COL.AD,SM_COL.AE,SM_COL.AF,SM_COL.AG,SM_COL.AH].map(c=>smCell(rows,row,c))});
function smMetricBlock(rows,row){
 const out=[];
 for(let r=row;r<Math.min(row+7,rows.length)&&out.length<3;r++){
  const metric=smMetric(rows,r);
  if(['전체 주간문의','발전사업 주간 문의','발전사업 주간 진행'].includes(metric.label))out.push(metric);
 }
 return out;
}
function smParseInquiryReport(rows){
 rows=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[];
 let year=num(smCell(rows,0,SM_COL.AB)),month=num(smCell(rows,0,SM_COL.AC));
 const monthlyHead=rows.findIndex((_,r)=>/^\d{2}월\s*전체$/.test(smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AB)));
 if(monthlyHead>=0&&!month)month=num(smCell(rows,monthlyHead,SM_COL.AB));
 if(!year){const hit=rows.slice(0,190).flat().map(txt).find(v=>/^20\d{2}년?$/.test(v));year=num(hit);}
 const monthly=monthlyHead>=0?smMetricBlock(rows,monthlyHead+1):[];
 const detailStarts=[];
 rows.slice(0,190).forEach((_,r)=>{
  const m=smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AB).match(/^(20\d{2})년\s*(\d{1,2})월\s*(\d+)주\s*진행사항\s*\(([^)]+)\)/);
  if(m)detailStarts.push({row:r,year:Number(m[1]),month:Number(m[2]),week:Number(m[3]),period:m[4]});
 });
 const firstDetail=detailStarts[0]?.row??190,weekly=[];
 for(let r=Math.max(0,monthlyHead+1);r<Math.min(firstDetail,rows.length);r++){
  const raw=smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AB),m=raw.match(/^(\d+)주차\s*([\s\S]*)$/);
  if(!m||smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AC)!=='전체 주간문의')continue;
  weekly.push({week:Number(m[1]),period:txt(m[2]).replace(/^\s+/,''),metrics:smMetricBlock(rows,r)});
 }
 const details=detailStarts.map((head,index)=>{
  const end=detailStarts[index+1]?.row??Math.min(rows.length,190),days=[];
  let total=[],top=[];
  for(let r=head.row+1;r<end;r++){
   const day=smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AB);
   if(/^\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)&&smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AC)==='전체 주간문의')days.push({day,metrics:smMetricBlock(rows,r)});
   if(day==='주간전체'&&smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.AC)==='전체 주간문의')total=smMetricBlock(rows,r);
   if(/문의\s*TOP\s*3/.test(day))top=[SM_COL.AB,SM_COL.AD,SM_COL.AF,SM_COL.AH].map(c=>({source:smCell(rows,r,c).replace(/\s*문의\s*TOP\s*3.*/,''),items:[1,2,3].map(offset=>({label:smCell(rows,r+offset,c),value:smCell(rows,r+offset,c+1)})).filter(x=>x.label)}));
  }
  const overview=weekly.find(w=>w.week===head.week);
  return {...head,period:head.period||overview?.period||'',days,total:total.length?total:(overview?.metrics||[]),top};
 });
 return {year,month,monthly,weekly,details,ready:monthly.length>0||weekly.length>0||details.length>0};
}
function smSelectedPeriod(){
 const months=selMonths(),month=state.mode==='month'&&state.months?.length?Number(state.months[0]):Number(months.at(-1));
 return {year:Number(V10.selectedYear||DB.year),month:month||Number(v10Today().slice(5,7))};
}
function smInquiryDate(record,year){
 const direct=v10Date(record?.inquiryDate);
 if(direct)return direct;
 const match=txt(record?.no).match(/^(?:sp|ugs)?(\d{1,2})-(\d{2})\d+/i),month=num(match?.[1]),day=num(match?.[2]);
 return month>=1&&month<=12&&day>=1&&day<=31?`${year}-${smDatePad(month)}-${smDatePad(day)}`:'';
}
function smWorkdayName(date){return ['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'][date.getUTCDay()];}
function smIsoDate(date){return `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-${smDatePad(date.getUTCMonth()+1)}-${smDatePad(date.getUTCDate())}`;}
function smDisplayDate(date){return `${date.getUTCMonth()+1}/${date.getUTCDate()}(${smWorkdayName(date)})`;}
function smMonthWorkweeks(year,month){
 const first=new Date(Date.UTC(year,month-1,1)),last=new Date(Date.UTC(year,month,0)),day=first.getUTCDay()||7,start=new Date(first);
 start.setUTCDate(first.getUTCDate()-(day-1));
 if(start.getUTCDate()+4<first.getUTCDate()&&start.getUTCMonth()===first.getUTCMonth())start.setUTCDate(start.getUTCDate()+7);
 const weeks=[];
 for(let monday=new Date(start);monday<=last;monday.setUTCDate(monday.getUTCDate()+7)){
  const friday=new Date(monday);friday.setUTCDate(friday.getUTCDate()+4);
  if(friday<first)continue;
  weeks.push({week:weeks.length+1,start:smIsoDate(monday),end:smIsoDate(friday),period:`${monday.getUTCMonth()+1}/${monday.getUTCDate()}~${friday.getUTCMonth()+1}/${friday.getUTCDate()}`});
 }
 return weeks;
}
function smInquirySource(record){
 if(/소개/.test(`${txt(record?.src)} ${txt(record?.ct)}`))return '소개';
 if(/^(?:SP|그랜드썬SP)$/i.test(txt(record?.corp)))return 'SP';
 if(/UGS|유지에스|유지스/i.test(txt(record?.corp)))return '유지에스';
 return '그랜드썬';
}
function smDerivedMetric(label,records){
 const sources=['그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개'],values=sources.map(source=>records.filter(record=>smInquirySource(record)===source).length);
 return {label,values:[...values,values.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0)]};
}
function smDerivedMetrics(records){
 const business=records.filter(record=>/^발전사업/.test(txt(record.type))),progress=business.filter(record=>/진행/.test(txt(record.ct)));
 return [smDerivedMetric('전체 주간문의',records),smDerivedMetric('발전사업 주간 문의',business),smDerivedMetric('발전사업 주간 진행',progress)];
}
function smDerivedTop(records){
 return ['그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개'].map(source=>{
  const values=smCountMap(records.filter(record=>smInquirySource(record)===source&&/^발전사업/.test(txt(record.type))),record=>txt(record.type));
  return {source,items:values.slice(0,3).map(([label,value])=>({label,value:String(value)}))};
 });
}
function smParseInquiryLedger(year,month,records){
 records=(Array.isArray(records)?records:[]).map(record=>({...record,_inquiryDate:smInquiryDate(record,year)})).filter(record=>record._inquiryDate.startsWith(`${year}-${smDatePad(month)}-`));
 const ranges=smMonthWorkweeks(year,month),details=ranges.map(range=>{
  const selected=records.filter(record=>record._inquiryDate>=range.start&&record._inquiryDate<=range.end),days=[];
  for(let cursor=new Date(`${range.start}T00:00:00Z`),end=new Date(`${range.end}T00:00:00Z`);cursor<=end;cursor.setUTCDate(cursor.getUTCDate()+1)){
   const date=smIsoDate(cursor),rows=selected.filter(record=>record._inquiryDate===date);
   days.push({day:`${smDatePad(cursor.getUTCMonth()+1)}-${smDatePad(cursor.getUTCDate())}`,metrics:smDerivedMetrics(rows)});
  }
  return {...range,year,month,days,total:smDerivedMetrics(selected),top:smDerivedTop(selected),derived:true};
 });
 return {year,month,monthly:smDerivedMetrics(records),weekly:details.map(({week,period,total})=>({week,period,metrics:total})),details,ready:true,derived:true};
}
function smInquiryForSelection(){
 const target=smSelectedPeriod(),sheet=smParseInquiryReport(V10.payload?.tongye);
 if(sheet.year===target.year&&sheet.month===target.month&&sheet.details.length)return sheet;
 const records=V10.payload?.yearData?.[target.year]?.records||[];
 return smParseInquiryLedger(target.year,target.month,records);
}
function smCountMap(entries,getter){
 const map=new Map();
 entries.forEach(entry=>{const key=getter(entry);if(key)map.set(key,(map.get(key)||0)+1);});
 return [...map.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]||a[0].localeCompare(b[0],'ko'));
}
function smEntrySource(text){return ['그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개'].find(x=>text.includes(`_${x}_`))||'기타';}
function smEntrySite(text){return ['공장','창고','근생','주거','축사','재배사','주차장','토지'].find(x=>text.includes(`_${x}_`))||'기타';}
function smEntryRelation(text){return ['대표','직원','협력사','건물주','가족','지인'].find(x=>text.includes(`_${x}_`))||'기타';}
function smEntryStatus(text){return text.includes('_미팅가망_')?'미팅가망':/\d{4}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}/.test(text)?'미팅확정':'확인 필요';}
function smEntryBranch(text){
 const region=['서울','경기','인천','강원','충북','충남','대전','세종','부산','대구','울산','경북','경남','광주','전북','전남','제주'].find(x=>text.includes(`_${x}_`));
 return ['서울','경기','인천','강원','충북','충남','대전','세종'].includes(region)?'안성지사':region?'부산지사':'기타';
}
function smParseMeetingReport(rows){
 rows=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[];
 const year=num(smCell(rows,1,SM_COL.N)),week=num(smCell(rows,1,SM_COL.O)),period=smCell(rows,1,SM_COL.P),stated=num(smCell(rows,0,SM_COL.Q));
 let current='';
 for(let r=0;r<Math.min(rows.length,6)&&!current;r++)for(let c=SM_COL.N;c<=30;c++){const v=smCell(rows,r,c);if(/이번주는\s*\d+\s*주차/.test(v)){current=v;break;}}
 const entries=[];
 for(let r=0;r<rows.length;r++){
  const no=smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.N),text=smCell(rows,r,SM_COL.O);
  if(/^\d+\.$/.test(no)&&text)entries.push({no:num(no),text});
 }
 return {year,week,period,current,count:stated||entries.length,entries,summary:{source:smCountMap(entries,e=>smEntrySource(e.text)),branch:smCountMap(entries,e=>smEntryBranch(e.text)),site:smCountMap(entries,e=>smEntrySite(e.text)),relation:smCountMap(entries,e=>smEntryRelation(e.text)),status:smCountMap(entries,e=>smEntryStatus(e.text))},ready:entries.length>0};
}
function smIsoWeek(value){
 const date=new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate()+4-(date.getUTCDay()||7));
 const yearStart=new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
 return Math.ceil((((date-yearStart)/86400000)+1)/7);
}
function smMeetingBranch(region){
 const group=regionOf(region);
 return ['수도권','충청권','강원권'].includes(group)?'안성지사':['영남권','호남권','제주'].includes(group)?'부산지사':'기타';
}
function smMeetingSite(type){return ['공장','창고','근생','주거','축사','재배사','주차장','토지'].find(site=>txt(type).includes(site))||'기타';}
function smParseMeetingLedger(rows,detail){
 rows=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[];
 const bounds=detail?.start&&detail?.end?{start:detail.start,end:detail.end}:smPeriodBounds(detail?.period,detail?.year,detail?.month);
 if(!bounds)return {year:detail?.year||0,week:0,period:'',count:0,entries:[],summary:{source:[],branch:[],site:[],relation:[],status:[]},ready:false,basis:'ledger'};
 const entries=[];
 for(let r=0;r<rows.length;r++){
  const date=v10Date(smCell(rows,r,4));
  if(!date||date<bounds.start||date>bounds.end)continue;
  const no=smCell(rows,r,3),source=smCell(rows,r,5),corp=smCell(rows,r,8),type=smCell(rows,r,9),consultant=smCell(rows,r,11),owner=smCell(rows,r,12),region=smCell(rows,r,13),capacity=smCell(rows,r,7);
  if(!no)continue;
  const sourceName=/소개/.test(source)?'소개':/SP/i.test(corp)?'SP':/UGS|유지/.test(corp)?'유지에스':'그랜드썬';
  const text=[no,region,type,consultant,owner,sourceName,capacity?`${capacity}kW`:'',date].filter(Boolean).join('_');
  entries.push({no:entries.length+1,text,source:sourceName,branch:smMeetingBranch(region),site:smMeetingSite(type),status:'미팅실적'});
 }
 const start=new Date(`${bounds.start}T00:00:00Z`),end=new Date(`${bounds.end}T00:00:00Z`),period=`${bounds.start.replace(/-/g,'/')}(${smWorkdayName(start)})~${bounds.end.replace(/-/g,'/')}(${smWorkdayName(end)})`;
 return {year:Number(bounds.start.slice(0,4)),week:smIsoWeek(bounds.start),period,current:'선택 문의 주차와 같은 기간의 실제 미팅 원장',count:entries.length,entries,summary:{source:smCountMap(entries,e=>e.source),branch:smCountMap(entries,e=>e.branch),site:smCountMap(entries,e=>e.site),relation:[],status:smCountMap(entries,e=>e.status)},ready:true,basis:'ledger'};
}
function smMetricsTable(rows,firstHeader='구분'){
 return `<div class="v10-table sales-table"><table><thead><tr>${[firstHeader,'그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개','합계'].map(h=>`<th>${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r=>`<tr><th>${esc(r.label)}</th>${r.values.map(v=>`<td>${esc(smNumber(v))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function smWeeklyOverview(report){
 return `<div class="v10-table sales-table sales-week-overview"><table><thead><tr>${['주차 · 기간','구분','그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개','합계'].map(h=>`<th>${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${report.weekly.map(w=>w.metrics.map((r,j)=>`<tr>${j===0?`<th rowspan="${w.metrics.length}">${w.week}주차<small>${esc(w.period)}</small></th>`:''}<th>${esc(r.label)}</th>${r.values.map(v=>`<td>${esc(smNumber(v))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function smTopThree(detail){
 if(!detail?.top?.length)return '<p class="sales-empty">유입별 TOP 3 자료가 없습니다.</p>';
 return `<div class="sales-top-grid">${detail.top.map(group=>`<article><h4>${esc(group.source)} 문의 TOP 3</h4><ol>${group.items.map(item=>`<li><span>${esc(item.label)}</span><b>${esc(smNumber(item.value))}건</b></li>`).join('')}</ol></article>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function smDailyTable(detail){
 if(!detail?.days?.length)return '<p class="sales-empty">선택 주의 일자별 자료가 없습니다.</p>';
 return `<div class="v10-table sales-table sales-day-table"><table><thead><tr>${['일자','구분','그랜드썬','SP','유지에스','소개','합계'].map(h=>`<th>${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${detail.days.map(day=>day.metrics.map((r,j)=>`<tr>${j===0?`<th rowspan="${day.metrics.length}">${esc(day.day)}</th>`:''}<th>${esc(r.label)}</th>${r.values.map(v=>`<td>${esc(smNumber(v))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')).join('')}${detail.total.map((r,j)=>`<tr class="sales-total">${j===0?`<th rowspan="${detail.total.length}">주간전체</th>`:''}<th>${esc(r.label)}</th>${r.values.map(v=>`<td>${esc(smNumber(v))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function smSummaryTable(title,rows){return `<article><h4>${esc(title)}</h4><table><tbody>${rows.map(([name,value])=>`<tr><th>${esc(name)}</th><td>${i(value)}건</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td>자료 없음</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></article>`;}
function smMeetingSection(report){
 if(!report.ready)return `<section id="salesMeetingCopy" class="sales-report-card sales-copy-section"><h3>이번 주 사업주 미팅</h3><p class="sales-empty">미팅26 시트의 N1:AE70 자료를 불러오지 못했습니다. 새로고침 후 다시 확인해 주세요.</p></section>`;
 return `<section id="salesMeetingCopy" class="sales-report-card sales-copy-section"><header><div><p class="sales-kicker">${esc(report.year)}년 ${i(report.week)}주차</p><h3>이번 주 사업주 미팅</h3><p>${esc(report.period)} · 총 ${i(report.count)}건${report.current?` · ${esc(report.current)}`:''}</p></div><strong>${i(report.count)}건</strong></header><div class="sales-summary-grid">${smSummaryTable('유입별',report.summary.source)}${smSummaryTable('지역 담당',report.summary.branch)}${smSummaryTable('설치장소',report.summary.site)}${smSummaryTable('문의 관계',report.summary.relation)}${smSummaryTable('미팅 상태',report.summary.status)}</div><div class="v10-table sales-table sales-meeting-list"><table><thead><tr><th>번호</th><th>영업회의 미팅 내용</th></tr></thead><tbody>${report.entries.length?report.entries.map(entry=>`<tr><td>${i(entry.no)}</td><td class="left">${esc(entry.text)}</td></tr>`).join(''):'<tr><td colspan="2">선택 기간에 실제 미팅이 없습니다.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></section>`;
}
const SM_MINUTE_SOURCES=[
 {name:'그랜드썬',index:0,cls:'gs'},
 {name:'SP',index:1,cls:'sp'},
 {name:'유지에스',index:2,cls:'ugs'},
 {name:'소개',index:3,cls:'ref'}
];
function smMinuteSources(detail){
 return SM_MINUTE_SOURCES.filter(source=>source.name!=='유지에스'||detail.total.some(row=>num(row.values[source.index])!==0)||(detail.top.find(group=>group.source===source.name)?.items||[]).some(item=>num(item.value)!==0));
}
function smMinuteInquiryTable(detail,sources){
 const rowClass=label=>label==='전체 주간문의'?'minutes-row-total':label==='발전사업 주간 문의'?'minutes-row-business':'minutes-row-progress';
 return `<div class="minutes-table-wrap"><table class="minutes-inquiry-table"><thead><tr><th></th>${sources.map(source=>`<th class="minutes-source-${source.cls}">${esc(source.name)}</th>`).join('')}<th class="minutes-source-sum">합계</th></tr></thead><tbody>${detail.total.map(row=>`<tr class="${rowClass(row.label)}"><th>${esc(row.label)}</th>${sources.map(source=>`<td>${esc(smNumber(row.values[source.index]))}</td>`).join('')}<td>${esc(smNumber(row.values[4]))}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function smMinuteTopTable(detail,sources){
 const groups=sources.map(source=>({source,group:detail.top.find(group=>group.source===source.name)||{items:[]}}));
 return `<div class="minutes-table-wrap"><table class="minutes-top-table"><thead><tr><th>순위</th>${groups.map(({source})=>`<th colspan="2" class="minutes-source-${source.cls}">${esc(source.name)} 문의 TOP 3</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${[0,1,2].map(index=>`<tr><th>${index+1}위</th>${groups.map(({group})=>{const item=group.items[index];return `<td>${esc(item?.label||'—')}</td><td class="minutes-count">${item?esc(smNumber(item.value)):'—'}</td>`;}).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function smMinuteEntryParts(value){
 const chunks=txt(value).split('_').filter(Boolean);
 if(!chunks.length)return {main:'',note:''};
 let note='',tail=chunks[chunks.length-1],slash=tail.split(/\s*\/\s*/);
 if(slash.length>1){chunks[chunks.length-1]=slash.shift();note=slash.join(' / ');}
 else if(tail.length>=18&&/[가-힣]/.test(tail)){note=chunks.pop();}
 return {main:chunks.join('_'),note};
}
function smMinuteSummaryLine(label,rows){
 return `<li><b>${esc(label)}</b> - ${rows.map(([name,value])=>`${esc(name)} ${i(value)}건`).join(', ')||'자료 없음'}</li>`;
}
function smMinutesReport(inquiry,detail,meeting){
 if(!detail||!meeting.ready)return `<section id="salesMinutesCopy" class="sales-minutes-report"><p class="sales-empty">회의록 형식에 필요한 주차별 문의 또는 미팅 자료가 없습니다.</p></section>`;
 const sources=smMinuteSources(detail),entries=meeting.entries.map(entry=>({no:entry.no,...smMinuteEntryParts(entry.text)}));
 const extra=salesMeetingState.extra?`<p class="minutes-extra">※${esc(salesMeetingState.extra)}</p>`:'';
 const actions=salesMeetingState.actions?`<h3>4. 후속 조치</h3><div class="minutes-actions">${esc(salesMeetingState.actions).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</div>`:'';
 const matched=smDetailMeetingMatch(detail,meeting),mismatch=matched?'':`<p class="minutes-period-warning">※ 문의 주차와 미팅 원본의 날짜가 다릅니다. 각 제목의 기간을 확인하세요.</p>`;
 return `<section id="salesMinutesCopy" class="sales-minutes-report"><h2 class="minutes-report-title"><span>■</span>컨설팅-${esc(salesMeetingState.reporter)}</h2><div class="minutes-report-box"><div class="minutes-box-title">* 컨설팅 내용</div><div class="minutes-period-basis"><b>문의 ${esc(detail.year)}년 ${i(detail.month)}월 ${i(detail.week)}주차</b><span>${esc(smPeriodLabel(detail.period))} · 월~금</span><b>미팅 ${esc(meeting.year)}년 ${i(meeting.week)}주차</b><span>${esc(smPeriodLabel(meeting.period))} · ${meeting.basis==='ledger'?'실제 미팅 원장':'원본 기준'}</span></div>${mismatch}<h3>1. 유입별 문의건수 <span>[ ${i(detail.month)}월 ${i(detail.week)}주 진행사항 (${esc(detail.period)}) ]</span></h3>${smMinuteInquiryTable(detail,sources)}<h3>2. 사업형태별 문의건수</h3>${smMinuteTopTable(detail,sources)}${extra}<h3>3. 미팅가망 및 특이사항 <span>[ ${esc(meeting.year)}년 ${i(meeting.week)}주차 (${esc(meeting.period)}) ]</span></h3><ol class="minutes-meeting-list">${entries.length?entries.map(entry=>`<li><span>${esc(entry.main)}</span>${entry.note?`<strong>${esc(entry.note)}</strong>`:''}</li>`).join(''):'<li><span>해당 기간 실제 미팅 없음</span></li>'}</ol><ul class="minutes-summary">${smMinuteSummaryLine('유입별 미팅가망',meeting.summary.source)}${smMinuteSummaryLine('지역별 대응예정',meeting.summary.branch)}${smMinuteSummaryLine('문의',meeting.summary.relation)}${smMinuteSummaryLine('설치장소',meeting.summary.site)}${smMinuteSummaryLine('미팅가망 및 확정',meeting.summary.status)}</ul>${actions}</div></section>`;
}
function easySalesMeeting(){
 const inquiry=smInquiryForSelection(),weeklyMeeting=smParseMeetingReport(V10.payload?.meeting26),detail=smSelectDetail(inquiry,weeklyMeeting),meeting=detail&&smDetailMeetingMatch(detail,weeklyMeeting)?weeklyMeeting:smParseMeetingLedger(V10.payload?.tongye,detail);
 salesMeetingState.detailKey=smDetailKey(detail);salesMeetingState.week=detail?.week||0;
 const matched=smDetailMeetingMatch(detail,meeting);
 const inquirySection=inquiry.ready?`<section id="salesInquiryCopy" class="sales-report-card sales-copy-section"><header><div><p class="sales-kicker">${esc(inquiry.year)}년 ${i(inquiry.month)}월 ${inquiry.derived?'문의 원장 재집계':'원본 집계'}</p><h3>월간 · 주차별 문의 현황</h3><p>상단에서 선택한 연도·월의 문의 접수일을 기준으로 월~금 주차를 표시합니다.</p></div><strong>${i(inquiry.month)}월</strong></header><h4 class="sales-subtitle">월 전체 문의</h4>${smMetricsTable(inquiry.monthly)}<p class="sales-note">${inquiry.derived?'상담번호의 문의 접수일을 기준으로 다시 집계했습니다.':'합계는 원본 통계 시트의 값을 그대로 표시합니다.'}</p><h4 class="sales-subtitle">주차별 문의</h4>${smWeeklyOverview(inquiry)}${detail?`<div class="sales-detail-head"><div><h4>${detail.month}월 ${detail.week}주차 일자별 문의</h4><p>${esc(detail.period)} · 월요일~금요일</p></div></div>${smDailyTable(detail)}${smTopThree(detail)}`:''}</section>`:`<section id="salesInquiryCopy" class="sales-report-card sales-copy-section"><h3>월간 · 주차별 문의 현황</h3><p class="sales-empty">선택한 연도·월의 문의 자료를 불러오지 못했습니다. 새로고침 후 다시 확인해 주세요.</p></section>`;
 const sourcePeriods=[detail?`문의 ${esc(detail.year)}년 ${i(detail.month)}월 ${i(detail.week)}주차 · ${esc(smPeriodLabel(detail.period))}`:'문의 자료 대기',meeting.ready?`미팅 ${esc(meeting.year)}년 ${i(meeting.week)}주차 · ${esc(smPeriodLabel(meeting.period))}`:'미팅 자료 대기'].join(' / ');
 const periodSelector=detail?`<section class="sales-period-picker"><div class="sales-period-picker-head"><div><p>보고 주차 선택</p><h3>날짜를 기준으로 문의·미팅 자료를 확인합니다</h3></div><label>문의 주차<select id="salesMeetingWeek">${inquiry.details.map(item=>`<option value="${esc(smDetailKey(item))}" ${smDetailKey(item)===smDetailKey(detail)?'selected':''}>${item.year}년 ${item.month}월 ${item.week}주차 · ${esc(smPeriodLabel(item.period))}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div><div class="sales-period-cards"><article><span>문의 기준</span><b>${esc(detail.year)}년 ${i(detail.month)}월 ${i(detail.week)}주차</b><strong>${esc(smPeriodLabel(detail.period))}</strong><small>월요일~금요일 집계</small></article><article><span>미팅 기준</span><b>${meeting.ready?`${esc(meeting.year)}년 ${i(meeting.week)}주차`:'자료 대기'}</b><strong>${meeting.ready?esc(smPeriodLabel(meeting.period)):'—'}</strong><small>${meeting.basis==='ledger'?'같은 기간 실제 미팅 원장':'주간 미팅 원본 시트'}</small></article><div class="sales-period-status ${matched?'is-match':'is-warning'}"><b>${matched?'날짜 일치':'기간 확인 필요'}</b><span>${matched?'문의와 미팅 자료의 시작일·종료일이 같습니다.':'문의 선택 주차와 미팅 자료의 날짜가 다릅니다.'}</span></div></div></section>`:'';
 return easyLead('영업회의 자료','회의록 1페이지 형식과 원본 상세표를 한글에 바로 붙여넣을 수 있습니다.',sourcePeriods)+periodSelector+`<div class="sales-minutes-controls"><label>보고자명<input id="salesMeetingReporter" maxlength="20" value="${esc(salesMeetingState.reporter)}"></label><label>별도 사업 메모<input id="salesMeetingExtra" maxlength="100" value="${esc(salesMeetingState.extra)}" placeholder="예: 한전수전합리화사업 - 0건 (제안1건)"></label><label class="sales-actions-field">후속 조치 · 담당/기한<textarea id="salesMeetingActions" maxlength="500" rows="2" placeholder="선택 입력 · 예: 김동호 / 10월 16일 / 제안서 발송">${esc(salesMeetingState.actions)}</textarea></label></div><div class="sales-copy-toolbar"><button class="btn primary" data-sales-copy="minutes">회의록 형식 복사</button><button class="btn" data-sales-copy="all">원본 상세 전체 복사</button><button class="btn" data-sales-copy="inquiry">문의표만 복사</button><button class="btn" data-sales-copy="meeting">미팅표만 복사</button><a class="btn" href="${SALES_MEETING_SOURCE.inquiry}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">문의 원본 열기</a><a class="btn" href="${SALES_MEETING_SOURCE.meeting}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">미팅 원본 열기</a><span id="salesCopyStatus" role="status"></span></div><div class="v10-callout sales-basis"><b>권장 보고 순서</b> 주간 문의 → 문의 TOP 3 → 미팅가망·특이사항 → 후속 조치 순으로 보고합니다. 보고자명과 메모를 수정하면 회의록 미리보기와 복사본에 바로 반영됩니다.</div>${smMinutesReport(inquiry,detail,meeting)}<details class="sales-source-details"><summary>원본 상세자료 펼치기</summary><div class="v10-callout sales-basis"><b>집계 기준</b> 영업회의 자료는 대시보드 상단에서 선택한 연도·월을 따라갑니다. 문의 주차를 바꾸면 같은 날짜의 실제 미팅도 함께 바뀝니다.</div><div id="salesMeetingCopyRoot" class="sales-copy-root">${inquirySection}${smMeetingSection(meeting)}</div></details>`;
}
function smPrepareClipboard(root){
 const clone=root.cloneNode(true);
 clone.querySelectorAll('select,label,.sales-note').forEach(node=>node.remove());
 clone.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:0 0 22px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #b9c5d6;border-radius:8px;font-family:Malgun Gothic,Arial,sans-serif;color:#14243a;background:#fff;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('h3').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('h4').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:16px 0 7px;font-size:16px;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:auto;margin:8px 0;font-size:13px;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('th,td').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','border:1px solid #8898ac;padding:7px 9px;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#eaf0f8;font-weight:700;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('td.left').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'text-align:left;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-report-title').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#111;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-report-box').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','border:1px solid #111;padding:0 8px 10px;color:#111;background:#fff;font-family:Malgun Gothic,Arial,sans-serif;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-box-title').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:0 -8px 8px;padding:3px 7px;border-bottom:1px dotted #444;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-period-basis').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:2px 9px;margin:6px 0 8px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #6685ad;background:#eef5ff;font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-period-warning').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:4px 0;color:#b52b1d;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.sales-minutes-report h3').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:9px 0 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.sales-minutes-report table').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;margin:3px 0;font-size:11px;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.sales-minutes-report th,.sales-minutes-report td').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','border:1px solid #111;padding:3px 4px;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-source-gs').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#cdddf4;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-source-sp').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#d9a3dc;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-source-ugs').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#fff0bd;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-source-ref').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#f5dcc4;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-source-sum').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#d6e8d1;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-row-total th').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#00ef21;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-row-business th').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'background:#fff200;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-row-business td,.minutes-count').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style',node.getAttribute('style')+'color:#d7191c;font-weight:800;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-meeting-list').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:2px 0 8px;padding-left:24px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-meeting-list strong').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','display:block;color:#d7191c;font-weight:800;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-summary').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:18px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;'));
 clone.querySelectorAll('.minutes-extra,.minutes-actions').forEach(node=>node.setAttribute('style','margin:5px 0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;'));
 return clone;
}
async function smCopyReport(kind){
 const selector=kind==='minutes'?'#salesMinutesCopy':kind==='inquiry'?'#salesInquiryCopy':kind==='meeting'?'#salesMeetingCopy':'#salesMeetingCopyRoot',root=document.querySelector(selector),status=$('#salesCopyStatus');
 if(!root)return;
 const clone=smPrepareClipboard(root),plain=(clone.innerText||clone.textContent||'').replace(/\n{3,}/g,'\n\n').trim(),html=`<div style="font-family:'Malgun Gothic',Arial,sans-serif;color:#14243a">${clone.innerHTML}</div>`;
 try{
  if(navigator.clipboard?.write&&typeof ClipboardItem!=='undefined')await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({'text/html':new Blob([html],{type:'text/html'}),'text/plain':new Blob([plain],{type:'text/plain'})})]);
  else await navigator.clipboard.writeText(plain);
  if(status)status.textContent='복사했습니다. 한글에서 Ctrl+V로 붙여넣으세요.';
 }catch(err){if(status)status.textContent='브라우저가 복사를 막았습니다. 다시 한 번 눌러 주세요.';}
}
if(!SECTIONS.some(s=>s.k==='salesMeeting'))SECTIONS.push({k:'salesMeeting',t:'영업회의 자료',g:'보고',basis:'exec'});
if(!EASY_NAV.some(s=>s.k==='salesMeeting'))EASY_NAV.push({k:'salesMeeting',label:'영업회의 자료',sub:'한글 보고서에 바로 복사'});
Object.assign(VIEWS,{salesMeeting:easySalesMeeting});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{
 if(event.target.id==='salesMeetingWeek'){salesMeetingState.detailKey=txt(event.target.value);store.set('v10_salesMeetingDetailKey',salesMeetingState.detailKey);render();return;}
 const setting={salesMeetingReporter:['reporter','v10_salesMeetingReporter'],salesMeetingExtra:['extra','v10_salesMeetingExtra'],salesMeetingActions:['actions','v10_salesMeetingActions']}[event.target.id];
 if(!setting)return;salesMeetingState[setting[0]]=txt(event.target.value);store.set(setting[1],salesMeetingState[setting[0]]);render();
});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const button=event.target.closest?.('[data-sales-copy]');if(button)smCopyReport(button.dataset.salesCopy);});

````

````css
.sales-period-picker {
````

### apps-script/v10/source-audit.js

````javascript
/* Source differences are visible, never silently adjusted to make totals agree. */
function v10SourceChecks(ms){
 if(DB.rawYear||v10Scoped())return [];
 const sum=sumFor(ms),q=inqFor(ms),a=v10Aggregate(ms),owners=malOwnersFor(ms);
 const months=DB.months.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.m));
 const checks=[];
 const add=(metric,sourceA,valueA,sourceB,valueB)=>checks.push({metric,sourceA,valueA,sourceB,valueB,difference:valueA-valueB});
 if(sum){add('전체 문의','통계 AB194:AO194',sum.inq,'말 BS:BW 요약',q.total);add('전체 사업 문의','통계 195행',sum.pwr,'말 BZ:CA 요약',q.pwr);add('문의월 미팅','통계 204행',sum.mt,'날짜 확인 원장',a.cohort);}
 add('실제 미팅 담당자','말 BB 월 합계',a.actual,'말 담당자별 합계',v10Sum(owners,'n'));
 add('미팅 용량 구간','말 BB 월 합계',a.actual,'말 AZ:BG 용량 구간',months.reduce((s,m)=>s+(m.buckets||[]).reduce((t,b)=>t+(b.n||0),0),0));
 add('활동월 원장','말 BB 월 합계',a.actual,'동일 보고 주차 원장',a.exeRows.length);
 return checks;
}
function v10SourceAudit(){
 const rows=v10SourceChecks(selMonths()),different=rows.filter(r=>r.difference!==0);
 const warnings=V10.payload?.provenance?.warnings||[];
 if(!rows.length&&!warnings.length)return '';
 return `<details class="easy-details source-audit"><summary>원본 대조 · ${different.length?'확인 필요 '+different.length+'항목':'집계 일치'}</summary><p class="v10-note">전체 문의·전체 사업 문의는 통계 AB:AO, 실제 활동은 말 AY:BK 보고표를 우선합니다. 월별 미팅은 보고 주차 전체를 집계합니다. 앞뒤 달 날짜도 해당 월의 보고 주차에 속하면 그 월 실적입니다. 원본은 변경하지 않았습니다.</p>${warnings.map(w=>`<p>${esc(w)}</p>`).join('')}${v10Table(['확인 항목','보고 기준','건수','대조 기준','건수','차이'],rows.map(r=>[esc(r.metric),esc(r.sourceA),i(r.valueA),esc(r.sourceB),i(r.valueB),r.difference?i(r.difference)+'건':'일치']))}<p class="v10-note">차이가 있는 분류의 합계를 전체 KPI로 대체하거나 누락 건을 임의 배분하지 않습니다.</p></details>`;
}

````

### apps-script/v10/template.gs

````javascript
/**
 * 그랜드썬 컨설팅 성과 대시보드 — 웹앱 (v9, 담당자별 P~Z 추가)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * v7에서 바뀐 것
 *   1) 캐시를 미리 채운다 — 30분마다 도는 트리거가 시트를 대신 읽어 둔다.
 *      사용자는 시트 읽기를 기다리지 않는다. (이게 가장 큰 개선)
 *   2) 캐시가 따뜻하면 화면에 데이터를 바로 실어 보낸다 — 왕복 1회로 끝난다.
 *      캐시가 비어 있을 때만 화면 먼저 → 데이터 나중 방식으로 넘어간다.
 *   3) 읽는 열을 파서가 실제로 쓰는 것만 남겼다.  5.0만 셀 → 3.1만 셀
 *   4) Sheets 고급 서비스가 켜져 있으면 batchGet 한 번으로 읽는다 (2~4배 빠름).
 *      꺼져 있으면 예전 방식으로 자동 대체되므로 그냥 두어도 동작한다.
 *   5) 캐시 유지 시간 10분 → 6시간
 *
 * 처음 한 번 해야 할 일 — 트리거 등록 (아래 둘 중 하나)
 *   (가) 편집기 왼쪽 ⏰ 트리거 → 트리거 추가 →
 *        함수 `캐시채우기` · 시간 기반 · 분 단위 타이머 · 30분마다 → 저장
 *   (나) 함수 목록에서 `설치` 를 골라 실행 (권한 화면이 한 번 더 뜬다)
 *
 * 주소 뒤 옵션:  ?data=1 → JSON   ?callback=함수 → JSONP   ?fresh=1 → 캐시 무시
 * 시트는 읽기만 하며 수정하지 않습니다.
 */

var SHEET_ID  = '1PR1M6AfYkzmvYlzFKkV4KRhJWTWs0rzZBmroZ3CSwyc';
var CACHE_SEC = 21600;               /* 6시간 (CacheService 최대값) */
var CACHE_KEY = 'gsdash_v9';
var CHUNK     = 90000;               /* 값 1개 100KB 한도 아래로 */

/* 읽을 영역 — [시작행, 끝행(0이면 마지막행까지), 시작열, 끝열]  모두 1부터 셈
   파서가 실제로 건드리는 열만 남겼다. 좌표는 시트와 똑같이 유지된다. */
var BLOCKS = [
  { sheet: '통계', max: 2100, ranges: [
      [  5,   0,   3,  14],   /* C~N   미팅 원장 (마지막 행까지) */
      [  1, 135,  16,  26],   /* P~Z   담당자별 미팅·계약 (연간 + 월별) */
      [  1, 225,  28,  41],   /* AB~AO 영업회의용 주간 문의 + 월별 집계표 */
      [  1, 305,  67,  86],   /* BO~CH 사업형태별 문의·미팅·계약 (월 21섹터) */
      [  1, 130,  96, 244]    /* CR~IJ 권역 정의 + 권역별 문의·미팅·담당자 */
  ]},
  { sheet: '말',   max: 560,  ranges: [
      [  1, 550,   3,  15],   /* C~O   주차별 전체문의 · 사업형태별 */
      [  1, 550,  21,  27],   /* U~AA  미팅 · 계약 */
      [  1, 550,  31,  36],   /* AE~AJ 연간 사업형태별 */
      [  1, 550,  51,  63],   /* AY~BK 미팅 간 달 · 용량구간 · 담당자 */
      [  1,  30,  64,  65],   /* BL~BM 연도별 전체문의 */
      [  1,  30,  71,  90]    /* BS~CL 월별 요약 · 목표 */
  ]},
  { sheet: '미팅26', max: 70, ranges: [
      [  1,  70,  14,  31]    /* N~AE 영업회의용 이번 주 미팅 목록 · 요약 */
  ]}
];

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- 진입점 */
function doGet(e) {
  var p = (e && e.parameter) ? e.parameter : {};
  var fresh = !!p.fresh;

  if (p.data || p.callback) {
    var json = getPayloadJson(fresh);
    if (p.callback && /^[A-Za-z0-9_$]{1,64}$/.test(p.callback)) {
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(p.callback + '(' + json + ');')
        .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JAVASCRIPT);
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(json)
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }

  /* 캐시가 이미 차 있으면 데이터를 화면에 같이 실어 보낸다 (왕복 1회).
     비어 있으면 null 을 실어 보내고, 브라우저가 화면을 먼저 그린 뒤 따로 받아 간다. */
  var warm = fresh ? null : readCache();
  var t = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('index');
  t.DATA = warm ? warm : 'null';
  return t.evaluate()
    .setTitle('그랜드썬 컨설팅 성과 대시보드')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}

/* 브라우저가 google.script.run 으로 부르는 함수 */
function getDashboardData(fresh) {
  return getPayloadJson(!!fresh);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------- 트리거 (미리 채우기) */
function 캐시채우기() {
  var t0 = new Date().getTime();
  var json = getPayloadJson(true);
  Logger.log('캐시 갱신 ' + (new Date().getTime() - t0) + 'ms · '
             + Math.round(json.length / 1024) + 'KB');
}

function 설치() {
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) {
    if (t.getHandlerFunction() === '캐시채우기') ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
  });
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('캐시채우기').timeBased().everyMinutes(30).create();
  캐시채우기();
  Logger.log('30분마다 캐시를 미리 채우도록 등록했습니다.');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ 캐시 계층 */
function readCache() {
  var cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  var meta = cache.get(CACHE_KEY + '_n');
  if (!meta) return null;
  var n = parseInt(meta, 10), parts = [];
  for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    var s = cache.get(CACHE_KEY + '_' + k);
    if (s === null) return null;          /* 일부만 남았으면 무효 */
    parts.push(s);
  }
  return parts.join('');
}

function writeCache(json) {
  try {
    var cache = CacheService.getScriptCache(), map = {}, i = 0, k = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < json.length; i += CHUNK) map[CACHE_KEY + '_' + (k++)] = json.substring(i, i + CHUNK);
    map[CACHE_KEY + '_n'] = String(k);
    cache.putAll(map, CACHE_SEC);
  } catch (err) { /* 캐시는 실패해도 넘어간다 */ }
}

function getPayloadJson(fresh) {
  if (!fresh) {
    var hit = readCache();
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  var json = JSON.stringify(collectData());
  writeCache(json);
  return json;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ 데이터 수집 */
function collectData() {
  try {
    var out = { at: new Date().toISOString() };
    var viaApi = false;
    try { viaApi = (typeof Sheets !== 'undefined' && Sheets.Spreadsheets); } catch (e) { viaApi = false; }
    if (viaApi) {
      var got = readViaApi();
      out.tongye = got['통계'];
      out.mal    = got['말'];
      out.meeting26 = got['미팅26'];
      out.via    = 'api';
    } else {
      var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID);
      out.tongye = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[0]);
      out.mal    = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[1]);
      out.meeting26 = readViaSheet(ss, BLOCKS[2]);
      out.via    = 'app';
    }
    return out;
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err) };
  }
}

/* --- 빠른 경로: Sheets 고급 서비스 batchGet (요청 1회) --- */
function readViaApi() {
  var ranges = [], plan = [];
  BLOCKS.forEach(function (blk) {
    blk.ranges.forEach(function (r) {
      ranges.push("'" + blk.sheet + "'!" + colA1(r[2]) + r[0] + ':' + colA1(r[3]) + (r[1] ? r[1] : ''));
      plan.push({ sheet: blk.sheet, r0: r[0], c0: r[2], max: blk.max });
    });
  });
  var res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.Values.batchGet(SHEET_ID, {
    ranges: ranges,
    valueRenderOption: 'FORMATTED_VALUE',
    dateTimeRenderOption: 'FORMATTED_STRING'
  });
  var grids = {};
  (res.valueRanges || []).forEach(function (vr, ix) {
    var q = plan[ix];
    if (!grids[q.sheet]) grids[q.sheet] = {};
    paint(grids[q.sheet], vr.values || [], q.r0, q.c0, q.max);
  });
  var out = {};
  BLOCKS.forEach(function (blk) { out[blk.sheet] = flatten(grids[blk.sheet] || {}); });
  return out;
}

/* --- 대체 경로: SpreadsheetApp --- */
function readViaSheet(ss, blk) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(blk.sheet);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('"' + blk.sheet + '" 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다.');
  var lastRow = Math.min(sh.getLastRow() || 1, blk.max);
  var lastCol = sh.getMaxColumns();
  var grid = {};
  blk.ranges.forEach(function (r) {
    var r0 = r[0], r1 = r[1] ? Math.min(r[1], blk.max) : lastRow;
    var c0 = r[2], c1 = Math.min(r[3], lastCol);
    if (r1 < r0 || c1 < c0) return;
    paint(grid, sh.getRange(r0, c0, r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1).getDisplayValues(), r0, c0, blk.max);
  });
  return flatten(grid);
}

/* 읽어 온 직사각형을 시트와 같은 절대 좌표에 얹는다 */
function paint(grid, vals, r0, c0, max) {
  for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
    var rIx = r0 - 1 + i;
    if (rIx >= max) break;
    var row = vals[i];
    if (!row) continue;
    for (var j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
      var v = row[j];
      if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) continue;
      if (!grid[rIx]) grid[rIx] = {};
      grid[rIx][c0 - 1 + j] = (typeof v === 'string') ? v : String(v);
    }
  }
}

/* 성긴 좌표표를 배열로 — 빈 칸은 '', 뒤쪽 여백은 잘라낸다 */
function flatten(grid) {
  var maxR = -1, r, c;
  for (var k in grid) { r = parseInt(k, 10); if (r > maxR) maxR = r; }
  var out = [];
  for (r = 0; r <= maxR; r++) {
    var g = grid[r];
    if (!g) { out.push([]); continue; }
    var e = -1;
    for (var k2 in g) { c = parseInt(k2, 10); if (c > e) e = c; }
    var line = new Array(e + 1);
    for (c = 0; c <= e; c++) line[c] = (g[c] === undefined) ? '' : g[c];
    out.push(line);
  }
  return out;
}

function colA1(n) {
  var s = '';
  while (n > 0) { var m = (n - 1) % 26; s = String.fromCharCode(65 + m) + s; n = (n - m - 1) / 26; }
  return s;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- 점검용 (수동 실행) */
function 속도점검() {
  var t0 = new Date().getTime();
  var r = collectData();
  var t1 = new Date().getTime();
  if (r.error) { Logger.log('오류: ' + r.error); return; }
  var json = JSON.stringify(r);
  Logger.log('읽기 ' + (t1 - t0) + 'ms · 경로 ' + r.via
             + ' · 통계 ' + r.tongye.length + '행 · 말 ' + r.mal.length + '행');
  Logger.log('전송량 약 ' + Math.round(json.length / 1024) + 'KB');
  Logger.log('원장 5행: ' + r.tongye[4].slice(2, 9).join(' | '));
  var t2 = new Date().getTime();
  readCache();
  Logger.log('캐시에서 읽기 ' + (new Date().getTime() - t2) + 'ms'
             + (readCache() ? '' : ' — 캐시가 비어 있습니다'));
}

function 캐시비우기() {
  var c = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  var n = parseInt(c.get(CACHE_KEY + '_n') || '0', 10);
  var keys = [CACHE_KEY + '_n'];
  for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) keys.push(CACHE_KEY + '_' + k);
  c.removeAll(keys);
  Logger.log('캐시를 비웠습니다.');
}

````

````html
<body>
<header class="business-header">
<div class="business-brand"><span class="business-brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">G</span><div><small>에너지사업부</small><strong>통합 대시보드</strong></div></div>
<nav class="business-tabs" id="businessTabs" role="tablist" aria-label="사업 파트 선택">
<button type="button" id="part-tab-consulting" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="part-panel-consulting" data-business-part="consulting">컨설팅</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-field" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-field" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="field">필드</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-outsourcing" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-outsourcing" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="outsourcing">외주</button>
<button type="button" id="part-tab-bidding" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="part-panel-bidding" tabindex="-1" data-business-part="bidding">입찰</button>
</nav>
<span class="business-wordmark">GRANDSUN</span>
</header>
<div class="shell business-panel" id="part-panel-consulting" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="part-tab-consulting">
<aside class="rail" id="rail">
<div class="brand">
<div class="brand-mark">G</div>
<div><b>컨설팅 성과<br>대시보드</b><small>GRANDSUN</small></div>
</div>
<div id="nav"></div>
<div class="railfoot">
<button class="btn sm" id="refreshBtn">새로고침</button>
<button class="btn sm" id="syncToggle">데이터 연결</button>
<button class="btn sm" id="themeBtn">다크</button>
</div>
</aside>
<main class="main">
<div class="topbar">
<button class="btn railtoggle" id="railBtn">☰</button>
<h1 id="sectTitle">전체 실적</h1>
<div class="spacer"></div>
<span class="chip" id="statusChip"><span class="dot"></span><span id="statusTxt">내장 데이터</span></span>
</div>
<section class="sync hide" id="syncPanel">
<h3>구글 시트 연결</h3>
<p>Apps Script 웹앱 주소로 열면 <b>열 때마다 시트를 새로 읽습니다.</b></p>
<div class="field"><span><b>연결 주소 (Apps Script 웹앱)</b></span>
<input type="url" id="urlScript" placeholder="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycb...../exec">
<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)">문제가 있으면
<a id="openScript" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--s1)">이 주소를 브라우저에서 직접 열어</a>
보세요.</span></div>
<div class="field"><span>통계 시트 CSV 주소 (예비)</span>
<input type="url" id="urlTongye" placeholder="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-.../pub?...output=csv"></div>
<div class="field"><span>말 시트 CSV 주소 (예비)</span>
<input type="url" id="urlMal" placeholder="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-.../pub?...output=csv"></div>
<div class="actions">
<button class="btn primary" id="connectBtn">연결하고 불러오기</button>
<button class="btn" id="clearBtn">기본값으로</button>
<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)">
<input type="checkbox" id="autoChk" checked> 열 때마다 자동으로 불러오기</label>
</div>
<div class="msg" id="syncMsg"></div>
<div class="sched">
<div class="sched-row">
<label><input type="checkbox" id="dailyChk" checked> <b>매일 지정 시각에 자동 갱신</b></label>
<input type="time" id="dailyTime" value="14:40" step="60">
</div>
<div class="sched-row">
<label><input type="checkbox" id="everyChk"> 열려 있는 동안 주기적으로 갱신</label>
<span><input type="number" id="everyMin" value="30" min="5" max="720" step="5"> 분마다</span>
</div>
<p id="nextRun" class="next-run"></p>
</div>
<div class="drop" id="dropZone">또는 <b>상담일지 엑셀(.xlsx)</b>을 여기로 끌어다 놓으세요 · 클릭해서 선택
<input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.csv" class="hide"></div>
</section>
<section class="periodbar" id="periodbar">
<div class="prow">
<span class="plabel">기간</span>
<div class="seg" id="pmode">
<button data-mode="all">전체</button>
<button data-mode="quarter">분기</button>
<button data-mode="month">월</button>
<button data-mode="cumulative">누적</button>
<button data-mode="year">년도</button>
</div>
<div class="pills" id="ppills"></div>
<div class="spacer" style="flex:1"></div>
<span class="psum" id="psum"></span>
</div>
<div class="prow">
<span class="plabel" id="pbasisLab">기준</span>
<div class="seg" id="pbasis">
<button data-basis="cohort">문의 온 달</button>
<button data-basis="exec">미팅 간 달</button>
</div>
<div class="filters" style="flex:1">
<label>담당자<select id="fOwner"></select></label>
<label>사업형태<select id="fType"></select></label>
<label>유입<select id="fSrc"></select></label>
<label>법인<select id="fCorp"></select></label>
<label class="grow">검색<input type="search" id="fQuery" placeholder="상담번호 · 지역 · 담당자 · 사업형태"></label>
</div>
<button class="btn sm" id="resetBtn">초기화</button>
</div>
</section>
<p class="basis-note" id="basisNote"></p>
<div id="view"></div>
<footer class="foot">
<div><b>문의 온 달</b> — 상담번호 앞 두 자리(문의가 들어온 달)로 묶습니다. 8월에 온 문의는 미팅을 9·10·11월에 가도 <b>8월 실적</b>으로 남습니다. 매월 보고서가 쓰는 기준입니다.</div>
<div><b>미팅 간 달</b> — 미팅날짜가 속한 달로 묶습니다. 8월에 다녀온 미팅이면 문의가 1·2·3월에 왔더라도 <b>8월</b>에 셉니다. 그 달에 실제로 얼마나 움직였는지 볼 때 씁니다.</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>전체 문의</b>는 말 시트 <code>A:H</code>(발전사업·O&amp;M·정부사업 등 총칭),
<b>발전사업 문의·미팅·계약</b>은 통계 시트 <code>BO:CH</code>(21개 사업형태 × 그랜드썬·SP·유지에스·소개),
<b>미팅 간 달</b>은 말 시트 <code>AY:BK</code>, <b>권역별</b>은 통계 시트 <code>CU:IJ</code>,
<b>용량·담당자·원장</b>은 통계 시트 미팅 원장 <code>C5:N</code>을 씁니다.</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>목표</b> — 전체 문의 월 1,500건 · 발전사업 문의 월 787건(마케팅 700 + 소개 87) ·
미팅 월 72건(주 17건) · 계약 용량 연 150MW(월 목표는 말 시트 <code>CE</code>열).</div>
<div style="margin-top:8px">계약 건수는 통계 BO:CH 기준입니다. 미팅 원장 기준은 미팅을 거쳐 맺은 계약만이라 조금 적습니다.</div>
<div id="footStamp" style="margin-top:8px"></div>
</footer>
</main>
</div>
````
