````html
<th class="num">마케팅</th><th class="num">소개</th><th class="num">소개 비중</th>
<th class="num">마케팅</th><th class="num">소개</th><th class="num">소개 비중</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ AX.map((g,k)=>{
const ti=mkI[k]+rfI[k], tm=mkM[k]+rfM[k], tk=mkK[k]+rfK[k];
return `<tr><td class="left hi">${esc(g.label)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C2}">${i(mkI[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C5}">${i(rfI[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(rfI[k],ti)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C2}">${i(mkM[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C5}">${i(rfM[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(rfM[k],tm)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C2}">${i(mkK[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${C5}">${i(rfK[k])}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(rfK[k],tk)}</td>
<td class="num hi">${pctS(tm,ti)}</td></tr>`;
}).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td>
<td class="num">${i(T(mkI))}</td><td class="num">${i(T(rfI))}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(T(rfI),T(mkI)+T(rfI))}</td>
<td class="num">${i(T(mkM))}</td><td class="num">${i(T(rfM))}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(T(rfM),T(mkM)+T(rfM))}</td>
<td class="num">${i(T(mkK))}</td><td class="num">${i(T(rfK))}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(T(rfK),T(mkK)+T(rfK))}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(T(mkM)+T(rfM),T(mkI)+T(rfI))}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`
+ `<p class="src"><b style="color:${C2}">마케팅</b>은 문의 ${i(T(mkI))}건 → 미팅 ${i(T(mkM))}건
(<b>${pctS(T(mkM),T(mkI))}</b>) → 계약 ${i(T(mkK))}건,
<b style="color:${C5}">소개</b>는 문의 ${i(T(rfI))}건 → 미팅 ${i(T(rfM))}건
(<b>${pctS(T(rfM),T(rfI))}</b>) → 계약 ${i(T(rfK))}건입니다.
소개가 문의 대비 미팅 전환에서 <b>${d1(pct(T(rfM),T(rfI))-pct(T(mkM),T(mkI)))}%p</b> 앞섭니다.</p>`,
'통계 BO:CH');
})()
+ `<div class="grid2">`
+ panel('월별 마케팅 문의 (법인별)', '통계 BO:CH',
chartBars({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'건',fmt:i,stacked:true,height:240,
aria:'월별 마케팅 문의',
series:[{name:'그랜드썬',color:C1,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].inq.gs)},
{name:'SP',color:C4,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].inq.sp)},
{name:'유지에스',color:C6,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].inq.ug)}]}))
+ panel('월별 소개 — 문의 · 미팅 · 계약', '통계 BO:CH',
chartLine({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:240,
aria:'월별 소개',
series:[{name:'소개 문의',color:C5,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].inq.ref)},
{name:'소개 미팅',color:C2,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].mt.ref)},
{name:'소개 계약',color:C3,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].ctr.ref)}]}))
+ `</div>`
+ panel('미팅 간 달 기준 유입', `${periodLabel()} · 말 시트 AY:BK`,
`<div class="tblwrap"><table><thead><tr><th class="left">유입</th>
<th class="num">미팅 건수</th><th class="num">미팅 용량</th><th class="num">1건 평균</th>
<th class="num">건수 비중</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td class="left hi">마케팅</td><td class="num hi">${i(E.mkN)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(E.mkCap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(E.mkN?E.mkCap/E.mkN:0)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(E.mkN,E.n)}</td></tr>
<tr><td class="left hi">소개</td><td class="num hi">${i(E.refN)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(E.refCap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(E.refN?E.refCap/E.refN:0)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(E.refN,E.n)}</td></tr>
</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td><td class="num">${i(E.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(E.cap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(E.n?E.cap/E.n:0)} kW</td>
<td class="num">100%</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`);
}
function viewRegion(){
const ms=selMonths();
const G=regionFor(ms);
if(!G.length) return sectHead('지역별', periodLabel())
+ panel('지역별','', '<p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:0">해당 기간의 지역별 표를 찾지 못했습니다.</p>');
const COLS=[C1,C2,C3,C4,C5,C6];
const RG_TINT={'수도권':'#f4d7dd','충청권':'#fbdfcc','강원권':'#fcefcd',
'영남권':'#dae9d9','호남권':'#d5e4e3','제주':'#dcd7eb'};
const rgCell=nm=>`<td class="left hi" style="background:${RG_TINT[nm]||'var(--plane)'};color:#1b1b1b">${esc(nm)}</td>`;
const SUB={'자가':'자가소비','자가소비':'자가소비','발전사업':'발전사업','임대':'임대'};
const byTitle=t=>G.find(g=>g.title===t);
const gInq=byTitle('문의'), gMt=byTitle('미팅');
const ownGroups=G.filter(g=>/담당자/.test(g.title));
const gOwn=ownGroups[0];
const names = (gInq||gMt||G[0]).regions.map(r=>r.region);
const pick=(g,nm)=>{
if(!g) return null;
return g.regions.find(x=>x.region===nm) || {vals:g.cols.map(()=>0), sum:0};
};
const slideMain = (gInq||gMt) ? `<div class="tblwrap" style="max-height:none"><table class="grp">
<thead>
<tr><th class="left" rowspan="2"></th>
${gInq?`<th class="num gL" colspan="${gInq.cols.length}">문의</th>`:''}
${gMt ?`<th class="num gL" colspan="${gMt.cols.length}">미팅</th>`:''}
<th class="num gL">문의 계</th><th class="num">미팅 계</th><th class="num">전환율</th></tr>
<tr>
${gInq?gInq.cols.map((c,k)=>`<th class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${esc(SUB[c]||c)}</th>`).join(''):''}
${gMt ?gMt.cols.map((c,k)=>`<th class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${esc(SUB[c]||c)}</th>`).join(''):''}
<th class="num gL"></th><th class="num"></th><th class="num"></th></tr>
</thead><tbody>`
+ names.map(nm=>{
const a=pick(gInq,nm), b=pick(gMt,nm);
return `<tr>${rgCell(nm)}`
+ (a? a.vals.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${v?i(v):'<span style="color:var(--muted)">0</span>'}</td>`).join(''):'')
+ (b? b.vals.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${v?i(v):'<span style="color:var(--muted)">0</span>'}</td>`).join(''):'')
+ `<td class="num hi gL">${a?i(a.sum):'–'}</td>
<td class="num hi">${b?i(b.sum):'–'}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${(a&&b)?pctS(b.sum,a.sum):'–'}</td></tr>`;
}).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td>`
+ (gInq? gInq.tot.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${i(v)}</td>`).join(''):'')
+ (gMt ? gMt.tot.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num${k===0?' gL':''}">${i(v)}</td>`).join(''):'')
+ `<td class="num gL">${gInq?i(gInq.totSum):'–'}</td>
<td class="num">${gMt?i(gMt.totSum):'–'}</td>
<td class="num">${(gInq&&gMt)?pctS(gMt.totSum,gInq.totSum):'–'}</td>
</tr></tfoot></table></div>` : '';
const oKeep = gOwn ? gOwn.cols.map((c,k)=>k).filter(k=>gOwn.tot[k]>0) : [];
const slideOwn = (gOwn && oKeep.length) ? `<div class="tblwrap" style="max-height:none"><table>
<thead><tr><th class="left"></th>
${oKeep.map(k=>`<th class="num">${esc(gOwn.cols[k])}</th>`).join('')}
<th class="num">합계</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ gOwn.regions.map(r=>`<tr>${rgCell(r.region)}`
+ oKeep.map(k=>`<td class="num">${r.vals[k]?i(r.vals[k]):'<span style="color:var(--muted)">·</span>'}</td>`).join('')
+ `<td class="num hi">${r.sum?i(r.sum):'<span style="color:var(--muted)">·</span>'}</td></tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td>`
+ oKeep.map(k=>`<td class="num">${i(gOwn.tot[k])}</td>`).join('')
+ `<td class="num">${i(gOwn.totSum)}</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>` : '';
const defs=(DB.regionDefs||[]);
const defNote = defs.length
? `<p class="src" style="margin-top:10px">`
+ defs.map(d=>`<b style="background:${RG_TINT[d.name]||'transparent'};color:#1b1b1b;
padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px">${esc(d.name)}</b> ${esc(d.area||'')}`).join(' &nbsp;·&nbsp; ')
+ `</p>` : '';
const slide = panel(`${periodLabel()} 신규 문의 · 미팅 — 지역별`,
'발표자료와 같은 모양입니다 · 통계 CU:IJ',
`<div class="grid2">`
+ `<div>` + panelSub('문의 · 미팅') + slideMain + `</div>`
+ `<div>` + panelSub('지역별 미팅 현황 (신규 + 소개)') + slideOwn + `</div>`
+ `</div>`
+ ((gOwn && gMt && gOwn.totSum!==gMt.totSum)
? `<p class="src">담당자별 표의 합계 <b>${i(gOwn.totSum)}건</b>은 왼쪽 미팅 합계
<b>${i(gMt.totSum)}건</b>과 <b>${i(Math.abs(gMt.totSum-gOwn.totSum))}건</b> 차이가 납니다 —
시트에서 담당자가 적히지 않은 미팅이 그만큼 있다는 뜻입니다.</p>` : '')
+ defNote, '통계 CU:IJ');
const gridTbl=(g, color)=>`<div class="tblwrap" style="max-height:none"><table><thead><tr>
<th class="left">권역</th>`
+ g.cols.map(c=>`<th class="num">${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')
+ `<th class="num">합계</th><th class="num">비중</th><th class="left">추세</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ g.rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.sum-a.sum).map(r=>`<tr>${rgCell(r.region)}`
+ r.vals.map(v=>`<td class="num">${v?i(v):'<span style="color:var(--muted)">–</span>'}</td>`).join('')
+ `<td class="num hi">${i(r.sum)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(r.sum,g.totSum)}</td>
<td class="left">${sparkHTML(r.vals, color, {kind:'bar', w:110, h:26, title:r.region})}</td></tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td>`
+ g.tot.map(v=>`<td class="num">${i(v)}</td>`).join('')
+ `<td class="num">${i(g.totSum)}</td><td class="num">100%</td><td></td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`;
const gi=regionGrid('문의'), gm=regionGrid('미팅');
const top=a=>a.rows.slice().sort((x,y)=>y.sum-x.sum)[0]||{region:'–',sum:0};
const monthly = panel(`${axisWord()} 권역별 문의 · 미팅`,
`${periodLabel()} · 세로는 권역, 가로는 ${axisWord().replace('별','')} · 통계 CU:IJ`,
panelSub('문의 (발전사업 + 자가소비 + 임대)') + gridTbl(gi, C1)
+ `<div style="height:14px"></div>`
+ panelSub('미팅 (발전사업 + 자가소비 + 임대)') + gridTbl(gm, C2)
+ `<div style="margin-top:14px">`
+ chartBars({labels:gi.cols,unit:'건',fmt:i,stacked:true,height:265,
aria:'월별 권역별 문의',
series:gi.rows.map((r,k)=>({name:r.region,color:COLS[k%COLS.length],values:r.vals}))})
+ `</div>`
+ `<p class="src">문의가 가장 많은 권역은 <b>${esc(top(gi).region)}</b> ${i(top(gi).sum)}건
(${pctS(top(gi).sum, gi.totSum)}), 미팅이 가장 많은 권역은
<b>${esc(top(gm).region)}</b> ${i(top(gm).sum)}건입니다.
전체 전환율은 <b>${pctS(gm.totSum, gi.totSum)}</b>입니다.</p>`,
'통계 CU:IJ');
const kpis = (gInq&&gMt) ? kpiHTML(markWhole([
{lab:'권역 문의', color:C1, val:i(gInq.totSum), unit:'건',
sub:gInq.cols.map((c,k)=>`${SUB[c]||c} ${i(gInq.tot[k])}`).join(' · ')},
{lab:'권역 미팅', color:C2, val:i(gMt.totSum), unit:'건',
sub:gMt.cols.map((c,k)=>`${SUB[c]||c} ${i(gMt.tot[k])}`).join(' · ')},
{lab:'문의 → 미팅', color:C3, val:pctS(gMt.totSum,gInq.totSum), unit:'', sub:'권역 표 기준'},
{lab:'1위 권역', color:C4, val:top(gi).region, unit:'', sub:`문의 ${i(top(gi).sum)}건`}
])) : '';
const conv = (gInq&&gMt) ? panel('권역별 문의 → 미팅 전환율', `${periodLabel()} · 사업 종류별로도`,
`<div class="tblwrap" style="max-height:none"><table><thead><tr><th class="left">권역</th>
<th class="num">문의</th><th class="num">미팅</th><th class="num">전환율</th>`
+ gInq.cols.map(c=>`<th class="num">${esc(SUB[c]||c)} 전환</th>`).join('')
+ `</tr></thead><tbody>`
+ gInq.regions.map(r=>{
const m2=pick(gMt,r.region);
return `<tr>${rgCell(r.region)}
<td class="num">${i(r.sum)}</td><td class="num hi">${i(m2.sum)}</td>
<td class="num"><b>${pctS(m2.sum,r.sum)}</b></td>`
+ r.vals.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(m2.vals[k]||0,v)}</td>`).join('')
+ `</tr>`;
}).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td>
<td class="num">${i(gInq.totSum)}</td><td class="num">${i(gMt.totSum)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(gMt.totSum,gInq.totSum)}</td>`
+ gInq.tot.map((v,k)=>`<td class="num">${pctS(gMt.tot[k]||0,v)}</td>`).join('')
+ `</tr></tfoot></table></div>`, '통계 CU:IJ') : '';
const ownDetail = ownGroups.slice(1).map(g=>panel(
`담당자 × 권역 — ${g.detail||g.title}`,
`${periodLabel()} · 누가 어디로 미팅을 갔나`,
heatHTML(g.cols, g.regions.map(r=>r.region),
g.cols.map((c,k)=>g.regions.map(r=>r.vals[k])), i, '담당자', 'warm'),
'통계 CU:IJ')).join('');
return filterNote()
+ sectHead('지역별', periodLabel())
+ sheetWholeNote('통계 CU:IJ 권역별 표')
+ (()=>{
const SCq=sectorFor(ms).tot.inq.tot;
if(!(SCq>0) || !(gInq&&gInq.totSum>0) || SCq===gInq.totSum) return '';
return `<div class="basis-note" style="margin:0 0 12px">
이 화면의 <b>권역 문의 ${i(gInq.totSum)}건</b>은 <b>문의</b> 화면의
<b>${i(SCq)}건</b>과 다릅니다 — 권역 표(CU:IJ)는 <b>발전사업 · 자가소비 · 임대</b> 셋만 세고,
문의 화면(BO:CH)은 <b>방수 · 팩토링 · 분양 · 기타 · 무응답</b>까지 21개 사업형태를 모두 세기 때문입니다.
차이 <b>${i(SCq-gInq.totSum)}건</b>이 그 나머지입니다. <b>미팅은 두 표가 정확히 일치</b>합니다.</div>`;
})()
+ `<div class="basis-note" style="margin:0 0 12px">발표자료(<b>컨설팅_신규 문의, 미팅_지역별</b>)와 같은 모양으로 맞췄습니다 —
왼쪽은 <b>문의 · 미팅</b>을 발전사업 · 자가소비 · 임대로, 오른쪽은 <b>담당자별 미팅(신규+소개)</b>입니다.
기간 버튼을 바꾸면 그 기간으로 다시 셉니다. 통계 시트 CU:IJ 기준.</div>`
+ kpis
+ slide
+ monthly
+ conv
+ ownDetail;
}
function viewGoal(){
const ms=selMonths(), all=dataMonths();
const ok=inquiryUsable();
const Q=ok?inqFor(ms):null, SC=sectorFor(ms), G=goalFor(ms);
const L=sumRows(rowsIn(ms)), E=malMeetFor(ms);
const bm=sectorByMonth();
return filterNote()
+ sectHead('목표 달성', periodLabel())
+ sheetWholeNote('시트 집계로 계산하는 목표 대비')
+ panel('종합 달성률', periodLabel(),
`<div class="blt c2">
${Q?bullet('전체 문의', Q.total, G.inqAll, v=>i(v)+'건'):''}
${bullet('발전사업 문의', SC.tot.inq.tot, G.inqPwr, v=>i(v)+'건')}
${bullet('마케팅 문의', grpMk(SC.tot.inq), G.inqPwrMk, v=>i(v)+'건')}
${bullet('소개 문의', SC.tot.inq.ref, G.inqPwrRef, v=>i(v)+'건')}
${bullet('미팅 건수', SC.tot.mt.tot, G.mtN, v=>i(v)+'건')}
${bullet('계약 용량', L.ctrCap, G.ctrCap, MW)}
</div>
<p class="src">막대가 <b>실적</b>, 검은 세로선이 <b>목표</b>입니다. 배경 띠는 목표의 50% · 80% 지점입니다.</p>
<p class="src"><b>문의</b> 전체 월 1,500건 (발전사업 · O&amp;M · 정부사업 등 총칭) ·
발전사업 월 787건 = 마케팅 700 + 소개 87.<br>
<b>미팅</b> 월 72건 (주 17건). <b>계약 용량</b> 연 150MW, 월 목표는 말 시트 <code>CE</code>열
(12,100 · 12,600 · 14,600 … 10,600 kW, 열두 달 합 150,000 kW).</p>`)
+ `<div class="grid2">`
+ panel('월별 문의 목표 대비', '전체 문의 1,500건 · 발전사업 787건',
chartBars({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:250,
rule:{value:GOAL.inqAll, label:`전체 목표 ${i(GOAL.inqAll)}건`},
aria:'월별 문의와 목표',
series:[{name:'전체 문의',color:C1,values:all.map(m=>{const x=(DB.msum||[]).find(y=>y.m===m);return x?x.inqTot:0;})},
{name:'발전사업 문의',color:C4,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].inq.tot)}]}))
+ panel('월별 미팅 목표 대비', '월 72건 (주 17건)',
chartBars({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:250,
rule:{value:GOAL.mtN, label:`월 목표 ${GOAL.mtN}건`},
aria:'월별 미팅과 목표',
series:[{name:'문의 온 달',color:C2,values:all.map(m=>bm[m].mt.tot)},
{name:'미팅 간 달',color:C6,values:all.map(m=>malMeetFor([m]).n)}]}))
+ `</div>`
+ panel('월별 계약 용량 목표 대비', '옅은 기둥이 그 달 목표, 그 안이 실적입니다 · 말 시트 CE열 · 연 150MW',
chartBars({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'MW',fmt:d1,height:265,
aria:'월별 계약 용량 목표 대비',
ghost:all.map(m=>{const x=(DB.msum||[]).find(y=>y.m===m);return (x?x.goalCtr:0)/1000;}),
series:[{name:'계약 용량',color:C3,values:all.map(m=>sumRows(rowsIn([m])).ctrCap/1000)}]})
+ (()=>{
const act=all.map(m=>sumRows(rowsIn([m])).ctrCap);
const gl =all.map(m=>{const x=(DB.msum||[]).find(y=>y.m===m);return x?x.goalCtr:0;});
const sa=act.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0), sg=gl.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const hit=all.filter((m,k)=>act[k]>=gl[k] && gl[k]>0);
return `<p class="src">누계 <b>${MW(sa)}</b> / 목표 <b>${MW(sg)}</b> →
<b style="color:${sa>=sg?'var(--good)':sa>=sg*0.7?'var(--warn)':'var(--crit)'}">${d1(sg?sa/sg*100:0)}%</b> ·
월 목표를 채운 달 <b>${hit.length}/${all.length}개월</b>${hit.length?` — ${hit.map(m=>m+'월').join(' · ')}`:''} ·
연 목표 150MW 대비 <b>${d1(sa/150000*100)}%</b></p>`;
})())
+ panel('월별 달성률 표', '문의 · 미팅 · 계약 한눈에',
`<div class="tblwrap"><table><thead><tr><th class="left">월</th>
<th class="num">전체 문의</th><th class="num">목표</th><th class="num">달성</th>
<th class="num">발전 문의</th><th class="num">목표</th><th class="num">달성</th>
<th class="num">미팅</th><th class="num">목표</th><th class="num">달성</th>
<th class="num">계약용량 (kW)</th><th class="num">목표 (kW)</th><th class="num">달성</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ all.map(m=>{
const q=(DB.msum||[]).find(x=>x.m===m)||{}, s=bm[m], c=sumRows(rowsIn([m]));
const gc=q.goalCtr||0;
return `<tr><td class="left hi">${m}월</td>
<td class="num">${i(q.inqTot||0)}</td><td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${i(GOAL.inqAll)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(q.inqTot||0,GOAL.inqAll)}</td>
<td class="num">${i(s.inq.tot)}</td><td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${i(GOAL.inqPwr)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(s.inq.tot,GOAL.inqPwr)}</td>
<td class="num">${i(s.mt.tot)}</td><td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${i(GOAL.mtN)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(s.mt.tot,GOAL.mtN)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(c.ctrCap)}</td><td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${i(gc)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(c.ctrCap,gc)}</td></tr>`;
}).join('')
+ `</tbody></table></div>`);
}
function viewCapacity(){
const ms=selMonths(), all=dataMonths();
const rows=rowsIn(ms), S=sumRows(rows);
const B=capBands(rows);
const E=malMeetFor(ms);
const bkN=CAP_BANDS.map(()=>0);
ms.forEach(m=>{
const blk=(DB.months||[]).find(x=>x.m===m); if(!blk) return;
(blk.buckets||[]).forEach((b,ix)=>{ if(ix<bkN.length) bkN[ix]+=b.n; });
});
const bkList=CAP_BANDS.map((b,ix)=>({label:b.label, n:bkN[ix]}));
const bkSum=bkList.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.n,0);
const kpis=[
{lab:'미팅 용량', color:C2, val:d1(S.cap/1000), unit:'MW', sub:`${i(S.n)}건`},
{lab:'1건 평균', color:C2, val:d1(S.avg), unit:'kW', sub:'미팅 원장 기준'},
{lab:'계약 용량', color:C3, val:d1(S.ctrCap/1000), unit:'MW', sub:`${i(S.ctr)}건`},
{lab:'계약 1건 평균', color:C3, val:d1(S.ctrAvg), unit:'kW', sub:''},
{lab:'마케팅 평균', color:C1, val:d1(S.mk?S.mkCap/S.mk:0), unit:'kW', sub:`${i(S.mk)}건`},
{lab:'소개 평균', color:C5, val:d1(S.ref?S.refCap/S.ref:0), unit:'kW', sub:`${i(S.ref)}건`}
];
return filterNote()
+ sectHead('용량 분석', periodLabel())
+ kpiHTML(kpis)
+ panel('매월 평균 용량과 미팅 횟수', '막대는 미팅 건수, 선은 1건 평균 용량',
chartBars({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:210,noTable:true,
aria:'월별 미팅 건수',
series:[{name:'미팅 건수',color:C2,values:all.map(m=>sumRows(rowsIn([m])).n)}]})
+ chartLine({labels:all.map(mLab),unit:'kW',fmt:d1,height:190,noTable:true,
aria:'월별 평균 용량',
series:[{name:'1건 평균 용량',color:C3,values:all.map(m=>{const s=sumRows(rowsIn([m]));return s.avg;})}]}),
'통계 미팅 원장')
+ `<div class="grid2">`
+ panel('용량 구간별 미팅', `${periodLabel()} · 미만 기준 (원장 계산)`,
chartBars({labels:B.map(b=>b.label),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:250,
aria:'용량 구간별 미팅 건수',
series:[{name:'미팅 건수',color:C2,values:B.map(b=>b.n)}]})
+ `<div class="tblwrap" style="margin-top:12px"><table><thead><tr>
<th class="left">구간</th><th class="num">건수</th><th class="num">비중</th>
<th class="num">용량</th><th class="num">평균</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ B.map(b=>`<tr><td class="left hi">${esc(b.label)}</td><td class="num hi">${i(b.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${pctS(b.n,S.n)}</td><td class="num">${d1(b.cap)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${d1(b.n?b.cap/b.n:0)} kW</td></tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody></table></div>`)
+ panel('용량 구간 (말 시트 집계)', `${periodLabel()} · 말 시트 AY:BK`,
(bkList.length? chartBars({labels:bkList.map(b=>b.label),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:250,
aria:'말 시트 용량 구간',
series:[{name:'미팅 건수',color:C2,values:bkList.map(b=>b.n)}]})
+ `<div class="tblwrap" style="margin-top:12px"><table><thead><tr>
<th class="left">구간</th><th class="num">건수</th><th class="num">비중</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ bkList.map(b=>`<tr><td class="left hi">${esc(b.label)}</td>
<td class="num hi">${i(b.n)}</td><td class="num">${pctS(b.n,bkSum)}</td></tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td><td class="num">${i(bkSum)}</td>
<td class="num">100%</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`
: '<p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:0">해당 기간 데이터가 없습니다.</p>'))
+ `</div>`
+ panel('월별 용량 요약', '미팅 간 달 기준 용량도 함께',
`<div class="tblwrap"><table><thead><tr><th class="left">월</th>
<th class="num">미팅 건수</th><th class="num">미팅 용량</th><th class="num">1건 평균</th>
<th class="num">계약 건수</th><th class="num">계약 용량</th>
<th class="num">미팅 간 달 건수</th><th class="num">미팅 간 달 용량</th>
<th class="num">평균</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ all.map(m=>{const s=sumRows(rowsIn([m])), e=malMeetFor([m]);
return `<tr><td class="left hi">${m}월</td>
<td class="num">${i(s.n)}</td><td class="num">${d1(s.cap)} kW</td>
<td class="num hi">${d1(s.avg)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${i(s.ctr)}</td><td class="num">${d1(s.ctrCap)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${i(e.n)}</td><td class="num">${d1(e.cap)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${d1(e.n?e.cap/e.n:0)} kW</td></tr>`;}).join('')
+ `</tbody></table></div>`);
}
function viewOwner(){
const ms=selMonths(), all=dataMonths();
const rows=rowsIn(ms), S=sumRows(rows);
const OL=ownerList(rows);
const OW=malOwnersFor(ms);
const RG=regionFor(ms);
const top=OL[0]||{name:'–',n:0};
const kpis=[
{lab:'미팅 담당자', color:C1, val:i(OL.length), unit:'명', sub:`원장 ${i(S.n)}건 기준`},
{lab:'1위', color:C2, val:top.name, unit:'', sub:`${i(top.n)}건 · ${d1(top.cap/1000)} MW`},
{lab:'1인 평균 미팅', color:C2, val:d1(OL.length?S.n/OL.length:0), unit:'건', sub:''},
{lab:'계약', color:C3, val:i(S.ctr), unit:'건', sub:`용량 ${d1(S.ctrCap/1000)} MW · 원장 기준`},
{lab:'마케팅', color:C2, val:i(S.mk), unit:'건', sub:`${d1(S.mkCap/1000)} MW`},
{lab:'소개', color:C5, val:i(S.ref), unit:'건', sub:`${d1(S.refCap/1000)} MW`}
];
const ownerTbl = `<div class="tblwrap"><table><thead><tr><th class="left">담당자</th>
<th class="num">미팅</th><th class="num">마케팅</th><th class="num">소개</th>
<th class="num">미팅 용량</th><th class="num">1건 평균</th>
<th class="num">계약</th><th class="num">계약률</th><th class="num">계약 용량</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ OL.map(o=>`<tr><td class="left hi">${esc(o.name)}</td>
<td class="num hi">${i(o.n)}</td><td class="num">${i(o.mk)}</td><td class="num">${i(o.ref)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(o.cap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(o.avg)} kW</td>
<td class="num hi">${i(o.ctr)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(o.ctr,o.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(o.ctrCap)} kW</td></tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">합계</td><td class="num">${i(S.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${i(S.mk)}</td><td class="num">${i(S.ref)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(S.cap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(S.avg)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${i(S.ctr)}</td><td class="num">${pctS(S.ctr,S.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(S.ctrCap)} kW</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>`;
const names=OL.map(o=>o.name);
const matrix=names.map(nm=>all.map(m=>rowsIn([m]).filter(r=>r.own===nm).length));
const ownGroups=RG.filter(g=>/담당자/.test(g.title));
const AXo=chartAxis();
const cmp=OL.map(o=>{
const per=AXo.map(g=>{
const rr=rowsIn(g.months).filter(r=>r.own===o.name);
const cap=rr.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r.cap||0),0);
return {n:rr.length, cap, avg: rr.length? cap/rr.length : 0};
});
return {...o, per, nTrend:trendOf(per.map(x=>x.n)), aTrend:trendOf(per.map(x=>x.avg))};
}).sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n);
const maxN=Math.max(...cmp.map(o=>o.n),1);
const maxCap=Math.max(...cmp.map(o=>o.cap),1);
const maxCtr=Math.max(...cmp.map(o=>o.ctr),1);
const maxCtrCap=Math.max(...cmp.map(o=>o.ctrCap),1);
const arrow=t=> t>5?`<b style="color:var(--good)">▲ ${d1(t)}%</b>`
: t<-5?`<b style="color:var(--crit)">▼ ${d1(Math.abs(t))}%</b>`
: `<span style="color:var(--muted)">– 보합</span>`;
const rg = o => o
? `<b>${esc(o.name)}</b> <i>${i(o.n)}건 · ${MW(o.cap)}</i>`
: `<i>없음</i>`;
const cards = `<div class="pcards">` + cmp.map((o,ix)=>{
const col=OWNER_COLORS[ix%OWNER_COLORS.length];
return `<div class="pcard" style="--pc:${col}">
<div class="hd">
<span class="nm"><button class="lnk" data-act="owner" data-val="${esc(o.name)}"
style="color:inherit;border-bottom-color:transparent">${esc(o.name)}</button></span>
<span class="rk">${ix+1}위 · 미팅 ${pctS(o.n,S.n)}</span></div>
<div class="quad">
<div class="q"><b>미팅</b><span>${i(o.n)}<em>건</em></span></div>
<div class="q"><b>미팅 용량</b><span>${d1(o.cap/1000)}<em>MW</em></span></div>
<div class="q"><b>계약 <span style="color:var(--ink2)">${pctS(o.ctr,o.n)}</span></b><span style="color:${o.ctr?'var(--s3)':'var(--muted)'}">${i(o.ctr)}<em>건</em></span></div>
<div class="q"><b>계약 용량</b><span style="color:${o.ctrCap?'var(--s3)':'var(--muted)'}">${d1(o.ctrCap/1000)}<em>MW</em></span></div>
</div>
<div class="rgs">
<div><i>미팅 1건 평균</i><b>${d1(o.avg)} kW</b></div>
<div><i>계약 1건 평균</i><b>${o.ctr? d1(o.ctrAvg)+' kW' : '–'}</b></div>
<div><i>많이 간 지역</i><span>${rg(o.topMt)}</span></div>
<div><i>많이 계약한 지역</i><span>${rg(o.topCtr)}</span></div>
</div>
<div class="sp"><i>${esc(axisWord())} 미팅</i>
${sparkHTML(o.per.map(x=>x.n), col, {kind:'bar', w:96, h:24, title:o.name})}
${arrow(o.nTrend)}</div>
</div>`;
}).join('') + `</div>`;
const cmpTbl = `<div class="tblwrap" style="max-height:none"><table><thead><tr>
<th class="left">필드 미팅자</th>
<th class="num">미팅</th><th class="num">미팅 용량</th><th class="num">미팅 1건 평균</th>
<th class="num">계약</th><th class="num">계약률</th>
<th class="num">계약 용량</th><th class="num">계약 1건 평균</th>
<th class="left">가장 많이 간 미팅 지역</th><th class="left">가장 많이 계약한 지역</th>
<th class="left">미팅 추세</th></tr></thead><tbody>`
+ cmp.map(o=>`<tr>
<td class="left hi"><button class="lnk" data-act="owner" data-val="${esc(o.name)}">${esc(o.name)}</button></td>
<td class="num hi">${i(o.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(o.cap)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${d1(o.avg)} kW</td>
<td class="num hi" style="color:${o.ctr?'var(--s3)':'var(--muted)'}">${i(o.ctr)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:var(--muted)">${pctS(o.ctr,o.n)}</td>
<td class="num" style="color:${o.ctrCap?'var(--s3)':'var(--muted)'}">${d1(o.ctrCap)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${o.ctr? d1(o.ctrAvg)+' kW' : '–'}</td>
<td class="left">${o.topMt? `<b>${esc(o.topMt.name)}</b> <span style="color:var(--muted)">${i(o.topMt.n)}건</span>`:'<span style="color:var(--muted)">–</span>'}</td>
<td class="left">${o.topCtr? `<b style="color:var(--s3)">${esc(o.topCtr.name)}</b> <span style="color:var(--muted)">${i(o.topCtr.n)}건 · ${MW(o.topCtr.cap)}</span>`:'<span style="color:var(--muted)">–</span>'}</td>
<td class="left">${sparkHTML(o.per.map(x=>x.n), C2, {kind:'bar', w:96, h:24, title:o.name})} ${arrow(o.nTrend)}</td>
</tr>`).join('')
+ `</tbody><tfoot><tr><td class="left">전체</td>
<td class="num">${i(S.n)}</td><td class="num">${d1(S.cap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(S.avg)} kW</td>
<td class="num">${i(S.ctr)}</td><td class="num">${pctS(S.ctr,S.n)}</td>
<td class="num">${d1(S.ctrCap)} kW</td><td class="num">${d1(S.ctr?S.ctrCap/S.ctr:0)} kW</td>
<td colspan="3" class="left" style="color:var(--muted)">지역은 통계 미팅 원장 N열(지역) 기준</td>
</tr></tfoot></table></div>`;
const cmpPanel = panel('필드 미팅자 한눈에 비교',
`${periodLabel()} · 미팅이 많은 순 · 이름을 누르면 그 사람만 봅니다 · 통계 미팅 원장`,
cards
+ `<div style="height:16px"></div>` + cmpTbl
+ `<div class="grid2" style="margin-top:14px">`
+ `<div>` + panelSub('미팅 건수 · 계약 건수')
+ chartBars({labels:cmp.map(o=>o.name),unit:'건',fmt:i,height:240,
aria:'필드 미팅자별 미팅·계약 건수',
series:[{name:'미팅',color:C2,colors:cmp.map(o=> o.n===maxN?'var(--good)':C2),values:cmp.map(o=>o.n)},
{name:'계약',color:C3,colors:cmp.map(o=> o.ctr===maxCtr&&maxCtr>0?'var(--good)':C3),values:cmp.map(o=>o.ctr)}]}) + `</div>`
+ `<div>` + panelSub('미팅 용량 · 계약 용량 (MW)')
+ chartBars({labels:cmp.map(o=>o.name),unit:'MW',fmt:d1,height:240,
aria:'필드 미팅자별 용량',
series:[{name:'미팅 용량',color:C2,colors:cmp.map(o=> o.cap===maxCap?'var(--good)':C2),values:cmp.map(o=>o.cap/1000)},
{name:'계약 용량',color:C3,colors:cmp.map(o=> o.ctrCap===maxCtrCap&&maxCtrCap>0?'var(--good)':C3),values:cmp.map(o=>o.ctrCap/1000)}]}) + `</div>`
+ `</div>`, '통계 미팅 원장');
return filterNote()
+ sectHead('담당자 실적', periodLabel())
+ `<div class="basis-note" style="margin:0 0 12px">이 화면은 <b>통계 미팅 원장</b>에서 한 줄씩 직접 센 값입니다 —
미팅 ${i(S.n)}건 · 계약 ${i(S.ctr)}건. 보고 기준인 <b>통계 BO:CH</b>(미팅 ${i(sectorFor(ms).tot.mt.tot)} ·
계약 ${i(sectorFor(ms).tot.ctr.tot)})와는 집계 시점이 달라 조금 차이가 납니다. <b>사람별 배분은 원장에만 있으므로</b> 이 화면은 원장을 씁니다.</div>`
+ kpiHTML(kpis)
+ cmpPanel
+ panel('담당자별 미팅과 계약', `${periodLabel()} · 통계 미팅 원장 기준`,
ownerTbl
+ `<div class="grid2" style="margin-top:12px">`
+ `<div>` + chartBars({labels:OL.map(o=>o.name),unit:'건',fmt:i,stacked:true,height:240,
aria:'담당자별 미팅 건수',
series:[{name:'마케팅',color:C2,values:OL.map(o=>o.mk)},
{name:'소개',color:C5,values:OL.map(o=>o.ref)}]}) + `</div>`

function trendOf(vals){
const v=vals.filter(x=>x>0);
if(v.length<3) return 0;
const h=Math.floor(v.length/2);
const a=v.slice(0,h).reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/h;
const b=v.slice(-h).reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/h;
return a? (b-a)/a*100 : 0;
}
function insightCard(kind, title, body){
const cls = kind==='good'?'goodk' : kind==='warn'?'warnk' : kind==='crit'?'critk' : '';
const lab = kind==='good'?'양호' : kind==='warn'?'주의' : kind==='crit'?'경고' : '관찰';
return `<div class="card ${cls}"><h3>${esc(title)}<span class="kind">${lab}</span></h3>${body}</div>`;
}

.getDashboardData(!!fresh);
});

function renderPeriod(){
document.querySelectorAll('#pmode button').forEach(b=>
b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.mode===state.mode));
document.querySelectorAll('#pbasis button').forEach(b=>
b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.basis===state.basis));
const fixed = sectOf(state.sect).basis !== 'both';
['#pbasis','#pbasisLab'].forEach(sel=>{
const el=document.querySelector(sel); if(el) el.classList.toggle('hide', fixed);
});
const all=dataMonths();
const box=$('#ppills');
if(state.mode==='quarter'){
const qs=[...new Set(all.map(qOf))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
box.innerHTML = qs.map(q=>`<button class="pill q${state.quarters.includes(q)?' on':''}"
data-q="${q}">${q}분기</button>`).join('')
+ `<button class="pill" data-q="all">전체</button>`;
} else if(state.mode==='month' || state.mode==='cumulative'){
box.innerHTML = all.map(m=>`<button class="pill${state.months.includes(m)?' on':''}"
data-m="${m}">${m}월</button>`).join('')
+ (state.mode==='month'?`<button class="pill" data-m="all">전체</button>`:'');
} else {
box.innerHTML = '';
}
const hint = state.mode==='quarter' ? '분기를 여러 개 골라 나란히 비교합니다'
: state.mode==='month'   ? '월을 여러 개 골라 나란히 비교합니다'
: state.mode==='cumulative' ? '고른 달까지 쌓아서 봅니다 (하나만 고르세요)'
: '전체 기간을 분기 단위로 비교합니다';
$('#psum').innerHTML = `<b>${esc(periodLabel())}</b> · ${esc(hint)}`;
}
function refreshFilters(){
const L=DB.ledger;
const f=(sel,vals,keep)=>{
const cur=keep??sel.value;
sel.innerHTML=vals.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}">${esc(v)}</option>`).join('');
sel.value = vals.includes(cur)?cur:vals[0];
};
const FIELD_ORDER=['조성현','최창민','임준길','진으뜸','김종식','정규진'];
const CONS_ORDER =['김동호','용현무','김세종','배승환','김용희'];
const order=(fixed,found)=>[
...fixed.filter(n=>found.includes(n)),
...found.filter(n=>!fixed.includes(n) && n!=='미지정').sort(),
...(found.includes('미지정')?['미지정']:[])];
const fieldNames = order(FIELD_ORDER,
[...new Set(L.map(r=>txt(r.own)||'미지정'))].filter(Boolean));
const consNames  = order(CONS_ORDER,
[...new Set(L.map(r=>txt(r.cons)||'미지정'))].filter(Boolean));
const sel=$('#fOwner');
const grp=(lab,pre,names)=>`<optgroup label="${esc(lab)}">`
+ names.map(n=>`<option value="${esc(pre+n)}">${esc(n)}</option>`).join('') + `</optgroup>`;
sel.innerHTML = `<option value="전체">전체</option>`
+ grp('필드 담당자 (미팅)','F:',fieldNames)
+ grp('컨설팅 담당자','C:',consNames);
const want = state.cons!=='전체' ? 'C:'+state.cons
: state.owner!=='전체' ? 'F:'+state.owner : '전체';
sel.value = want;
if(sel.value!==want){ sel.value='전체'; state.owner='전체'; state.cons='전체'; }
const secs = sectorNames();
const types = secs.length ? secs
: [...new Set(L.map(r=>txt(r.type)))].filter(Boolean).sort();
f($('#fType'),  ['전체',...types], state.type);
const srcs = ['마케팅','소개',...[...new Set(L.map(r=>r.src))].filter(x=>x&&x!=='마케팅'&&x!=='소개').sort()];
const corps = ['그랜드썬','SP','유지에스',
...[...new Set(L.map(r=>r.corp))].filter(x=>x&&!['그랜드썬','SP','유지에스'].includes(x)).sort()];
f($('#fSrc'),   ['전체',...srcs], state.src);
f($('#fCorp'),  ['전체',...corps], state.corp);
$('#fQuery').value=state.query;
state.type=$('#fType').value;
state.src=$('#fSrc').value; state.corp=$('#fCorp').value;
}
function basisNote(){
let warn='';
if(DB.odd && DB.odd.length){
const list=DB.odd.slice(0,4).map(r=>`${esc(r.no)}(${esc(r.date)})`).join(', ');
warn = `<span style="color:var(--crit)">⚠ 통계 시트에 기준연도(${esc(DB.year)})와 다른
미팅날짜가 <b>${DB.odd.length}건</b> 있습니다 — ${list}${DB.odd.length>4?' 외':''}. 오타일 수 있습니다.</span>`;
}
if(sectOf(state.sect).basis!=='both'){
$('#basisNote').innerHTML = warn;
$('#basisNote').classList.toggle('hide', !warn);
return;
}
$('#basisNote').classList.remove('hide');
const ms=selMonths();
const lab = ms.length===1 ? `${ms[0]}월` : periodLabel();
const base = rowsAll();
const nCoh = base.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.cmo)).length;
const nExe = base.filter(r=>ms.includes(r.em)).length;
const head = state.basis==='cohort'
? `<b>문의 온 달</b><span class="tag">보고 기준</span> — ${esc(lab)}에 <b>들어온 문의</b>로 이뤄진 건입니다.
미팅은 그 다음 달에 갔을 수도 있습니다.`
: `<b>미팅 간 달</b> — ${esc(lab)}에 <b>실제로 다녀온 미팅</b>입니다.
문의는 몇 달 전에 왔을 수도 있습니다.`;
const cmp = (nCoh===nExe) ? '' :
`<br><span class="alt">같은 ${esc(lab)}을 두 기준으로 세면 —
문의 온 달 <b>${i(nCoh)}건</b>, 미팅 간 달 <b>${i(nExe)}건</b>. 이만큼 다릅니다.</span>`;
$('#basisNote').innerHTML = `${head}${cmp}${warn?'<br>'+warn:''}`;
}
function render(){
const sc=sectOf(state.sect);
if(sc.basis!=='both') state.basis = sc.basis;
renderNav(); renderPeriod(); basisNote();
try{
view.innerHTML = (VIEWS[state.sect]||viewOverall)();
}catch(err){
view.innerHTML = `<section class="panel"><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px">화면을 그리지 못했습니다</h2>
<p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)">${esc(err.message)}</p></section>`;
}
wireCharts(view);
stampFoot();
window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});
}
$('#nav').addEventListener('click',e=>{
const b=e.target.closest('button[data-sect]'); if(!b) return;
state.sect=b.dataset.sect;
$('#rail').classList.remove('open');
render();
});
$('#railBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#rail').classList.toggle('open'));
view.addEventListener('click',e=>{
const cp=e.target.closest('[data-copy]');
if(cp){
const tsv=document.getElementById(cp.dataset.copy);
if(tsv){
navigator.clipboard.writeText(tsv.textContent).then(()=>{
const o=cp.textContent; cp.textContent='복사했습니다 ✓'; cp.classList.add('done');
setTimeout(()=>{cp.textContent=o; cp.classList.remove('done');},1800);
});
}
return;
}
const k=e.target.closest('[data-kpi]');
if(!k) return;
state.kpiOpen = (state.kpiOpen===k.dataset.kpi) ? null : k.dataset.kpi;
render();
});
view.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
if(e.key!=='Enter' && e.key!==' ') return;
const k=e.target.closest('[data-kpi]'); if(!k) return;
e.preventDefault();
state.kpiOpen = (state.kpiOpen===k.dataset.kpi) ? null : k.dataset.kpi;
render();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
const t=e.target;
if(t && (t.tagName==='INPUT'||t.tagName==='SELECT'||t.tagName==='TEXTAREA')) return;
if(e.ctrlKey||e.altKey||e.metaKey) return;
const ix=SECTIONS.findIndex(x=>x.k===state.sect);
let to=null;
if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='PageDown') to=Math.min(ix+1, SECTIONS.length-1);
if(e.key==='ArrowLeft' ||e.key==='PageUp')   to=Math.max(ix-1, 0);
if(e.key==='Home') to=0;
if(to!==null && to!==ix){ e.preventDefault(); state.sect=SECTIONS[to].k; render(); return; }
});
$('#pmode').addEventListener('click',e=>{
const b=e.target.closest('button[data-mode]'); if(!b) return;
state.mode=b.dataset.mode;
if(state.mode==='cumulative' && state.months.length>1)
state.months=[Math.max(...state.months)];
render();
});
$('#pbasis').addEventListener('click',e=>{
const b=e.target.closest('button[data-basis]'); if(!b) return;
state.basis=b.dataset.basis; render();
});
$('#ppills').addEventListener('click',e=>{
const b=e.target.closest('button'); if(!b) return;
if(b.dataset.q!==undefined){
if(b.dataset.q==='all'){ state.quarters=[]; }
else{
const q=+b.dataset.q;
state.quarters = state.quarters.includes(q)
? state.quarters.filter(x=>x!==q) : [...state.quarters,q];
}
}
if(b.dataset.m!==undefined){
if(b.dataset.m==='all'){ state.months=[]; }
else{
const m=+b.dataset.m;
if(state.mode==='cumulative') state.months=[m];
else state.months = state.months.includes(m)
? state.months.filter(x=>x!==m) : [...state.months,m];
}
}
render();
});
$('#fOwner').addEventListener('change',e=>{
const v=e.target.value;
state.owner = v.startsWith('F:') ? v.slice(2) : '전체';
state.cons  = v.startsWith('C:') ? v.slice(2) : '전체';
render();
});
['fType','fSrc','fCorp'].forEach(id=>{
$('#'+id).addEventListener('change',e=>{
state[{fType:'type',fSrc:'src',fCorp:'corp'}[id]]=e.target.value;
render();
});
});
let qT; $('#fQuery').addEventListener('input',e=>{
state.query=e.target.value; clearTimeout(qT); qT=setTimeout(render,200);
});
$('#resetBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
state.mode='all'; state.quarters=[]; state.months=[];
state.owner='전체';state.cons='전체';state.type='전체';state.src='전체';state.corp='전체';state.query='';
refreshFilters(); render();
});
view.addEventListener('click',e=>{
const b=e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if(!b) return;
const act=b.getAttribute('data-act'), val=b.getAttribute('data-val');
if(act==='owner'){ state.owner = state.owner===val?'전체':val; state.cons='전체'; }
if(act==='cons'){  state.cons  = state.cons===val?'전체':val;  state.owner='전체'; }
if(act==='type')  state.type  = state.type===val?'전체':val;
refreshFilters(); render();
});
$('#themeBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
const cur=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
const next=cur==='dark'?'light':'dark';
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',next);
$('#themeBtn').textContent = next==='dark'?'라이트':'다크';

});
$('#syncToggle').addEventListener('click',()=> $('#syncPanel').classList.toggle('hide'));
function msg(kind,html){
const m=$('#syncMsg'); m.className='msg on '+kind; m.innerHTML=html;
}
function normalizeUrl(u){
u=txt(u); if(!u) return '';
if(/\/pub\?/.test(u) && !/output=csv/.test(u)) u=u.replace(/output=\w+/,'output=csv');
return u;
}
function jsonp(url, timeoutMs){
timeoutMs = timeoutMs || 60000;
return new Promise((res,rej)=>{
const cb='__gsdash_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
const s=document.createElement('script');
let done=false;
const cleanup=()=>{ try{delete window[cb];}catch(e){window[cb]=undefined;}
if(s.parentNode) s.parentNode.removeChild(s); clearTimeout(timer); };
const timer=setTimeout(()=>{ if(!done){ cleanup(); rej(new Error('응답 시간 초과')); } }, timeoutMs);
window[cb]=data=>{ done=true; cleanup(); res(data); };
s.onerror=()=>{ if(!done){ cleanup();
rej(new Error('주소를 불러오지 못했습니다. 배포 URL과 접근 권한(모든 사용자)을 확인하세요.')); } };
s.src = url + (url.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?') + 'callback='+cb+'&_ts='+Date.now();
document.head.appendChild(s);
});
}
function rebuild(tongyeRows, malRows, source){
const ledger=parseTongye(tongyeRows);
if(!ledger.length) throw new Error('통계 시트에서 미팅 원장을 찾지 못했습니다.');
const mal=parseMal(malRows);
const sum=parseTongyeSummary(tongyeRows);
const regions=parseRegionTables(tongyeRows);
const regionDefs=parseRegionDefs(tongyeRows);
const sectors=parseSectors(tongyeRows);
const owners=parseOwnerStats(tongyeRows);
if(sum && sum.year && sum.year.inq>0 && mal.years.length){
const lastY=mal.years[mal.years.length-1];
if(lastY && lastY.partial) lastY.inq = sum.year.inq;
}
const yr=dominantYear(ledger);
DB={ledger, months:mal.months, msum:mal.msum, years:mal.years,
ytdBt:mal.ytdBt, ytdTot:mal.ytdTot, sum, regions, regionDefs, sectors, owners,
year:yr, stamp:Date.now(), source, odd:oddYearRows(ledger,yr)};
}
async function loadFromScript(silent){
const u=txt($('#urlScript').value);
if(!u) return false;
setStatus('','불러오는 중…');
try{
const d=await jsonp(u);
if(d && d.error) throw new Error(d.error);
if(!d || !d.tongye || !d.mal) throw new Error('응답에 통계·말 데이터가 없습니다.');
rebuild(d.tongye, d.mal, '구글 시트 (Apps Script 실시간)');
store.set('urlScript',u); store.set('auto',$('#autoChk').checked);
refreshFilters(); render();
setStatus('live','시트 실시간 연결됨');
msg('ok',`시트에서 불러왔습니다. 미팅 원장 <b>${i(DB.ledger.length)}건</b>`);
return true;
}catch(err){
if(!silent) msg('bad','Apps Script 연결 실패: '+esc(err.message));
return false;
}
}
async function fetchCSV(url){
const bust=url+(url.includes('?')?'&':'?')+'_ts='+Date.now();
const r=await fetch(bust,{cache:'no-store',redirect:'follow'});
if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);
const t=await r.text();
if(/<html/i.test(t.slice(0,400))) throw new Error('CSV가 아닌 HTML이 돌아왔습니다.');
return t;
}
async function loadFromUrls(silent){
const a=normalizeUrl($('#urlTongye').value), b=normalizeUrl($('#urlMal').value);
if(!a||!b){ if(!silent) msg('bad','두 주소를 모두 넣어주세요.'); return false; }
setStatus('','불러오는 중…');
try{
const [ta,tb]=await Promise.all([fetchCSV(a),fetchCSV(b)]);
rebuild(parseCSV(ta), parseCSV(tb), '구글 시트 (웹에 게시)');
store.set('urlTongye',a); store.set('urlMal',b); store.set('auto',$('#autoChk').checked);
refreshFilters(); render();
setStatus('live','시트 연결됨');
msg('ok',`불러왔습니다. 미팅 원장 <b>${i(DB.ledger.length)}건</b>`);
return true;
}catch(err){
setStatus('err','연결 실패 · 내장 데이터 표시 중');
$('#syncPanel').classList.remove('hide');
msg('bad',`시트를 불러오지 못했습니다: ${esc(err.message)}`);
return false;
}
}
$('#connectBtn').addEventListener('click',async ()=>{
if(txt($('#urlScript').value)){ if(await loadFromScript(false)) return; }
loadFromUrls(false);
});
$('#clearBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
store.del('urlTongye'); store.del('urlMal'); store.del('urlScript');
$('#urlScript').value=DEFAULT_URLS.script;
$('#urlTongye').value=DEFAULT_URLS.tongye; $('#urlMal').value=DEFAULT_URLS.mal;
msg('ok','기본 주소로 되돌렸습니다.');
});
let everyTimer=null;
const dayKey = d => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
async function refreshNow(silent){
if(RUN_MODE){
try{ skeleton('최신 데이터를 다시 읽는 중입니다'); await loadViaRun(true); return true; }
catch(err){ setStatus('err','갱신 실패'); render(); if(!silent) alert('갱신 실패: '+err.message); return false; }
}
if(INLINE_MODE){ location.reload(); return true; }
if(txt($('#urlScript').value)){ if(await loadFromScript(silent)) return true; }
if($('#urlTongye').value && $('#urlMal').value) return await loadFromUrls(silent);
return false;
}
$('#refreshBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>refreshNow(false));
function showNextRun(){
const el=$('#nextRun'); if(!el) return;
const parts=[];
if($('#dailyChk').checked){
const [h,m]=($('#dailyTime').value||'14:40').split(':').map(Number);
const now=new Date();
const next=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate(),h||0,m||0,0,0);
if(store.get('lastDaily','')===dayKey(now) || next<=now) next.setDate(next.getDate()+1);
parts.push(`다음 예약 갱신: ${next.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{month:'numeric',day:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}`);
}
if($('#everyChk').checked) parts.push(`${$('#everyMin').value}분마다 갱신 중`);
el.textContent = parts.length? parts.join(' · ') : '예약 갱신 꺼짐';
}
function setupEvery(){
if(everyTimer){ clearInterval(everyTimer); everyTimer=null; }
if(!$('#everyChk').checked) return;
const mins=Math.max(5,Math.min(720,+$('#everyMin').value||30));
everyTimer=setInterval(()=>refreshNow(true).then(showNextRun), mins*60*1000);
}
function saveSched(){
store.set('dailyOn',$('#dailyChk').checked);
store.set('dailyTime',$('#dailyTime').value);
store.set('everyOn',$('#everyChk').checked);
store.set('everyMin',$('#everyMin').value);
setupEvery(); showNextRun();
}
setInterval(async ()=>{
if(!$('#dailyChk') || !$('#dailyChk').checked) return;
const [h,m]=($('#dailyTime').value||'14:40').split(':').map(Number);
const now=new Date(), k=dayKey(now);
if(store.get('lastDaily','')===k) return;
if(now.getHours()>h || (now.getHours()===h && now.getMinutes()>=m)){
store.set('lastDaily',k);
await refreshNow(true);
showNextRun();
}
}, 30000);
['dailyChk','dailyTime','everyChk','everyMin'].forEach(id=>
$('#'+id).addEventListener('change', saveSched));
function syncScriptLink(){
const u=txt($('#urlScript').value), a=$('#openScript');
if(a){ a.href=u||'#'; a.style.pointerEvents=u?'auto':'none'; }
}
$('#urlScript').addEventListener('input', syncScriptLink);
function loadScript(src){
return new Promise((res,rej)=>{
const s=document.createElement('script'); s.src=src; s.onload=res;
s.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('엑셀 해석기를 불러오지 못했습니다 (인터넷 확인)'));
document.head.appendChild(s);
});
}
async function handleFile(file){
if(!file) return;
setStatus('','파일 읽는 중…');
try{
if(/\.csv$/i.test(file.name)) throw new Error('CSV 한 개로는 두 시트를 채울 수 없습니다. 엑셀(.xlsx)을 올려주세요.');
if(!window.XLSX) await loadScript('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js');
const buf=await file.arrayBuffer();
const wb=XLSX.read(buf,{type:'array'});
const pick=n=>{ const s=wb.Sheets[n]; if(!s) throw new Error(`"${n}" 시트를 찾지 못했습니다.`);
return XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(s,{header:1,defval:'',raw:false,blankrows:true}); };
rebuild(pick('통계'), pick('말'), '엑셀 파일 · '+file.name);
refreshFilters(); render();
setStatus('stale','엑셀 파일');
msg('ok',`엑셀에서 불러왔습니다. 미팅 원장 <b>${i(DB.ledger.length)}건</b>`);
}catch(err){
setStatus('err','읽기 실패');
msg('bad','엑셀을 읽지 못했습니다: '+esc(err.message));
}
}
const dz=$('#dropZone'), fi=$('#fileInput');
dz.addEventListener('click',()=>fi.click());
fi.addEventListener('change',e=>handleFile(e.target.files[0]));
['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(ev=>dz.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.add('over');}));
['dragleave','drop'].forEach(ev=>dz.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over');}));
dz.addEventListener('drop',e=>handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]));
window.addEventListener('dragover',e=>e.preventDefault());
window.addEventListener('drop',e=>e.preventDefault());

['.sync .actions','#dropZone'].forEach(sel=>{

$('#syncToggle').textContent='자동 갱신';
const h=document.querySelector('#syncPanel h3'), pp=document.querySelector('#syncPanel p');
if(h) h.textContent='자동 갱신';
if(pp) pp.innerHTML='이 주소는 <b>30분마다 시트를 미리 읽어 둡니다.</b> 그래서 빨리 열립니다. 방금 고친 내용을 지금 보려면 왼쪽 아래 <b>새로고침</b>을 누르세요.';
}
if(RUN_MODE && !INLINE_MODE){
renderNav();
skeleton();
loadViaRun(false).catch(err=>{
view.innerHTML=`<section class="panel"><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px">시트를 읽지 못했습니다</h2>
<p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)">${esc(err.message)}</p></section>`;
setStatus('err','시트 읽기 실패');
}).then(()=>{
store.set('lastDaily', dayKey(new Date()));
setupEvery(); showNextRun();
});
return;
}
if(INLINE_MODE){
const d=window.__INLINE_DATA__;
try{
if(d.error) throw new Error(d.error);
rebuild(d.tongye, d.mal, RUN_MODE?'구글 시트 (웹주소 · 30분마다 자동 갱신)':'구글 시트 (웹주소 · 열 때마다 최신)');
refreshFilters(); render();
setStatus('live','시트 실시간');
}catch(err){
view.innerHTML=`<section class="panel"><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:15px">시트를 읽지 못했습니다</h2>
<p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)">${esc(err.message)}</p></section>`;
setStatus('err','시트 읽기 실패');
return;
}
store.set('lastDaily', dayKey(new Date()));
setupEvery(); showNextRun();
return;
}
rebuild(EMBEDDED.tongye, EMBEDDED.mal, '내장 데이터 (스냅샷)');
refreshFilters(); render();
setStatus('stale','내장 데이터');
const sc=store.get('urlScript', DEFAULT_URLS.script);
const a=store.get('urlTongye', DEFAULT_URLS.tongye);
const b=store.get('urlMal',    DEFAULT_URLS.mal);
const auto=store.get('auto',true);
$('#urlScript').value=sc; $('#urlTongye').value=a; $('#urlMal').value=b;
$('#autoChk').checked=!!auto;
setupEvery(); showNextRun(); syncScriptLink();
if(!auto){ setStatus('stale','연결됨 · 새로고침 누르면 갱신'); return; }
(async ()=>{
const mark=()=>{ store.set('lastDaily', dayKey(new Date())); showNextRun(); };
if(sc && await loadFromScript(true)){ mark(); return; }
if(a&&b && await loadFromUrls(true)){ mark(); return; }
setStatus('err','실시간 연결 안 됨 · 내장 데이터 표시 중');
})();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

````javascript
/* Read only the requested weekly meeting summaries; never customer rows. */
function collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10() {
  var id = '1DkUE6SYR9uyS3TGzlRTq28yuGluYpnuF2yuyCt_2lx8';
  var result = { at: new Date().toISOString(), spreadsheetId: id, sheets: [], errors: [] };
  try {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh) {
      var m = sh.getName().match(/^(\d{2})\.(\d{2})$/);
      if (!m || Number(m[1]) < 25 || Number(m[2]) < 1 || Number(m[2]) > 12) return;
      try {
        result.sheets.push({ sheet: sh.getName(), gid: sh.getSheetId(), year: 2000 + Number(m[1]), month: Number(m[2]), rows: sh.getRange('J1:O8').getDisplayValues() });
      } catch (e) { result.errors.push(sh.getName() + ': ' + e.message); }
    });
  } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); }
  return result;
}

````

````javascript
/* Calendar weeks connect two independently dated source reports. */
const CW={weeks:store.get('v10_consultingWeeks',{}),loading:false,error:''};
const cwISO=d=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const cwShift=(iso,n)=>{const d=new Date(iso+'T00:00:00Z');d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+n);return cwISO(d);};
function cwWeekOne(year){const d=new Date(Date.UTC(year,0,4));d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-(d.getUTCDay()+6)%7);return cwISO(d);}
function cwWeekCount(year){return Math.round((Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year+1))-Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year)))/604800000);}
function cwRange(year,week){const start=cwShift(cwWeekOne(year),(week-1)*7);return {year,week,start,end:cwShift(start,4),meetingStart:cwShift(start,-3),meetingEnd:cwShift(start,3)};}
function cwSelected(year){const saved=Number(CW.weeks[year]);if(saved>=1&&saved<=cwWeekCount(year))return saved;return Math.max(1,Math.min(cwWeekCount(year),1+Math.floor((Date.parse(v10Today())-Date.parse(cwWeekOne(year)))/604800000)));}
function cwPeriod(raw,year,month){
 const m=String(raw||'').match(/(\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{1,2})\s*[~～–—-]\s*(\d{1,2})[\/-](\d{1,2})/);if(!m)return null;
 const sm=Number(m[1]),em=Number(m[3]);let sy=year;if(month===1&&sm===12)sy--;if(month===12&&sm===1)sy++;
 const start=`${sy}-${String(sm).padStart(2,'0')}-${m[2].padStart(2,'0')}`,end=`${sy+(em<sm?1:0)}-${String(em).padStart(2,'0')}-${m[4].padStart(2,'0')}`;
 if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(start))||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(end))||cwISO(new Date(start+'T00:00:00Z'))!==start||cwISO(new Date(end+'T00:00:00Z'))!==end)return null;
 return {start,end};
}
const cwValue=v=>txt(v)===''?null:num(v);
function cwInquiryRows(payload){
 const report=smParseInquiryReport(payload?.tongye);
 return report.weekly.map(w=>({...w,...cwPeriod(w.period,report.year,report.month),year:report.year,month:report.month})).filter(w=>w.start&&new Date(w.start+'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay()===1&&cwShift(w.start,4)===w.end);
}
function cwMeetingRows(payload){
 const found=new Map();
 for(const sh of payload?.weeklyMeetings?.sheets||[]){
  const name=sh.sheet.match(/^(\d{2})\.(\d{2})$/);if(!name)continue;
  const year=sh.year||2000+Number(name[1]),month=sh.month||Number(name[2]);
  const header=(sh.rows||[]).find(row=>txt(row[0])==='날짜')||[];
  const hasMarketingCapacity=/마케팅.*미팅.*용량/.test(txt(header[4])),hasMarketingCount=/마케팅.*미팅.*건수/.test(txt(header[5]));
  for(const row of sh.rows||[]){
   if(!/^\d+주차$/.test(txt(row[1])))continue;
   const dates=cwPeriod(row[0],year,month);if(!dates||new Date(dates.start+'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay()!==5||cwShift(dates.start,6)!==dates.end)continue;
   const item={...dates,sheet:sh.sheet,gid:sh.gid,period:txt(row[0]),week:txt(row[1]),capacity:cwValue(row[2]),count:cwValue(row[3]),marketingCapacity:hasMarketingCapacity?cwValue(row[4]):null,marketingCount:hasMarketingCount?cwValue(row[5]):null};
   // A week repeated at a month boundary must not be counted twice.
   if(!found.has(item.start)||item.count!==null)found.set(item.start,item);
  }
 }
 return [...found.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.start.localeCompare(b.start));
}
function cwData(year,week){
 const range=cwRange(year,week),inquiry=cwInquiryRows(V10.payload).find(r=>r.start===range.start&&r.end===range.end),meeting=cwMeetingRows(V10.payload).find(r=>r.start===range.meetingStart&&r.end===range.meetingEnd);
 return {range,inquiry,meeting};
}
const cwLabel=(a,b)=>`${a.slice(5).replace('-','/')} ~ ${b.slice(5).replace('-','/')}`;
const cwMetric=(inquiry,index)=>cwValue(inquiry?.metrics?.[index]?.values?.[4]);
const cwShow=(value,unit='건')=>value===null||value===undefined?'—':`${Number(value).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:3})}${unit}`;
function cwCard(label,value,note,color){return `<article class="v10-kpi" style="--metric:${color}"><span class="label">${esc(label)}</span><strong>${esc(value)}</strong><small>${esc(note)}</small></article>`;}
function cwView(){
 const year=Number(DB.year),week=cwSelected(year),{range:r,inquiry,meeting}=cwData(year,week),count=cwWeekCount(year);
 const source=smParseInquiryReport(V10.payload?.tongye),available=cwInquiryRows(V10.payload),meetingRows=cwMeetingRows(V10.payload);
 const selector=`<div class="cw-controls"><button class="btn" data-cw-step="-1" ${week===1?'disabled':''}>이전 주</button><label>연간 주차<select id="consultingWeek" aria-label="연간 주차">${Array.from({length:count},(_,n)=>{const w=cwRange(year,n+1);return `<option value="${n+1}" ${week===n+1?'selected':''}>${n+1}주차 · ${cwLabel(w.start,w.end)}</option>`;}).join('')}</select></label><button class="btn" data-cw-step="1" ${week===count?'disabled':''}>다음 주</button><button class="btn" data-cw-today>이번 주</button><strong>${year}년 ${week}주차</strong></div>`;
 const periods=`<div class="cw-periods"><div><span>문의 · 월요일~금요일</span><b>${cwLabel(r.start,r.end)}</b></div><div><span>미팅 · 금요일~목요일</span><b>${cwLabel(r.meetingStart,r.meetingEnd)}</b></div></div>`;
 const inquiryBody=inquiry?smMetricsTable(inquiry.metrics):v10Empty('이 주의 문의 원본 자료가 연결되지 않았습니다.');
 const meetingBody=meeting?v10Table(['구분','미팅 건수','미팅 용량'],[['전체',cwShow(meeting.count),cwShow(meeting.capacity,' kW')],['마케팅',cwShow(meeting.marketingCount),cwShow(meeting.marketingCapacity,' kW')]]):v10Empty(CW.loading?'미팅 원본을 불러오는 중입니다.':'이 주의 미팅 원본 자료가 연결되지 않았습니다.');
 const rows=Array.from({length:count},(_,n)=>{const w=cwRange(year,n+1),a=available.find(x=>x.start===w.start),b=meetingRows.find(x=>x.start===w.meetingStart);return [`<button class="easy-link ${n+1===week?'cw-selected':''}" data-cw-week="${n+1}">${n+1}주차</button>`,cwLabel(w.start,w.end),cwShow(cwMetric(a,0)),cwShow(cwMetric(a,1)),cwLabel(w.meetingStart,w.meetingEnd),cwShow(b?.count),cwShow(b?.capacity,' kW')];});
 return easyLead('컨설팅 주간 실적','문의와 미팅의 원본 보고 기간을 각각 확인합니다.','주간 · 부서 전체')+selector+periods
 +`<div class="v10-kpis">${cwCard('전체 주간 문의',cwShow(cwMetric(inquiry,0)),'월~금 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[0])}${cwCard('발전사업 주간 문의',cwShow(cwMetric(inquiry,1)),'월~금 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[1])}${cwCard('보고 미팅 건수',cwShow(meeting?.count),'금~목 · 원본 보고 미팅',V10.colors[3])}${cwCard('보고 미팅 용량',cwShow(meeting?.capacity,' kW'),'금~목 · 원본 합계',V10.colors[4])}</div>`
 +`<div class="cw-panels">${v10Panel('유입별 주간 문의',`${cwLabel(r.start,r.end)} · 월~금`,inquiryBody+`<p class="v10-note">문의 원본: 통계 AB~AH · 현재 ${source.year||'—'}년 ${source.month||'—'}월 표가 연결되어 있습니다. 빈칸은 —, 원본의 0은 0으로 표시합니다.</p><a class="easy-link" href="${SALES_MEETING_SOURCE.inquiry}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">문의 원본 열기 ↗</a>`)}${v10Panel('주간 미팅 실적',`${cwLabel(r.meetingStart,r.meetingEnd)} · 금~목`,meetingBody+`<p class="v10-note">미팅 원본: ${esc(meeting?.sheet||'월별 시트')} J~O. 예정 미팅이 포함된 경우 원본 집계 그대로 표시합니다.</p><a class="easy-link" href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DkUE6SYR9uyS3TGzlRTq28yuGluYpnuF2yuyCt_2lx8/edit?gid=${meeting?.gid||1866167974}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">미팅 원본 열기 ↗</a>`)}</div>`
 +((CW.error||V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings?.errors?.length)?`<div class="v10-callout" role="status">미팅 자료 연결 확인 필요: ${esc(CW.error||V10.payload.weeklyMeetings.errors.join(' / '))}</div>`:'')
 +`<p class="v10-note">주차는 ISO 연간 주차를 사용합니다.${count===53?' '+year+'년은 달력상 53주차가 있어 연말 누락 없이 표시합니다.':''} 서로 다른 기간의 문의와 미팅으로 전환율을 계산하지 않습니다. 문의 과거 주차는 원본에 확인된 자료만 표시합니다.</p>`
 +v10Panel('연간 주차별 비교','주차를 누르면 해당 주의 상세 자료로 이동합니다.',v10Table(['주차','문의 기간 (월~금)','전체 문의','발전사업 문의','미팅 기간 (금~목)','미팅 건수','미팅 용량'],rows))
 +`<p class="v10-note">미팅 자료 갱신: ${esc(V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings?.at?new Date(V10.payload.weeklyMeetings.at).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul'}):'연결 대기')}</p>`;
}
function cwLoad(){
 if(V10.payload?.weeklyMeetings||CW.loading||CW.error||typeof google==='undefined'||!google.script?.run)return;
 CW.loading=true;google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(d=>{CW.loading=false;V10.payload.weeklyMeetings=d;if(state.sect==='weekly')render();}).withFailureHandler(e=>{CW.loading=false;CW.error=String(e.message||e);if(state.sect==='weekly')render();}).collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10();
}
SECTIONS.push({k:'weekly',t:'주간 실적',g:'실적',basis:'exec'});
VIEWS.weekly=()=>{cwLoad();return cwView();};
EASY_MENU.find(x=>x.k==='summary').items.push(['weekly','주간 실적']);
const cwOriginalPeriod=renderPeriod;
renderPeriod=function(){cwOriginalPeriod();document.body.classList.toggle('cw-weekly',state.sect==='weekly');if(state.sect==='weekly'){$('#easyPeriodNote').textContent=`${DB.year}년 · 연간 주차 조회 · 문의 월~금 / 미팅 금~목 · 부서 전체`;} };
const cwToolbar=document.querySelector('.easy-toolbar');
if(cwToolbar){const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='easy-preset cw-open';button.dataset.v10Section='weekly';button.textContent='주간 조회';cwToolbar.insertBefore(button,cwToolbar.firstChild);}
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.id==='consultingWeek'){CW.weeks[DB.year]=Number(e.target.value);store.set('v10_consultingWeeks',CW.weeks);render();}});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-cw-week],[data-cw-step],[data-cw-today]');if(!b)return;const year=Number(DB.year);if(b.hasAttribute('data-cw-today')){delete CW.weeks[year];}else CW.weeks[year]=Math.max(1,Math.min(cwWeekCount(year),b.dataset.cwWeek?Number(b.dataset.cwWeek):cwSelected(year)+Number(b.dataset.cwStep)));store.set('v10_consultingWeeks',CW.weeks);render();});
````

### apps-script/v10/year-data.gs

````javascript
/* v10 additions: year discovery and a compact, read-only inquiry ledger. */
function collectYearDataV10(ss) {
  var result = {};
  ss.getSheets().forEach(function(sh) {
    var year = sh.getName();
    if (!/^20\d{2}$/.test(year) || Number(year) < 2025) return;
    var last = sh.getLastRow();
    var records = [];
    if (last >= 3) {
      var rows = sh.getRange(3, 1, last - 2, Math.min(sh.getMaxColumns(),13)).getDisplayValues();
      rows.forEach(function(v) {
        var no = String(v[0] || '').trim();
        var match = no.match(/^(?:(sp|ugs)[- ]?)?(\d{1,2})-(\d{2})\d+/i);
        // Number-only preallocated rows are not actual inquiries.
        if (!match || !v.slice(1).some(function(cell) { return String(cell || '').trim(); })) return;
        var month = Number(match[2]);
        if (month < 1 || month > 12) return;
        var day = Number(match[3]);
        var inquiryDate = day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? year+'-'+('0'+month).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+day).slice(-2) : '';
        var dt = String(v[9] || '').match(/(20\d{2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})[.\/-](\d{1,2})/);
        var date = dt ? dt[1]+'-'+('0'+dt[2]).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+dt[3]).slice(-2) : '';
        var status = String(v[1] || '').trim();
        var area = String(v[4] || '');
        var reg = /서울|경기|인천/.test(area)?'수도권':/충남|충북|충청|대전|세종/.test(area)?'충청권':/강원/.test(area)?'강원권':/부산|대구|울산|경남|경북|경상/.test(area)?'영남권':/광주|전남|전북|전라/.test(area)?'호남권':/제주/.test(area)?'제주':area?'기타':'미분류';
        records.push({no:no,year:Number(year),cmo:month,inquiryDate:inquiryDate,date:date,em:dt?Number(dt[2]):0,meetingYear:dt?Number(dt[1]):0,
          ct:status,src:/소개/.test(status)?'소개':status?'마케팅':'미분류',type:String(v[2]||''),reg:reg,
          prop:String(v[5]||''),cons:String(v[6]||''),own:String(v[7]||'미지정'),
          cap:parseFloat(String(v[10]||'').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''))||0,
          corp:match[1]?match[1].toUpperCase():'그랜드썬'});
      });
    }
    result[year] = {records:records,source:year+' 문의 원장',sourceRule:'소개 상태는 소개, 나머지 기재 상태는 마케팅; 법인은 상담번호 접두어 기준'};
  });
  return result;
}

````

### scripts/build-dashboard-v10.mjs

````javascript
// Assemble self-contained Apps Script files from the supplied source and v10 extension.
import { readFile,writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import {gunzipSync} from 'node:zlib';
const base=new URL('../apps-script/v10/',import.meta.url);
const read=name=>readFile(new URL(name,base),'utf8');
let html=await read('template.html');
const css=(await read('dashboard.css'))+'\n'+(await read('easy-ui.css'))+'\n'+await read('followup.css')+'\n'+await read('readability.css')+'\n'+await read('sales-meeting.css')+'\n'+await read('sales-minutes.css')+'\n'+await read('business-parts.css')+'\n'+await read('weekly.css');
const contractInput=process.env.CONTRACT_DATA_GZIP_BASE64?gunzipSync(Buffer.from(process.env.CONTRACT_DATA_GZIP_BASE64,'base64')).toString('utf8'):await read('contracts-data.json');
const parsedContracts=JSON.parse(contractInput);
if(!Array.isArray(parsedContracts.sources))throw Error('Contract build data is missing or invalid');
const contractData=JSON.stringify(parsedContracts).replaceAll('<','\\u003c').replaceAll('\u2028','\\u2028').replaceAll('\u2029','\\u2029');
const contracts=(await read('contracts.js')).replace('__CONTRACT_DATA__',contractData);

let server=await read('template.gs');
server=server.replace("'gsdash_v9'","'gsdash_v10'").replace('var CHUNK     = 90000','var CHUNK     = 24000');
server=server.replace('var CACHE_SEC = 21600','var CACHE_SEC = 300');

server=server.replace('    return out;\n  } catch (err)',"    out.yearData = collectYearDataV10(SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID));\n    return out;\n  } catch (err)");

server=server.replace("t.DATA = warm ? warm : 'null';","t.DATA = 'null';");

server+='\n'+await read('year-data.gs');
server+='\n'+await read('followup.gs');
server+='\n'+await read('followup-source.gs');
server+='\n'+await read('presentation-comments.gs');
server+='\n'+await read('weekly-data.gs');
server=server.replace('  var fresh = !!p.fresh;',"  if (p.weekly === '1') return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(collectWeeklyMeetingDataV10())).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);\n  var fresh = !!p.fresh;");

if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(adminHash))throw Error('Valid administrator hash is required; authentication cannot be reset during deployment');
server=server.replace('__FOLLOWUP_ADMIN_HASH__',adminHash);

html=html.replace('</head>',`<meta name="dashboard-release" content="${release}">\n</head>`);
````

### scripts/dashboard-data-source.mjs

````javascript
// Read-only: current full reporting ranges and legacy year ledgers are separate sources.
export const CURRENT_ENDPOINT='https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzHukN_HIc7iguhO8ujKhJUO4NaPUOSkc2p3RyLe-Emq_UpH9uOOr-xGWZqHwEUkxYM/exec';
export const YEAR_ENDPOINT='https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycby7LAZQTCtyReniF7IJtEkXo7LvSVRtvKzAJ4tvUKy5y_pFfNmJcw6UktI1trYFIuS9/exec';
async function get(url,fresh){
 const r=await fetch(url+'?data=1'+(fresh?'&fresh=1':''),{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60000)});
 if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Google data request failed: '+r.status);
 const d=await r.json();if(d.error)throw new Error(d.error);return d;
}
export async function readDashboardPayload(fresh=false){
 const [current,legacy,weekly]=await Promise.allSettled([get(CURRENT_ENDPOINT,true),get(YEAR_ENDPOINT,fresh),fetch(CURRENT_ENDPOINT+'?weekly=1',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60000)}).then(async r=>{if(!r.ok)throw Error('주간 미팅 연결: '+r.status);const d=await r.json();if(!Array.isArray(d.sheets))throw Error('주간 미팅 연결 기능이 필요합니다.');return d;})]);
 if(current.status!=='fulfilled')throw current.reason;
 const d=current.value;
 d.weeklyMeetings=weekly.status==='fulfilled'?weekly.value:{sheets:[],errors:['주간 미팅 원본 연결 실패: '+weekly.reason.message]};
 if(!Array.isArray(d.tongye)||!Array.isArray(d.mal)||!d.tongye[193]?.[29])throw new Error('통계 전체 집계 범위를 읽지 못했습니다. 이전 축소 데이터로 대체하지 않습니다.');
 const warnings=[];
 if(legacy.status==='fulfilled')d.yearSheets=legacy.value.yearSheets;
 else warnings.push('연도별 원장 연결 실패: 현재 통계·말 시트만 표시합니다.');
 d.provenance={reportEndpoint:CURRENT_ENDPOINT,reportAt:d.at,yearEndpoint:YEAR_ENDPOINT,yearAt:legacy.status==='fulfilled'?legacy.value.at:null,warnings};
 return d;
}

````

### scripts/deploy-dashboard.mjs

````javascript
// Deploy only the dashboard files. Keep editor-only changes and sharing untouched.
import {readFile,writeFile,mkdir} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
export const SCRIPT_ID='1vjd_vQXbncbVPvOlgRZZsy0XLRYXqywWIwAc-S_9Pov7d4gn75NhmTIj';
export const DEPLOYMENT_ID='AKfycbzHukN_HIc7iguhO8ujKhJUO4NaPUOSkc2p3RyLe-Emq_UpH9uOOr-xGWZqHwEUkxYM';
export const WEB_URL=`https://script.google.com/macros/s/${DEPLOYMENT_ID}/exec`;
export const filesOnly=d=>({files:d.files.map(({name,type,source})=>({name,type,source}))});
export const fingerprint=d=>createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(filesOnly(d).files.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name)))).digest('hex');
export function releaseFiles(published,html,server){
 const next=filesOnly(published);
 for(const [name,type,source] of [['index','HTML',html],['대시보드','SERVER_JS',server]]){
  const matches=next.files.filter(f=>f.name===name&&f.type===type);
  if(matches.length!==1)throw Error('Expected dashboard file is missing or ambiguous: '+name);
  matches[0].source=source;
 }
 return next;
}
export async function deploy({api,html,server,release,checkHealth,backup=async()=>{},log=console.log}){
 if(!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/i.test(release))throw Error('Deployment requires a Git commit identifier');
 if(!html.includes(`content="${release}"`)||!server.includes(`release:'${release}'`))throw Error('Build/release identifier mismatch');
 const prior=await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID);
 if(!Number.isInteger(prior.deploymentConfig?.versionNumber))throw Error('Existing versioned deployment is required');
 const published=await api('content?versionNumber='+prior.deploymentConfig.versionNumber);
 const head=await api('content');
 const next=releaseFiles(published,html,server);
 await backup({head,prior});
 if(fingerprint(await api('content'))!==fingerprint(head))throw Error('Editor changed during preparation; deployment stopped');
 let staged=false,version;
 try{
  staged=true;
  await api('content','PUT',next);
  if(fingerprint(await api('content'))!==fingerprint(next))throw Error('Staged source verification failed');
  version=await api('versions','POST',{description:'GitHub '+release.slice(0,12)});
  if(!Number.isInteger(version.versionNumber))throw Error('Version creation was not confirmed');
 }finally{
  if(staged){
   const now=await api('content');
   if(fingerprint(now)===fingerprint(next)){
    await api('content','PUT',filesOnly(head));
    if(fingerprint(await api('content'))!==fingerprint(head))throw Error('Editor source restoration failed; deployment not changed');
   }else if(fingerprint(now)!==fingerprint(head))throw Error('Concurrent editor change detected; deployment stopped without overwriting it');
  }
 }
 const target={...prior.deploymentConfig,versionNumber:version.versionNumber,description:'GitHub '+release.slice(0,12)};
 const latest=await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID);
 if(JSON.stringify(latest.deploymentConfig)!==JSON.stringify(prior.deploymentConfig))throw Error('Deployment changed concurrently; refusing to replace it');
 try{
  await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID,'PUT',{deploymentConfig:target});
  const verified=await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID);
  if(verified.deploymentConfig.versionNumber!==version.versionNumber)throw Error('Deployment version verification failed');
  if(!await checkHealth(release))throw Error('Published health check failed');
 }catch(e){
  const current=await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID);
  if(current.deploymentConfig.versionNumber===version.versionNumber){
   await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID,'PUT',{deploymentConfig:prior.deploymentConfig});
   const restored=await api('deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID);
   if(restored.deploymentConfig.versionNumber!==prior.deploymentConfig.versionNumber)throw Error('Rollback could not be verified; inspect deployment immediately');
   log('Previous deployment restored after verification failure.');
  }
  throw e;
 }
 log('Deployment verified: version '+version.versionNumber+' / commit '+release.slice(0,12));
 return {version:version.versionNumber,previousVersion:prior.deploymentConfig.versionNumber,url:WEB_URL};
}
export async function main(){
 const env=process.env;
 for(const key of ['GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID','GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET','GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN','GITHUB_SHA'])if(!env[key])throw Error('Required secret or release is missing: '+key);
 const authResponse=await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',{method:'POST',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30000),body:new URLSearchParams({client_id:env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,client_secret:env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,refresh_token:env.GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN,grant_type:'refresh_token'})});
 if(!authResponse.ok)throw Error('Google authentication failed (HTTP '+authResponse.status+'); reauthorize the deployment account');
 const auth=await authResponse.json();if(!auth.access_token)throw Error('Google did not return an access token');
 if(env.GITHUB_ACTIONS==='true')console.log('::add-mask::'+auth.access_token);
 const api=async(path,method='GET',body)=>{
  const r=await fetch(`https://script.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${SCRIPT_ID}/${path}`,{method,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60000),headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+auth.access_token,'Content-Type':'application/json'},...(body?{body:JSON.stringify(body)}:{})});
  if(!r.ok)throw Error('Apps Script '+method+' '+path+' failed (HTTP '+r.status+')');
  return r.json();
 };
 const base=new URL('../apps-script/v10/',import.meta.url);
 const html=await readFile(new URL('index.html',base),'utf8'),server=await readFile(new URL('대시보드.gs',base),'utf8');
 const checkHealth=async release=>{
  for(let n=0;n<6;n++){
   try{const r=await fetch(WEB_URL+'?health=1&release='+release+'&check='+n,{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(25000)});if(r.ok){const d=await r.json();if(d.ok===true&&d.release===release)return true;}}catch{}
   if(n<5)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000));
  }
  return false;
 };
 const backup=async data=>{
  const folder=new URL('../outputs/deployment-'+Date.now()+'/',import.meta.url);await mkdir(folder,{recursive:true});
  await writeFile(new URL('prior.json',folder),JSON.stringify(data),{mode:0o600});
 };
 const result=await deploy({api,html,server,release:env.GITHUB_SHA,checkHealth,backup});
 if(env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY)await writeFile(env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY,`## Dashboard deployed\n- Commit: ${env.GITHUB_SHA}\n- Version: ${result.version}\n- Previous version: ${result.previousVersion}\n- [Open dashboard](${WEB_URL})\n`,{flag:'a'});
 return result;
}
if(process.argv[1]&&import.meta.url===pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href)main().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1;});

````

### scripts/preview-dashboard-v10.mjs

````javascript
import {createServer} from 'node:http';
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {readDashboardPayload} from './dashboard-data-source.mjs';
const source=new URL('../apps-script/v10/index.html',import.meta.url);
let cached=null,inflight=null;
async function payload(fresh=false){
 if(cached&&!fresh&&Date.now()-cached.time<300000)return cached.data;
 if(inflight)return inflight;
 inflight=(async()=>{
  const d=await readDashboardPayload(fresh);
  cached={data:d,time:Date.now()};return d;
 })().finally(()=>{inflight=null;});return inflight;
}
const server=createServer(async(req,res)=>{
 try{
  if(req.url.startsWith('/data.json')){const data=await payload(req.url.includes('fresh=1'));res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'application/json;charset=utf-8','cache-control':'no-store'});res.end(JSON.stringify(data));return;}
  if(req.url!=='/'){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');return;}
  const html=(await readFile(source,'utf8')).replace('<?!= DATA ?>','null');
  res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'text/html;charset=utf-8','cache-control':'no-store'});res.end(html);
 }catch(e){res.writeHead(502,{'content-type':'application/json;charset=utf-8','cache-control':'no-store'});res.end(JSON.stringify({error:e.message}));}
});
server.listen(4176,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('Dashboard v10 preview: http://127.0.0.1:4176/'));

````

````javascript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {deploy,releaseFiles,fingerprint,DEPLOYMENT_ID} from '../scripts/deploy-dashboard.mjs';
const release='a'.repeat(40),html=`<meta name="dashboard-release" content="${release}">`,server=`var health={release:'${release}'};`;
const published={files:[{name:'appsscript',type:'JSON',source:'{"webapp":{"access":"ANYONE_ANONYMOUS"}}'},{name:'index',type:'HTML',source:'old html'},{name:'대시보드',type:'SERVER_JS',source:'old server'},{name:'자동알림창',type:'SERVER_JS',source:'published alert'}]};
const editor=structuredClone(published);editor.files[3].source='unpublished user alert';
assert.equal(releaseFiles(published,html,server).files[3].source,'published alert');
assert.equal(published.files[1].source,'old html','release assembly must not mutate the published snapshot');
assert.throws(()=>releaseFiles({files:[]},html,server),/missing/);
function mock({failVersion=false,concurrentStage=false,failHealth=false}={}){
 let head=structuredClone(editor),deployment={deploymentConfig:{scriptId:'script',versionNumber:54,manifestFileName:'appsscript',description:'existing'}};
 let staged=false,conflicted=false;const calls=[];
 const api=async(path,method='GET',body)=>{
  calls.push({path,method});
  if(path==='deployments/'+DEPLOYMENT_ID){if(method==='PUT')deployment=structuredClone(body);return structuredClone(deployment);}
  if(path.startsWith('content?'))return structuredClone(published);
  if(path==='content'){
   if(method==='PUT'){head=structuredClone(body);staged=head.files[1].source===html;}
   if(method==='GET'&&staged&&concurrentStage&&!conflicted){head.files[3].source='concurrent editor change';conflicted=true;}
   return structuredClone(head);
  }
  if(path==='versions'&&method==='POST'){if(failVersion)throw Error('version unavailable');return {versionNumber:55};}
  throw Error('Unexpected API operation');
 };
 return {api,checkHealth:async()=>!failHealth,log:()=>{},read:()=>({head,deployment,calls})};
}
{
 const m=mock();const result=await deploy({...m,html,server,release});
 assert.equal(result.version,55);assert.equal(fingerprint(m.read().head),fingerprint(editor),'unpublished editor source is preserved');
 assert.equal(m.read().deployment.deploymentConfig.manifestFileName,'appsscript');
}
{
 const m=mock({failVersion:true});await assert.rejects(()=>deploy({...m,html,server,release}),/version unavailable/);
 assert.equal(fingerprint(m.read().head),fingerprint(editor));assert.equal(m.read().deployment.deploymentConfig.versionNumber,54);
}
{
 const m=mock({failHealth:true});await assert.rejects(()=>deploy({...m,html,server,release}),/health check/);
 assert.equal(m.read().deployment.deploymentConfig.versionNumber,54,'failed public verification rolls back the deployment');
}
{
 const m=mock({concurrentStage:true});await assert.rejects(()=>deploy({...m,html,server,release}),/Concurrent editor/);
 assert.equal(m.read().head.files[3].source,'concurrent editor change','never overwrite concurrent edits');
 assert.equal(m.read().deployment.deploymentConfig.versionNumber,54);
}
console.log('PASS: deployment preserves sharing and unpublished edits, stops concurrent changes, and rolls back failed verification');
````

### tests/presentation-comments-ui.test.mjs

````javascript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import vm from 'node:vm';

const source=await readFile(new URL('../apps-script/v10/easy-ui.js',import.meta.url),'utf8');
const code=source.slice(source.indexOf('const easyPresentationComments='),source.indexOf('function easyDownloadPresentationPdf'));
const timers=new Map(),calls=[];
let timerId=0;
const google={script:{get run(){
 const handlers={};
 const runner={
  withSuccessHandler(fn){handlers.success=fn;return runner;},
  withFailureHandler(fn){handlers.failure=fn;return runner;},
  getPresentationComment(...args){calls.push({name:'get',args,...handlers});},
  savePresentationComment(...args){calls.push({name:'save',args,...handlers});}
 };
 return runner;
}}};
const context=vm.createContext({
 google,RUN_MODE:true,DB:{year:2026},state:{sect:'presentation'},
 store:{get:(_key,fallback)=>fallback,set(){}},
 esc:s=>String(s),txt:s=>String(s||'').trim(),selMonths:()=>[9],v10Today:()=> '2026-09-29',
 easyPresentationInsights:()=>'<div class="perf-inquiry-metrics">자동 문의 분석</div>',
 setTimeout(fn,ms){const id=++timerId;timers.set(id,{fn,ms});return id;},
 clearTimeout:id=>timers.delete(id),
 FormData:class {constructor(form){this.form=form;}get(name){if(name==='analysis')return this.form.analysis??this.form.text??'';if(name==='inquiryAnalysis')return this.form.inquiryAnalysis??null;return this.form.improvement??'';}},
 render(){vm.runInContext('easyEnsurePresentationComment(2026,9)',context);}
});
const run=s=>vm.runInContext(s,context);
vm.runInContext(code,context);
const tick=async(ms)=>{
 for(const [id,timer] of [...timers])if(timer.ms===ms){timers.delete(id);timer.fn();}
 await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();
};
const html=run('easyPresentationCommentEditor([9])');
assert.ok(!/<textarea[^>]*disabled/.test(html),'loading must not prevent typing');
assert.ok(html.includes('문의 분석')&&html.includes('자동 문의 분석'),'inquiry analysis is rendered from automatic metrics');
assert.ok(!html.includes('name="inquiryAnalysis"'),'inquiry analysis is no longer an editable textarea');
assert.ok(html.includes('name="analysis"'),'overall analysis remains editable');
await tick(0);
assert.equal(calls.length,1);
const saving=run("easySavePresentationComment({dataset:{year:'2026',month:'9'},analysis:'직접 작성한 의견',inquiryAnalysis:'문의 분석',improvement:'실행 계획'})");
await tick(0);
assert.deepEqual(calls.map(c=>c.name),['get','save'],'saving during load does not start a second fetch');
calls[1].success({year:2026,month:9,text:'{\"version\":3,\"analysis\":\"직접 작성한 의견\",\"inquiryAnalysis\":\"문의 분석\",\"improvement\":\"실행 계획\"}',updatedAt:'2026-09-29T00:00:00Z'});
await saving;
calls[0].success({year:2026,month:9,text:'늦게 도착한 이전 내용'});
await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationCommentParts(easyPresentationComments.drafts['2026-09']).analysis"),'직접 작성한 의견','late load cannot overwrite saved text');
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationCommentParts(easyPresentationComments.drafts['2026-09']).inquiryAnalysis"),'문의 분석');
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationCommentParts(easyPresentationCommentFormText({dataset:{year:'2026',month:'9'},analysis:'수정된 종합분석',improvement:'계획'})).inquiryAnalysis"),'문의 분석','removing the old inquiry textarea must preserve its stored content');

const failedSave=run("easySavePresentationComment({dataset:{year:'2026',month:'9'},analysis:'오류가 나도 유지할 초안',improvement:'보존할 개선방안'})");
calls.at(-1).failure({message:'저장 연결 오류'});
await failedSave;
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationCommentParts(easyPresentationComments.drafts['2026-09']).analysis"),'오류가 나도 유지할 초안');
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationComments.saving['2026-09']"),false);

run('easyEnsurePresentationComment(2026,8)');await tick(0);
await tick(12000);
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationComments.loading['2026-08']"),false,'timeout ends loading');
const count=calls.length;
run('easyEnsurePresentationComment(2026,8)');await tick(0);
assert.equal(calls.length,count,'render does not retry failed loads forever');
assert.equal(run("easyPresentationCommentParts(easyPresentationComments.drafts['2026-09']).analysis"),'오류가 나도 유지할 초안','other month loading preserves current draft');
console.log('PASS: editable loading, load/save race, error drafts, timeout and month isolation');
````

````javascript
const saved=context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:'  9월 개선안\r\n후속 미팅 점검  '});
assert.equal(saved.text,'9월 개선안\n후속 미팅 점검');
assert.equal(saved.updatedBy,'reporter@example.com');
assert.equal(context.getPresentationComment(2026,9).text,'9월 개선안\n후속 미팅 점검');
assert.equal(context.getPresentationComment(2026,8).text,'','months do not overwrite each other');
context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:''});
assert.equal(context.getPresentationComment(2026,9).text,'','blank save clears the month');
assert.throws(()=>context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:13,text:'x'}),/월을 확인/);
assert.throws(()=>context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:'x'.repeat(10001)}),/10000자/);
const longText='한글😀'.repeat(1250);
context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:longText});
assert.equal(context.getPresentationComment(2026,9).text,longText,'5,000 UTF-16 characters including Korean and emoji round-trip');
const beforeFailure=new Map(values);
failKey='performance_presentation_comment_v1_2026-09';
assert.throws(()=>context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:'실패 테스트'}),/simulated/);
assert.deepEqual(values,beforeFailure,'failed publication keeps original comment and removes partial chunks');
failKey='';
context.savePresentationComment({year:2026,month:9,text:''});
assert.equal(values.size,0,'clearing also removes stored chunks');
values.set('performance_presentation_comment_v1_2026-08',JSON.stringify({text:'이전 형식 코멘트'}));
assert.equal(context.getPresentationComment(2026,8).text,'이전 형식 코멘트','legacy saved comments remain readable');
console.log('PASS: presentation comments persist by year and month with validation');

````
